chapters.title: Chapter 2880 Treachery and Plots! I
paragraphs: This was a place laid out purposefully by Noah- an intermediary to accept the many incoming powerful entities as their Extremes were burned out and filtered!
Very soon, after the arrival of the Primogenitor of Steel...
WAP! WAP!...

One after another, powerful Entities ranging from the Fifth to Seventh Gradations of Extremity appeared as their bodies were being burned of either Vacuous or Vitalis, their eyes coming to hone in on Noah's glorious figure as his voice echoed out.

{Welcome to my Aletheian Dream of Arcadia. Like the Veil of Arcadia you all stemmed from, it is meant to contain the weavings of hopes and dreams...a place to burn away your old reliance on Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority before embarking on an entirely different path.}
The Aletheian Dream of Arcadia!
On this day, under the calm gazes of Noah's people, dozens of Entities began to enter one after another as their bodies were being cleansed of Vacuous and Vitalis!
At the forefront, the visage of Steel was bright as with his burning eyes, he called out mightily.
{The Most Recent Honored One- Noah Osmont...you lived and made something grand!}
WAA!
He survived against the Dikastes of Extremity and even enacted a domain like this that could not fall under the gazes of others!
His expression was bright as he looked around and continued.
{Where is this? How can the gazes of the Ones Above Extremity not fall here?}
As he spoke, more and more Entities appeared behind him as the visage of Curagulus also appeared not too far away, his gaze bright as he gazed around with wonder.
Noah's figure was calm as when he opened his mouth to reply...
|Marvelous...|
A voice boomed out.
But it wasn't just a voice.
It was an intent!

From the body of a Vacuous Entity at the 6th Gradation of Extremity whose body was being burnt of the last remaining shreds of this authority, tendrils of Vacuous Existential Authority blared and pushed away Tyranny and Infinity!
The blooming intent alarmed the new entrants as their faces turned ashen.

|Our gazes cannot fall here because you live between Existence and Non-existence, surrounded by the light of a weaving that keeps you constantly moving across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. It truly is a marvelous creation. Truly a worthy effort.|
RUMBLE!
As the intent spoke, the body of the Entity at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity exploded as in its place, the mighty visage of Serpentine pupils and burning black wings appeared.
A Dikastes of Extremity!

Of the tendrils of Tyranny and Infinity that were previously wrapping around it, its wings held an obsidian transparent glass that now contained wriggling Existential Extremity Authorities of Tyranny and Infinity.
The moment it appeared, the color drained from all the Entities who had arrived in the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia!
Those near the emerging Dikastes of Extremity scrambled away as their extremes began to burn with even more fear and a sense of rising regret.
They had already made this choice as they couldn't take it back!
But as regret rose in the hearts of some, those who had lived even longer and were more perceptive had their gazes turn toward the Most Recent Honored One who had taken them all here.
They saw his visage still unfettered as his hands remained behind his back.
Seeing this, the eyes of Steel and others retained their sense of calm as it seemed that not everything was for naught!
Did he expect this? Did he plan for this? Did he know this would happen?!
Noah's gaze was also noticed by the Dikastes of Extremity as the serpentine eyes of this entity curved into a cruel smile while its intent weaved out.
|Why are you still so smug, Insurgent? Finding the cave you were hiding in was hard as wondrously, a worthless seed like you led us right to it with just a little push.|
|Call out to you? The Weaver of Extremity? What laughable nugatory efforts and words those were.|

As it spoke, even more auras blared and emerged as an Entity who was known as the Primogenitor of Bones at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity...had his visage explode as from it, a Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity appeared.
TRING!

A string of a somber symphony echoed out at this moment as far in the distance, the visage of the Bard of Vitalis could be seen as he held his guitar lightly, other instruments manifesting around him as a heavy and sorrowful tune began to play!
As if what was going on concerned him and didn't concern him at the same time, the Bard sought to find a tune to fit this heavy mood.
Even if his existence was extinguished, at least he would have been playing a grand symphony to his last moments.
BOOM!

In another area, the body of an entity at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity changed as another Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity appeared, and such a scene continued to play out as multiple Entities who had attended the Existential Symposium...turned out to be Dikastes of Extremity lying dormant in disguise.
They all spread out in the surroundings and encircled the vast Aletheian Dream of Arcadia!
Amongst all the newly appearing ones, one with a distinct appearance reminiscent of Noah blared with might as it was...Larseus Corvin of the Legacy of Ignatius.

|You said to me that you love to see the expression of arrogance and narcissism the most on those like me. That I would come to grovel- kneeling at your feet as this expression turns into despair and shock. Do you still feel that same way, Little Rat? Do you feel an overabundance of control at this moment?|
The Dikastes who found him in the waters of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity taunted as its eyes radiated profound cruelty.

It wanted to continue as currently, over 20 Dikastes of Extremity surrounded the dreamy sandy gold domain as one who was surrounded by tendrils of powerful Vitalis Existential Extremity Authority weaved her intent.
|Enough.|
WAA!
Cavalier Reylyra of the Legacy of Al-Abalem spoke out grandly as her power robustly spread in the surroundings.
The serpentine eye on her chest locked onto Noah's figure as her intent fully focused on him.

|I'm holding everyone back right now to give you a chance. Your demeanor of calmness must mean we've possibly only located one of the caves you hide in, or it is simply false bravado. Whichever it is doesn't matter.|
WAA!

|I'll give you a chance right now- a chance for survival before things get really, really bad for you. Stand down, stop this senseless and unwinnable war you are trying to wage, and we will welcome you back into the folds of Vitalis.|

|All will be forgiven...after all, a Seed like you who can expand Existential Extremity Authorities by himself and escape us for this long is unique. Our Legacy can cleanse you of these corrupted authorities and add you to our folds. No war. No pain. No uncertainties.|

Her intent and words were shocking ones as when Steel, Curagulus, the Bard of Vitalis, Primogenitor of Flames, and the others who had made the choice to call out to the Weaver heard it- their expressions changed drastically!
The means of these Entities were so terrifying that they would go this far?
The eyes of Cavalier Reylyra of the Legacy of Al-Abalem blazed with grandness and majesty as her intent continued.

|However bad you think things can get from here on out, I will tell you that you cannot even imagine. Do not wait for what you cannot imagine. Relinquish this fantasy of control and join us...and you will be shown what Extremity truly is. You will be shown what is Above Extremity, and how to get there if you are special enough. And after that...only brilliance awaits you.|
Only brilliance waited.
Only majesty was waiting!
All eyes and Wills turned towards the most recent Honored One at this moment.
Against such words, against such a ticket to brilliance...this Entity smiled and replied.
{Your offer is enticing.}
{Sadly, I have an extreme aversion to bending the knee to others- to the point that even thinking about it repulses me.}
HUUM!
The eyes of the Extremity of Quintessence turned utterly cold as they shone with brilliance, his voice continuing to echo out!

{One by one, Legacies shall fall. White and black will come under the heel of the call....those words right there- you wait for those to come true, and then you can come before me again, Cavalier Reylyra of the Legacy of Al-Abalem.}
A heavy denial.
A shocking set of words!
Words that the moment they were uttered, Cavalier Reylyra blazed with brilliance as her intent echoed out.
|Kill them all.|

chapters.title: Chapter 2881 Treachery and Plots! II
paragraphs: Wait for those words to come true, and then you can come before me again, Cavalier Reylyra of the Legacy of Al-Abalem.
These were the words the Insurgent had spoken as he rebuffed their offer and retained his calm look!
Did he already see through them before they appeared within this space of Existence and Non-existence?
All of these were important questions, but they were all pushed aside the moment he called her by her name and identified her legacy!
He knew of her.
It meant he could read intents and weaving to a critical level at this moment.
He knew about their Legacy.
It meant he could pierce across protected weavings of Records and Existence to locate such information.
For just this, this Insurgent had to be located fully and be taken care of!
At this stage of reality, the flow of time was extremely unique and subjective.
Around the same time and even slightly before Cavalier Reylyra of the Legacy of Al-Abalem gave her command, while she was still talking to Noah with her intent...
Noah's own voice had been weaving out.
Towards the clones of his people that he purposefully brought behind him, their figures situated on the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia.

{I wanted you all to see and experience the power, oppression, and suffocation of our current enemies. Their power, and how undeniable it is. How they could take on the form of anyone and that without a discerning eye...you could make a grave mistake.}
These words flowed serenely into the minds of Henry, Barbatos, the Cimmerian Architect, Ishtar, and many others!

{Against these enemies, simply climbing the Gradations of Extremity will not be enough. The understanding of the weaving of Extremes, Records, and Existence itself...is what is allowing me to ever so rapidly bridge the gap in power and knowledge...}
Noah's intent was a mighty one as it flowed into the minds of his people while expressing many things.
The Cimmerian Architect closed her eyes as she felt this intent within her blood.
Within the Lineage now coursing through her, an intent told her that a portion of the blood of the Weaver of Extremity flowed through her.
That with it, what she could do held no limits.
She simply had to understand.
She simply had to learn how to be in tune with the weaving of Extremes, Existence, and Records themselves as after that...everything else would fall in line.

The moment Noah's intent finished weaving its ideals into his people, authority wrapped around all of them and caused them to instantly shuttle out of existence- and this was around the same time as when Cavalier Reylyra gave her command!
BOOOM!
Existential Extremity Authorities blared madly and with purpose.
They shot out towards all Entities from the Fifth to Seventh Gradations of Extremity as whenever the smiting tendrils of Vacuous and Vitalis passed, extinction would follow!
But...everything followed its course.

It just so happened that by the time Cavalier Reylyra gave her command, the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities within the depths of Existence of all Entities who had called out to the Weaver...were entirely burnt away.
So at this moment in time, they entered an even deeper state of Existence and Nonexistence as they began to disappear from the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia!
The only thing they faced...was the descent of the cataclysmic light of Vacuous and Vitalis that seemed to be hanging over their heads right before they disappeared.
Some who were too close to the Dikastes of Extremity even had a portion of their existence burn before a paradoxical light covered them entirely!
HUUM!
The light and blaring sound of a solemn symphony changed to a high paced one full of possibilities at this moment as an instant after...
It cut off as the Bard of Vitalis disappeared right before thick tendrils of Vitalis reached him.

Amidst the descent of the undeniable power of the Dikastes of Extremity, even the Primogenitor of Steel closed his eyes and sensed its intent fully while he disappeared- ensuring that he branded it in his mind and that he wouldn't forget it ever in his life!
WAP!

One by one, those who had made the choice to abandon Vitalis and Vacuous had such an authority burned out of their existence before they were funneled across records and existence towards a pristine location.

The Dikastes of Extremity seemed maddened to exert their will as Cavalier Reylyra herself moved, shocking power emanating from her as she instantly appeared above the visage of Curagulus who nearly had every ounce of Vitalis burned from his body and was about to be whisked away!

Sensing the shocking power above him, the past owner of the Veil of Arcadia bellowed out as the Extremity of Arcadia bloomed with a gorgeous white blue light- fearlessly shooting towards the unstoppable Dikastes of Extremity above as he sought to hold on a little bit longer before he was gone.

Yet the intent of his Extreme seemed like paper before the visage of Cavalier Reylyra as truly, the last vestiges of Vitalis had to be erased from him right at this moment while being whisked away like all others, or his records may truly be eradicated by a maddened Cavalier Reylyra!
{Weaver!}
He seemed to bellow out with the last vestige of his records towards the Weaver of Extremity as the sharp wings of Cavalier Reylyra were right above him, inches away when...!
Nothing occurred.
The wings of Cavalier Reylyra descending unto Curagulus halted an inch away as her serpentine eyes turned sour.
The struggling figure of Curagulus that held a gaze of somberness and pain turned his head unnaturally towards Noah as all emotion had faded from his face.
He smacked his lips with pity while a shocking intent weaved from him- from Curagulus himself!
|When did you find out, Little Insurgent?|

The over 20 Dikastes of Extremity came to line up behind Cavalier Reylyra and the visage of Curagulus as at this moment, they were the only entities remaining in this domain apart from the lone visage of Noah above the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia!

chapters.title: Chapter 2882 Treachery and Plots! III
paragraphs: One moment, the visage of Curagulus was struggling and waiting to be taken to the true home of the Weaver of Extremity just like all the others.
And then in the next moment when this didn't occur, his whole demeanor changed as currently, he floated next to the Dikastes of Extremity freely while gazing with coldness towards the visage of Noah!
When did he find out?
In the distance, the Weaver of Extremity had a cold smile as he voiced out.
{I found out the moment I first walked through the doors of the Arcadian High Hall. All those who were Dikastes hiding in other forms...including the shell of Curagulus.}
A shell of Curagulus!
The plots and means of the Dikastes of Extremity were terrifying as they left one of the most important figures in all this to maintain their form until the most important moment!
So long as they gained access to the lands and domains of the Insurgent before them, they could bring everything he had built down.
But even this...had failed.
HUUM!
The visage of Curagulus twisted as in its place, an oppressively powerful Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity appeared.
Seeing this scene caused the Weaver of Extremity to gaze with a sense of loss as he sighed, trying to pierce the veils of mystery to understand.
When was Curagulus truly Curagulus? The Dikastes taking his form...did such a thing mean they killed the original entity or was he locked off somewhere?
Such questions applied to all the forms of beings that the Dikastes of Extremity took for their disguise as at this moment, the answer was not entirely clear!

The Weaver looked at the mixture of Vitalis and Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity in front of him who gazed towards him with their terrifying serpentine eyes, each of them holding tendrils of his Existential Extremity Authorities within their wings as they held their own purpose.
He...also held his own purpose!
{How about it? You all are here, I am here. Why don't we have a bout and see if one side can hurt the other?}
The Weaver spoke nonchalantly as the Dikastes of Extremity continued to gaze at him coldly!

The intelligence of how the body of the Insurgent would disappear the moment they weaved their intent against him was now widespread amongst their forces, along with the fact that a minuscule shred of their authority would disappear thereafter.
They had to first understand his authorities and how to counter them before they proceeded forward, and anything else done at this moment would only be for the benefit of the Insurgent!
At the forefront, the visage of Cavalier Reylyra was cold as the pristine white of Vitalis flowed all around her, her intent weaving en masse.

|You are in a peculiar stage of existence right now where you may feel like you're making some difference, or that you're some Messiah who was capable of rising and doing something others couldn't. That the Seeds stretched out across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains are some pitiable things you have to save. What you don't understand, Insurgent, is truly how futile all of that is.|

|And let me be clear- this isn't me talking or rambling for the sake of it. Truly, you do not know the futility in all of this. There is not a path where you somehow come out on top. There isn't a weaving of existence and extremes that somehow allows you to bundle your way through. I will tell you now that your actions will cause a great deal of pain in the long term. Pain to you. Pain to those you love. Pain to the innumerable other Seeds out there. The end will not be a pretty one, nor will it be a victorious one if things continue to unfold like this.|
Her serpentine eyes radiated a profound light of power and wisdom as she spoke, her wings spanning behind her gorgeously while the other Dikastes of Extremity gazed on coldly!

|To be honest with you, I empathize with all the Seeds across the Vitalis and Vacuous Domains. My colleagues and I may seem apathetic and cruel when talking about you all...but I do understand your plight. And it is because I understand that I am letting you know...the past state of existence is the best possible form of existence to be living in. Before you elevated any concepts to the Existential level. Before all of this began. Right now, we are involved. But soon...those we report to will be more involved and lay down their commands. From your perspective, I assure you that they will seem more cruel than anything you can imagine.|

|We have lived with you all for eons as at least we have a form of attachment. They...will not even consider you all living things. The reality you will unleash upon yourself and others if you do not stop...even I fear it, Noah Osmont.|
HUUM!
They didn't call him a seed.
They didn't call him an Insurgent.
Cavalier Reylyra called him by his name as she seemed to be weaving an intent from the depths of her heart!
The Weaver gazed at her and read her intent.
Many thoughts and weavings danced within his Vermillion colored pupils as he shook his head while beginning to disappear.
{It is better to struggle and be free than to be chained for eons.}
WAA!
With these words, the Weaver of Extremity disappeared.
The only ones left behind in the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia were the Dikastes of Extremity as their intent bubbled silently.

Ferocious expressions appeared on all of their serpentine eyes moments later as massive circular rune circles of black and white appeared, swirling like cataclysmic disks that cut apart all surrounding reality- the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia being torn to nothingness within moments!
Thereafter, their figures began to disappear one after another silently- each taking a different path.
In the midst of swirling records of existence though, slivers of vermillion colored flames continued to shine as the Will of the Weaver of Extremity burned bright.
He had seen through their plays, so why had he followed along?
The answer was a simple one, and yet grand in its complexity.
But very simply...he wanted to answer a question.
The question being...just where exactly did the Dikastes of Extremity call home?

All those who were Dikastes hiding in other forms...including the shell of Curagulus.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2883 Al-Abalem! I
paragraphs: Home.
A domain where one returned to.
A domain one spent most of their lives in.
A domain where one felt safe and at peace- a refuge from anything and everything.
Every single entity had a home!
And the Weaver of Extremity...sought to intricately tie himself into the workings of the Dikastes of Extremity as he sought to answer the critical question of where their home was!
When it came to cause an effect- to any weavings of Existence, Records, and Extremes that pertained to him- his capabilities as the Weaver of Extremity allowed him to view and understand them.
It was how he found out about the Existential Symposium in the Existential Arcadian High Hall.
It was how he was able to peer through the veil of the Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity in the Haven of Anarchos!
And through this event, he had even further coiled himself around the Dikastes of Extremity.
His genuine waves of Tyranny and Infinity had wrapped around their bodies as in order to pull off their plot, they had allowed him to do so.

They allowed him to burn a portion of their Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority before they ultimately revealed themselves- and they went even further to collect his Existential Extremity Authorities on themselves!
His weavings mixed with theirs.
His existence touched theirs.
And after they extinguished the golden light of the Aletheian Dream of Arcadia...
{The weavings of your Extremes are being carried great distances across Records and Existence itself.}
A magnificent prompt rose before Noah's eyes.
His soul buzzed to continue reading into new and wondrous unfolding weavings as a part of his will sent its focus towards the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to gaze at its new entrants!
Across innumerable records.
Within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
The figures of the Dikastes of Extremity could be seen ascending upwards at an astonishing pace as their bodies were surrounded by the signature of a unique intent.

One burned with a transparent white light while the other burned with glorious darkness, each side holding Vitalis and Vacuous Dikastes as they climbed up side by side after making an exit from the paradoxical domain that was the past Aletheian Dream of Arcadia!
They seemed to be rising ever higher and with purpose as if they were following a roadmap- as if they could see the weavings of Records and Existence that others didn't have access to.
All of it...was still within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that encompassed both the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity.

At a certain point during their ascension, they seemed to enter an area of Records that held a division of black and white- a scene that only their eyes could see as when they arrived here, the two sides separated!
The visage of Cavalier Reylyra gazed towards the Blackhats in the distance as her intent weaved out.
|The choice to make will be one that both Legacies must agree to. Present all data we've collected to the Basileus of Ignatius, and we will do the same with the Basileus of Al-Abalem.|
Her intent was a serene one as it was met with affirmation before a blinding black light covered all the Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity.

A moment later, Cavalier Reylyra and the Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity ascended upwards a little bit more before their bodies released an Innate authority that...seemingly warped them across this region of Records in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and transported them towards even more complex and intricate records!

Their massive figures were moving rapidly as at this moment, the records around them had changed as one could see tendrils of white stretching out all around them as if they were pathways, and they flew across one pathway to another as all of these branching pathways seemed to be converging towards a single one.
HUUM!
When they reached a certain point, an endlessly vast runic magic circle blazing with plasmic white flames rotated above them seamlessly.
Normally, they would pass such a point easily as this time, their figures were forcefully brought to a halt.
It was for no other reason than what they carried with them today.

The plasmic white flames would turn anything below the Ninth Gradation to cinders just by proximity, but Cavalier Reylyra and the others seemed to be entirely too familiar with them as when these flames gather around the purple and blue tendrils of foreign Existential Extremity Authorities between their wings- their intents moved to communicate with these flames.
A moment passed as they seemed to receive some form of feedback before an instant later, their figures were no longer halted as they resumed their ascent!
All of this...was still within the confines of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.

They traversed great distances in a short period of time as the tendrils of white branching pathways converged and became bigger and bigger, to the point that they soon seemed to be traveling on only a single path as after some time, they came across another endlessly vast runic circle that swirled with indomitable might.
From this blazing white plasmic runic circle, a will seemed to descend and scan every single Dikastes of Extremity briefly before it also flashed and let them through.

At this point, the only thing ahead and in front of them was a singular grand white path that they followed, their figures continuing their ascent until they arrived below the third and final runic circle!
But this one...was wondrously solid.
Solid as if it were impassable.
On its surface, there were unique molds that seemed to match those of butterfly-like wings, along with the serpentine eyes at their very center.

The figures of Cavalier Reylyra and other Dikastes of Extremity turned around when they arrived before this massive white solid runic circle that stretched out endlessly, their figures moving backwards as their vibrant serpentine eyes on their wings opened ever wider while they came to perfectly match the molds of the wings on the solid surface behind them!

Their wings were then traced by a brilliant white light as if it were confirming multiple signals, and only after this was done...did their bodies begin to be pulled into the solid runic circle as they disappeared soon after.
When they reappeared again...they were in the beginnings of a glorious domain.
A domain...that one could call a home!

chapters.title: Chapter 2884 Al-Abalem! II
paragraphs: Every pore on the robust Physiology of the Dikastes of Extremity felt calm and peaceful as they stepped into this domain.
|Even minutes feel like eons when away from our Archaeos Vitalis Pylos...come, we must meet with the Existential Engineers.|
In this new space filled with hazy and serene white mist, Cavalier Reylyra seemingly bathed in its intent with contentment while speaking out and delving deeper in.
With the mist ever so gradually clearing, they rose above a white cloudy layer that seemed to stretch out in all directions.
In the surroundings, scintillating and extremely pure tendrils of Vitalis flowed serenely as every few miles, there seemed to be points of convergence of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
Where these points stood, one could see solidified Planalith Krystallos floating like fruits and radiating vibrant light.

There were hundreds of such points of convergence stretching out all around this region, with clusters of dozens of Planalith Krystallos around each one as the concentration of this authority alone was immense!
The earth continued to show a cluster of endless clouds as the skies...were even more unique!

The skies seemed to be burning with serene white flames that stretched out for light years, but in the far distance, these flames formed a curvature that folded inwards- creating the phenomenon and appearance of a massive hole in the center of the skies that white flames disappeared into from all around.

The figures of Cavalier Reylyra and the other Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity floated towards massive white gates that seemed connected from the cloudy earth below and all the way up to the flaming skies above, a sliver of such gates open as the bodies of 9 Dikastes of Extremity were standing powerfully in front of such a gateway!
With nods of recognition, Cavalier Reylyra and the others passed through as before them...lay utmost brilliance.
The Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
A home.
A grand construct that the Dikastes of Extremity considered a home, but it was more than just that!
This was the domain where the Legacy of Al-Abalem was housed.
Where Basileus of Al-Abalem stood strong!

Past the massive gateway, an intense white light covered everything as the eyes of any entities below the Ninth Gradation of Extremity may not be able to even observe anything, but one could distinctly observe the outline of circular floating structures that looked like buildings the size of Cosmos.

They floated with immensity and majesty as they held great variation in size, with the figures following Cavalier Reylyra going towards one of the more massive circular structures light years into the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.

With its exterior solid and shining with a milky white crystalline light, one could see the top of this structure radiating a beam of white light towards the flaming skies, with this building being open like a half moon as within it...the Titanic figure of two Entities that looked similar to the Dikastes of Extremity were facing each other!
They looked similar, but they were at least ten times larger and their bodies were wingless!

Their upper bodies were humanoid in nature as they still held a serpentine eye on the chest and head, with their lower being transitioning into tendrils of white Vitalis Extremity Authority that seemed to stretch down and connect to the structure and white clouds below.
Above their heads, tendrils of white light constantly surged out as they contributed to the massive white pillar of light shooting to the skies at the top of the structure they were in!
These...were Existential Engineers.

Between the two titanic Existential Engineers inside the circular structure, a singularity of blazing white light constantly spun with an exotic light as they seemed to be in the middle of something, but nobody unqualified would even begin to understand what they were doing!

Cavalier Reylyra and the other Dikastes arrived as she waved her hands to collect all the bundles of contained Foreign Existential Extremity Authorities while descending into the building when all of a sudden...her eyes and the eyes of the oncoming Dikastes managed to see under the hazy white brilliance all around, there were two figures much smaller in size than the Existential Engineers or even Dikastes of Extremity- and they were currently talking amongst each other while gazing at the circling singularity between the two massive Existential Engineers.

The moment that Cavalier Reylyra and the others saw these two beings, their bodies instantly sank to their knees right where they stood as with utter respect and reverence, they voiced out at the same time.
|We greet Basileus Anaine! We greet Basileus Urirr!|
Their wings bent down respectfully.
Their serpentine eyes gazed down in reverence!
Ahead of them, two entities turned towards their direction as they...were pristine in nature.
They seemed fully humanoid and far from the Physiologies of the Dikastes of Extremity, one being a male and the other being a female as silver white hair was adorned on their heads.
Each of them emanated tremendous beauty and honor, and no aura could be felt from their bodies as one would never be able to ascertain what Gradation of Extremity they were in!
This was because...they exceeded all established Gradations.

Unlike the Dikastes of Extremity who only held a single serpentine eye on their head, these two entities held a nose and a mouth with two bright eyes- the pupils within being the only similarity as they were serpentine in nature.

A smile slowly formed on the woman referred to as Basileus Anaine as she waved her hands towards the Dikastes of Extremity while looking curiously towards the bundle of Foreign Existential Extremity Authorities within her grasp.
|These are the sources of the Problem you all are handling below?|
As her intent weaved, Cavalier Reylyra and the other sank down even more while she replied!
|Yes, Basileus Anaine. Forgive our incompetence to resolve it quickly. We were bringing it to Engineer Xonial and Engineer Vathayu for more clarity on its standing and extent of authority.|
|Oh?| Basileus Anaine smiled at such words as she beckoned with her hands.
|Let me take a look at the Existential Extremity Authorities that have risen in our little Arboretum.|
WAA!
Existential Extremity Authorities meant to be observed and quantified by Existential Engineers.
At this moment in time, they fell into the hands of an Entity far, far above such beings in authority!
Into the hands of a Basileus of Al-Abalem!

As her intent weaved, Cavalier Reylyra and the other sank down even more while she replied!
|Yes, Basileus Anaine.
Forgive our incompetence to resolve it quickly.
We were bringing it to Engineer Xonial and Engineer Vathayu for more clarity on its standing and extent of authority.|
|Oh?| Basileus Anaine smiled at such words as she beckoned with her hands.
|Let me take a look at the Existential Extremity Authorities that have risen in our little Arboretum.|
WAA!
Existential Extremity Authorities meant to be observed and quantified by Existential Engineers.
At this moment in time, they fell into the hands of an Entity far, far above such beings in authority!
Into the hands of a Basileus of Al-Abalem!

chapters.title: Chapter 2885 Al-Abalem! III
paragraphs: Basileus.
In ancient texts, this was a word that stood for Kings or Emperors.
When the subjects of a King or an Emperor gave their respect, varying levels of reverence and respect could be felt from their existence.

At this moment in time, one could see utmost Reverence portrayed in the demeanor of the Dikastes of Extremity towards the two Basileus before them, with their figures remaining in kneeling positions and gazing down as Basileus Anaine took hold of the white bubble of light holding tendrils of purple and blue light!
Beside her, Basileus Urirr raised his brows with interest as the both of them were the same.
Not an ounce of an aura could be felt from them, and yet every move they made seemed unsurpassable as if a flicker of their hands could disintegrate swathes of extremes and existence!
At this moment, the visage of Basileus Anaine gazed at the bubble of light holding purple and blue tendrils of light as her eyes lit up.
|Interesting. They are still young and not fully developed, but they can hold some sway if elevated tremendously. This one is...|
Her hand mesmerizingly moved into the bubble of light as she came to touch the purple tendrils of authority within it.
|Tyranny, is it? And the other is even more ambitious, seeking to embody the very existence of Infinity.|
She spoke serenely while her hands twirled the Existential Extremity Authorities of Tyranny and Infinity!
Beside her, Basileus Urirr raised his brows as he spoke, turning his gaze towards the Dikastes of Extremity.
|If they are only at this level, how is this Seed not located and cleared out yet?|
His words were heavy as they caused the Dikastes of Extremity to further sink in their knees, Cavalier Reylyra bowing deeply as she replied with utmost Reverence!

|Forgive us, Basileus. The Insurgent seems to be extremely apt in the Weavings of Extremes, Records, and Existence. He seems to be hiding within the folds of the Annals of Extremity, likely in a state of existence and non-existence...|
|Oh?| The words were shocking ones as the white serpentine pupils of Basileus Anaine shone, with her intent continuing soon after.

|The cost to remain in a state of existence and non-existent constantly is extremely high, with any usage of Existential Extremity Authority towards that being so high that he shouldn't be able to do anything else but stay still. He needs to exceed the Gradations to possibly do something like that...and he hasn't yet. It seems...|
On the face of Basileus Anaine, a deep and wide smile formed as she gave off such pristine beauty that could even entice those on the Gradations of Extremity!
|It seems that this Insurgent has another secret. Something you all have yet to find out. Mmm...it almost wants to make me seek permission from Father to go down.|
WAA!
The word was a simple one.
Yet when Cavalier Reylyra and the others heard it, they shuddered in the depths of their existence!
This was because they knew and understood full well his unshakable authority.
In the Legacy of Al-Abalem, he was at the very top.
The Archon Basileus.
Archon Basileus Al-Abalem!
The Basileus Anaine and Basileus Urirr before them were the progeny of such an insurmountable existence!
The white pupils of Basileus Anaine curved into slits as she came to focus on the ball of light holding Tyranny and Infinity while her intent weaved.
|How is the spread of corruption of these Existential Authorities?|
The spread of corruption.
They were Existential Extremity Authorities, and yet they seemed to be getting the same treatment as if they were a disease or infection.
When it came to such a question, Cavalier Reylyra was quick to reply in a heavy tone.
|At the cost of trying to locate his abode, he came in contact with many of the Prime Vitalis and Vacuous Seeds. A majority have been corrupted or close to it.|
HUUM!

The instant these words were uttered, the surrounding reality buzzed and cracked as the lower halves of the over a dozen Dikastes of Extremity were instantly ground to dust, their serpentine eyes revealing pain that they sought to never show as their heads turned even lower!
The one who had done this was none other than Basileus Urirr as his eyes carried a chilling light.
|You let it get that far? What use is keeping you all to monitor the Arboretum if you see the spread of corruption and do nothing to stop it? What use are you to the great Legacy of Al-Abalem?|
The words were chilling as it felt like in the next most, all of the Dikastes of Extremity here would be extinguished!
But...
|Now now.| Basileus Anaine raised her hands as things calmed.
The lower halves of the Dikastes of Extremity began to heal.
A twinkling light of zeal and power crossed the gorgeous eyes of Basileus Anaine as she smiled towards the Dikastes of Extremity.

|When facing something that isn't so easily understood, these things can happen. Uprisings of Corrupted Seeds are not entirely too rare as over the eons, cases have risen in other lands too...no matter how much those distant neighboring lands try to hide it. Our Legacy has its hands entrenched in too many places as we know too much...|
Words with heavy implications left her mouth as she talked about Uprisings of Corrupted Seeds in other lands!

|Even with these uprisings, the result has always remained the same. No Corrupted Seed that had enacted its own Existential Extremity has been able to do anything, and nor will there ever lie a chance for it to do something under any Legacy. Not while Father controls...that.|
That.
When Basileus Anaine said this word and what she was referring to, a heavy sense of oppression seemed to descend all around as it represented too much power!
She didn't need to speak of what 'that' was. They all knew!
That which was controlled by the Archon Basileus.
That which guaranteed them Hegemony in the lands they were directed to govern and oversee!

chapters.title: Chapter 2886 Dungeon Break! I
paragraphs: The eyes of Basileus Anaine were shining with a fervent gaze as she mentioned 'that'!
Something that the Archon Basileus gained access to when their Legacy was given the reins to oversee these lands.
Something that was intricately connected to everything here, and yet sitting so far above it that under its control, no entity could deny its weaving.
Her pink lips trembled as she couldn't help but utter out...
|The Codex...|
HUUM!

The surrounding reality buzzed and trembled at the mere mention of such a word as the fervent light within the eyes of Basileus Anaine slowly dimmed, her pupils coming to focus on the reverential figures of Cavalier Reylyra and other Dikastes of Extremity as she continued.

|But since it is approaching this stage with multiple Prime Seeds being corrupted, it comes to a critical period where...'that' may need to take place. I don't favor it, nor do I wish for it to be utilized. It's bad for business...and we'll have to mingle with the Blackhats to all be in agreement. As Basileus, we can't easily descend so it is still up to you all. Continue to act against the Insurgent and see what other results unfold for now. As for his authorities...|
Her graceful figure focused on the tendrils of Tyranny and Infinity contained within the bubbles of light, her fingers coming to twirl around them once more.
Her intent weaved.
But this time, it didn't weave to anyone here.
It weaved towards the Foreign Existential Extremity Authorities before her!
|Hey, can you hear me?|
WAA!
|Do these Authorities still have any trace of your will? Can you still observe their weavings?|
She...was talking to the tendrils of Authorities as if she was waiting for an answer on the other side!
Seeing this scene, Basileus Urirr scoffed while shaking his head.
|It is an impossibility for any trace of a Seed to remain in this space. Why do this?|
An impossibility.
Basileus Anaine heard these words and smiled.
Across the weavings of Extremes, Records, and Existence...were there ever any absolute impossibilities?!

Basileus Anaine pushed the bubbles containing the tendrils of Tyranny and Infinity towards the two massive Existential Engineers around them as her intent circled around the concept of impossibilities.
|No matter. The Engineers will study them deeply and provide you all with countermeasures. I'll let Father know, so you all keep to your duties. Wake others from hibernation if necessary.|
|Yes, Basileus!| Cavalier Reylyra and the others spoke out reverentially as an instant later, the figures of both Basileus Anaine and Basileus Urirr disappeared as if they were never there!
Cavalier Reylyra breathed easy thereafter as she and the others rose, gazing towards the Existential Engineers that had already begun to work as they waited.
When the Existential Extremity Authorities of the Insurgent could be countered, what would he do then?
{The weavings of your authorities are traversing great distances into areas unexplored by those similar to you.}
Noah's vision was bright.

A hazy vermillion colored light covered all of his vision as it was taking a great deal of his power, but he continued to peer into the weavings of Records and Existence while the Dikastes of Extremity carried his Existential Extremity Authorities far, far deeper into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
{Your Authority as the Weaver of Extremity is becoming heavily expanded as you continue to peer into the intricate and unseen weavings of Existence and Records.}
He saw many things!
He saw the Dikastes of Extremity pass through a plasmic runic circle that scanned everything about them.
He saw them pass through another, and then arrive before a solid runic circle that seemed impenetrable to all others but then.

Every prior runic circle they crossed caused his vision to lessen more and more as there was very little he could see at this moment, but he was able to observe the Dikastes of Extremity turn around and fit their wings into molds of the endless circular wall before their existence was sucked into someplace else entirely.
And here....
{The gaze of the Weaver of Extremity has been obscured by an undeniable authority.}
His sight was stopped.
He couldn't see anything else thereafter as it seemed like the Dikastes of Extremity had entered a truly terrifying place!
But he had achieved what he wanted to achieve to an extent.
Grasping exactly where the home of these entities was located.
They couldn't find him, but he could them!
Now, the only question that remained...was how he could get close to such a location and even infiltrate it when there were so many layers of checks and restrictions.

The only method to pass the final check seemed to depend on becoming a Dikastes of Extremity himself, or morphing into such an entity to an extent that he would never be recognized as anything else but that.
He had to-
|Hey, C&n y@u he$r me?|
His existence buzzed as through the weavings connected to him, he heard a voice with garbled sets of words.
The voice was enough to make his gaze extremely stern and heavy as...from its weaving intent, no signature of the Gradations of Extremity lay within it!
It meant that very likely, it was an entity that had exceeded the Gradations of Extremity beginning to peer into him.
Coming to such a conclusion, Noah knew he had to hurry and keep on forging forward!

And at this moment, a critical moment of progression was coming as great change was about to bloom in one of his projects, and it was none other than his Existential Dungeon Apocalypse beginning to show its wonders!
Away from the gaze of the Weaver of Extremity.
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Inside the Dungeon Monolith where two entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity were sent in.
The Primogenitor of Dust had an ashen expression filled with disbelief as she gazed at the Primogenitor of the Sword who was in a similar predicament.
They...at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, were actually outmatched!

Above them stood the figures of Barbatos stroking the skull of a massive Abyssal Hyperversal Undead Entity pulsing with tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities, her tantalizing figure voicing out coldly and with majesty.
{If you and your people wish to be saved...call out to the Weaver of Extremity.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2887 Dungeon Break! II
paragraphs: It was an unimaginable feat even to her minutes ago.
But there she stood.
Her chest rose and fell as she looked over to Barbatos who used bony tendrils of her Abyssal Hyperversal Undead beasts to suppress the Primogenitor of Dust.

Even she gazed down at her own feet as a multicolored Xyston was pressing down on a massive white sword- yet another Entity that had fallen to their power as the waves of Tyranny from Sargon still blared wildly behind her!
Athena truly couldn't believe that all of this would be possible minutes ago but now, it was their current reality.
All due to a power that had awakened within the bloodline relating to the Weaver of Extremity.
All due to the fact that the power they received from the Extremity of Harems increased by a shocking fraction.
{Call out to the Weaver, and be quick about it too, otherwise the Dikastes of Extremity will soon be able to react.}

Athena was taken out of her thoughts as Barbatos' voice rang out again, a trace of vermillion colored light flashing within Athena as she saw a glance of the Weavings of the Extremity of the Sword and Dust.
They were filled with emotions of uncertainty and resignation, emotions of shame and weakness!
Could you imagine that? Entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity actually feeling a sense of weakness?
Athena marveled at the reality that had brought these Primogenitors to such a state as within a moment...
{O Weaver!}
Their Extremity Clones called out.
And a burning Vermillion colored light began to burn as both they, their main bodies, and their people who should have received their message should very soon disappear and join their ranks.
And by the time this occurred...
{You have successfully repulsed the last Defenders of this Existential Dungeon Monolith!}
The figures of the Avernus Clan Leaders didn't even need to be mentioned as they were defeated by stray attacks from Xiaomi's Ruin alone.
But they managed to defend the Dungeon against extremely powerful beings as for this...
{Multiple defenders have tried and failed to stop the spread of authority continued within this Existential Dungeon Monolith.}
{The Existential Dungeon will proceed towards the stage of a Dungeon Break!}
HUUM!
A buzzing of authority began to emanate all around as Athena couldn't help but smile.
It seemed like her man was about to do something crazy once more!
The domain they were in buzzed and shook as they became bathed in a pristine purple light.
Outside of the Existential Dungeon Monolith, the massive structure began to shake and blare with light- expanding and contracting like a balloon as it made it clear it would be exploding soon!
This feature was none other than a Dungeon Break!

After a sufficient time passed since the establishment of the Existential Dungeon, such a thing was a common occurrence as it would be hastened the more that defenders entered but did not manage to successfully clear any of the Invading forces within it.
And after subsequent failures, the Existential Dungeon within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains was ready!
But it wasn't the only one.
In the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains- within the burning white lands of Anarchos.
Inside the second established Existential Dungeon, the Extremity of Nepotism was fully displaying his power as a shocking advent of the Existential Hyperversal Embodiment of Tyranny displayed itself!

Unlike Sargon's, what Henry displayed was not entirely filled with a royal purple glow as at this moment, he stood atop a massive purple gold throne like a young emperor from ancient times- his subjects down below adorned in purple and golden robes as their features were defined.

Their bodies gave off a glow of realism as each one seemed to at least be on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity, and thousands of such illusory subjects kneeled towards their Emperor as they filled up the Raid Boss Throne Room!
Collectively surging off from them was an oppressive authority of tyranny that would force all enemies to pay their respects to the Tyrannical Emperor on the throne, and for any who resisted...

The subsequent reality was already expressed as the Prime Devourer, the Vacuous Entities at the Sixth and Seventh Gradations of Extremity that had entered this Dungeon...they could all be seen surrounded by hundreds of Ministers of Tyranny who forcefully grasped their bodies and were forcing them towards kneeling positions!
These Ministers of Tyranny gave off a devilish charm as they resembled a much older Henry, their bodies varying as they gave off auras at the Fifth or Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

They ensured the Tyrannical Will of the Emperor would be achieved as their bodies didn't just course through with Tyranny...with some of them adorned in blue robes simmering with Infinity and others adorned in golden robes shining with Destiny!
It was the result of a Dynamis of Extremity, but the result of the Extremity of Nepotism gaining the most profound effect of the Lineage of the Weaver of Extremity as the next in line.
The one with the purest Bloodline under the Weaver of Extremity!

He turned the simple Obsidian ranked skill, {Existential Hyperversal Embodiment}, into something so terrifying that even entities of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity were being forced to get on their knees under his grandeur.
In the distance, the Cimmerian Architect and Ishtar smacked their lips while Katelyn, Eowyn, and Tiamat rolled their eyes while gazing at each other.
They didn't even need to be here if the Son of Destiny was going to take the spotlight!
And as if he were trying to emulate his Father, Henry gazed coldly as the Vacuous Entities being forced to kneel down and spoke.
{We know you are not here of your own volition, so if you wish to be saved...call out to my Father. Call out to the Weaver of Extremity.}
HUUM!

He could see the flow far better than any others here as while he spoke, he forced the knees of the Prime Devourer to smack down as his body began to disintegrate, and he could see the weaving intents of the Vacuous Entities before him as they slowly got past their pride and shame to call out to a certain someone!

{Call out to the Weaver, and be quick about it too, otherwise the Dikastes of Extremity will soon be able to react.}

Athena was taken out of her thoughts as Barbatos' voice rang out again, a trace of vermillion colored light flashing within Athena as she saw a glance of the Weavings of the Extremity of the Sword and Dust.
They were filled with emotions of uncertainty and resignation, emotions of shame and weakness!
Could you imagine that?
Entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity actually feeling a sense of weakness?
Athena marveled at the reality that had brought these Primogenitors to such a state as within a moment...
{O Weaver!}
Their Extremity Clones called out.
And a burning Vermillion colored light began to burn as both they, their main bodies, and their people who should have received their message should very soon disappear and join their ranks.
And by the time this occurred...
{You have successfully repulsed the last Defenders of this Existential Dungeon Monolith!}
The figures of the Avernus Clan Leaders didn't even need to be mentioned as they were defeated by stray attacks from Xiaomi's Ruin alone.
But they managed to defend the Dungeon against extremely powerful beings as for this...
{Multiple defenders have tried and failed to stop the spread of authority continued within this Existential Dungeon Monolith.}
{The Existential Dungeon will proceed towards the stage of a Dungeon Break!}
HUUM!
A buzzing of authority began to emanate all around as Athena couldn't help but smile.
It seemed like her man was about to do something crazy once more!
The domain they were in buzzed and shook as they became bathed in a pristine purple light.
Outside of the Existential Dungeon Monolith, the massive structure began to shake and blare with light- expanding and contracting like a balloon as it made it clear it would be exploding soon!
This feature was none other than a Dungeon Break!

After a sufficient time passed since the establishment of the Existential Dungeon, such a thing was a common occurrence as it would be hastened the more that defenders entered but did not manage to successfully clear any of the Invading forces within it.
And after subsequent failures, the Existential Dungeon within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains was ready!
But it wasn't the only one.
In the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains- within the burning white lands of Anarchos.
Inside the second established Existential Dungeon, the Extremity of Nepotism was fully displaying his power as a shocking advent of the Existential Hyperversal Embodiment of Tyranny displayed itself!

Unlike Sargon's, what Henry displayed was not entirely filled with a royal purple glow as at this moment, he stood atop a massive purple gold throne like a young emperor from ancient times- his subjects down below adorned in purple and golden robes as their features were defined.

Their bodies gave off a glow of realism as each one seemed to at least be on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity, and thousands of such illusory subjects kneeled towards their Emperor as they filled up the Raid Boss Throne Room!
Collectively surging off from them was an oppressive authority of tyranny that would force all enemies to pay their respects to the Tyrannical Emperor on the throne, and for any who resisted...

The subsequent reality was already expressed as the Prime Devourer, the Vacuous Entities at the Sixth and Seventh Gradations of Extremity that had entered this Dungeon...they could all be seen surrounded by hundreds of Ministers of Tyranny who forcefully grasped their bodies and were forcing them towards kneeling positions!
These Ministers of Tyranny gave off a devilish charm as they resembled a much older Henry, their bodies varying as they gave off auras at the Fifth or Sixth Gradation of Extremity.

They ensured the Tyrannical Will of the Emperor would be achieved as their bodies didn't just course through with Tyranny...with some of them adorned in blue robes simmering with Infinity and others adorned in golden robes shining with Destiny!
It was the result of a Dynamis of Extremity, but the result of the Extremity of Nepotism gaining the most profound effect of the Lineage of the Weaver of Extremity as the next in line.
The one with the purest Bloodline under the Weaver of Extremity!

He turned the simple Obsidian ranked skill, {Existential Hyperversal Embodiment}, into something so terrifying that even entities of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity were being forced to get on their knees under his grandeur.
In the distance, the Cimmerian Architect and Ishtar smacked their lips while Katelyn, Eowyn, and Tiamat rolled their eyes while gazing at each other.
They didn't even need to be here if the Son of Destiny was going to take the spotlight!
And as if he were trying to emulate his Father, Henry gazed coldly as the Vacuous Entities being forced to kneel down and spoke.
{We know you are not here of your own volition, so if you wish to be saved...call out to my Father.
Call out to the Weaver of Extremity.}
HUUM!

He could see the flow far better than any others here as while he spoke, he forced the knees of the Prime Devourer to smack down as his body began to disintegrate, and he could see the weaving intents of the Vacuous Entities before him as they slowly got past their pride and shame to call out to a certain someone!

chapters.title: Chapter 2888 Dungeon Break! III
paragraphs: Henry's vision then twisted to show outside of the Dungeon Monolith that had begun to hum at this moment- at the Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity that his father had allowed him to see up close in the destroyed Aletheian Dream of Arcadia not too long ago.
{Let the first domino fall...}
The Extremity of Nepotism fully leaned into his power as within the Dungeon he was in...
{The Dungeon Break has been initiated!}

Tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities exploded out as a devouring light emerged and only increased! The serpentine eyes of the Dikastes of Extremity became sharp in the distance as first, the main bodies of the Entities they held hostage began to be wrapped in a paradoxical light of Existence and Non-existence, their intent moving instantly to crush them right then and there as different parts of the Existence of their hostages were destroyed before they disappeared.
Nonetheless...they disappeared.
And then, for the first time in History, the Dikastes of Extremity were shown a scene that would act as the trigger point for the many things to come.
They observed the cluster of Existential Extremity Authorities within the Monolith ahead of them twist and distort before in the next instant...
CRACK!
The massive cosmic sized Dungeon Monolith cracked...and an influx of Existential Extremity Authorities exploded out!
|Contain i-|
They moved to contain this spreading authority, but the moment it exploded out, it disappeared into the reality and records all around them.
It went on to achieve its purpose!
A purpose that was so extremely heavy and critical as with every Dungeon Break...the Records of Existence of a Hundredth of the Invaded Existential Hyperversal Domain would be taken!
The feature MacGuffin supported.
The feature meant to devour the enemy lands.
Noah watched it unfold at this moment with complexity.
His main body remained in the depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as not far from him, the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and Ruination shared his senses and watched it.
Truly, he was conflicted.
Objectively, he knew of his own power and concepts, and the fact that what he was doing was overpowered and obscene on all accounts.
And yet at the same time, he still felt weak.
It was a paradoxical existence because as the Weaver of Extremity, he knew both to be true!
Since he enacted this identity through the hands of the Protagonist, too many things had been changed about him.
He saw too many things now.
He saw countless possibilities!
Countless weavings.
He saw weavings of his glory and wonder, and he felt weavings of his deaths.
None of it was guaranteed.
Weavings of brilliance and Quintessence were there, but they weren't guaranteed.
Weavings of death and oblivion were there, but they weren't guaranteed!
All that existed...were possibilities.
Possibilities!
He felt it all as if his mind had gained immense clarity.
All of them were possible paths he began to see the minuscule weavings of, but he didn't know the exact steps he had to take to get there!
But he knew the coming paths wouldn't be easy.
He knew that it would be filled with adversity and pain!
When Cavalier Reylyra gave her proposal not too long ago, the weavings of her existence told him that she wasn't lying.

The Dikastes of Extremity were Entities that had not even fully exceeded the Gradations of Extremity, and yet Noah couldn't even touch them as of yet. There were those who were truly above Extremity that he had to plan how to counter and get past!
All of this had to be shouldered by him alone, with his people also generating tremendous aid with the utilization of his Existential Extremity Authorities.
No...what Cavalier Reylyra has said about the future to unfold was not wrong.

There would be a heavy price to pay for the path he was following...but the alternative was for him to give up. To bend the knee to others as his living and the living of his family and people would be under their whims and control.
And such a thing...
{The Extremity of Tyranny blazes with defiance.}
Such a thing wasn't just out of his nature, but it was something he would never do even if his existence wasn't filled with Tyranny!
HUUM!
Vermillion colored flames raged with abundance as the thoughts of the Weaver of Extremity moved.
The two Dungeon Monoliths he had released fractured as his authority spread around wildly within Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, and Noah felt it.
He felt the devouring lights of his Existential Extremity Authorities wrap around the Records of Existence itself of the many domains of Vacuous and Vitalis.
He then felt the massive purple Existential Dungeon Rift pulse and tremble as from it, multicolored chunks of Records began to be spat out as they flowed towards the surging Extremity Vein!
The multicolored chunks of Records were a hundredth of the Records of Existence of Vitalis, and a hundredth of Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!
Along with it, his Existential Extremity Authorities began to seethe as their weavings exploded upwards in authority and power.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself began to buzz as it began to be reinforced and expanded.
The Existential Dungeon Rift continued to spit out chunks of Records of Existence as Noah knew.
He knew that at this point in time, there was no turning back.
He understood that it wasn't so simple that he was devouring a hundredth of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
He knew this would encroach on the bottom line of the Dikastes of Extremity and their Masters.
He knew their reaction would be a swift and a heavy one.
What he needed to ensure...was that he was capable enough to defend against it while getting ready to use his expanded Authorities to cause the descent of even more Existential Dungeon Monoliths.
The weavings of change began to blow.
In the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, Cavalier Tseviax closed his serpentine eyes before they opened to release a flash of immeasurable rage a moment later.

And in even further distant lands, the eyes of Cavalier Reylyra flashed with incredulity as her senses portrayed something to her, her intent very quickly changing as she looked up to see the contained and controlled Existential Extremity Authorities within bubbles of light that the Existential Engineers were studying...exploded out with a Devouring light!

chapters.title: Chapter 2889 Dungeon Break! IV
paragraphs: They were docile and contained.
When it came to authority, they didn't truly have any edge over Vitalis currently swirling around them.
They held no will.
No trace of controlled weavings of the Insurgent.
But they erupted out with a power that didn't just rely on Existential Extremity Authorities- but one interlinked with Absolute Existential Restrictions!
This was how even though the Tendrils of Tyranny and Infinity were contained, they were still able to ignore the bountiful undeniable authorities around them and erupt to do something innately.
They seemed to simply be following a sense of intuition as they erupted out and surged into the surroundings of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.

Into the surroundings of the paradisiacal domain filled with a cloudy white earth and white burning skies- in a land filled with Dikastes of Extremity and even more terrifying Entities...the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem!
The tendrils of Tyranny and Infinity radiated a devouring light and took a tiny, insignificant, and a small bite of the domain around them!
Tiny.
Insignificant.
But what it represented...oh what it represented!

At this moment, Records of Existence of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos were siphoned off and taken across the bounds of existence and nonexistence, their implications and consequences being one that no side could have imagined.
And mind you...it wasn't just the Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity that tooth contained bubbles of light that held the light of Tyranny and Infinity.
There were also Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity who did the same thing.
It meant that the counterpart of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos...may very well be facing the same phenomenon!

Across the weavings of Records, Noah was accepting the inflow of incoming records of Existence and allowing everything to be filtered and flow into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- this massive construct of his transforming all incoming Records of Existence into a form that could be assimilated into it with ease.

And this emerging scene...was prevalent in the eyes of newly arriving entrants who had just stepped foot into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and saw the glorious Extremity Vein and multiple swirling Aletheian Havens around it.
Entities like the Primogenitor of Steel.
Entities like the Primogenitor of Flames, of Dust, and of the Sword.

Their grand welcome into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...was these existences who had reached such a great level of power to be shown the weaving of the results of the first Dungeon Break that devoured a hundredth of Vitalis, and a hundredth of Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
A Hundredth!
Of the Havens and domains that had been established for who knew how many eons!
This was a terrifying concept in itself as what Noah gained from it was utterly obscene- with the greatest benefactor being the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

It should have been just this boon, even though its implications were already so shocking. But then...the Records of Existence of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos and the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos began to come in.
Even Noah didn't expect it...nor did he plan for it.
His weaving began to dance as his Existential Extremity Authorities pulsed with fervor!
When the effects of the Dungeon Break devouring a hundredth of both Vacuous and Vitalis were enacted, it was randomized as pieces of the Havens within both Domains were taken chunks of.
That should have been it!
Noah didn't expect the Extremity Authorities he gave to the Dikastes of Extremity that they then took to their homes to be activated and erupt with a devouring light.
But because of this...
HUUM!
{The Weavings of Records deeply entrenched and hidden across existence are becoming prevalent to you.}
{The quality of Records is quintessential, with the authority of the Weaver devouring them all greedily!}
BOOOM!
Singularities of vermillion colored flames erupted around him like a storm.
Not too far from him, the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was too indisposed to even glance in his direction as she was managing the assimilation of the incoming Records of Existence.
After all...this was a hundredth of both Vitalis and Vacuous! It was tremendous!
And now with chunks of a Domain they should in no way have access to, things became obscene!
{The Weaver of Extremity looks his gaze upon domains entrenched in the depths of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.}
{The Weavings of the Domains of the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius unveil themselves before your eyes.}
{Your Authority as the Weaver is increasing at a rapid pace.}
{You are gradually leaving your stage of infancy.}

A tremendous inflow of information unfolded as apart from this, Noah felt his Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures exploded upwards in number, his Existential Extremity Authorities being elevated to an alarming degree while he was learning many things.
Amongst them was the identity of those above the Dikastes of Extremity.
Amongst them was the knowledge of just how terrifying his enemies were!
{The Masters of the Dikastes of Extremity that have walked upon the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos and the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos become prevalent to you.}
{You have caught a glimpse of the Basileus of Al-Abalem.}
{You have caught a glimpse of the Basileus of Ignatius.}
Noah's mind buzzed as from the small chunks of domains he devoured in lands he should have never accessed to, he was able to see the weavings of those who had stepped on them before.
Weavings of Entities so grand that they even caused a sense of suffocation for him.
Weavings of those who were truly Above Extremity!
Just their knowledge alone was enough to cause common beings to turn despondent and understand that they could never stand against such creatures!
Yet when Noah learned about them, he didn't have throngs of fear rising as even the sense of suffocation was quickly cast aside.
Because...
{One by one, Legacies shall fall....White and black will come under the heel of the call.}
Noah steeled his existence as he repeated the Prophecy.
The Prophecy that he as the Protagonist had enacted himself!
{The Weavings of the Extremity of the Protagonist are becoming even more profound in order to realize the reality of the features it has brought to fruition.}

Noah's body was suffused by a Vermillion colored light as thick tendrils of this authority wrapped around his body, one last prompt coming that caused a click to book within his existence as if...he had opened something he didn't have access to before.
{Your authority as the Weaver of Extremity has reached its first Metamorphosis.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2890 Unforgivable! I
paragraphs: 2890 Unforgivable! I
Quintessential clarity boomed in him.
What felt foreign and difficult to understand and do before became easy.
Quintessence. Tyranny. Infinity. Protagonist.
Their roots within him entrenched themselves ever deeper as what they stood for- their desires, their intent, their weaving...it grew ever more.

{Your authority as the Weaver of Extremity has risen to such an extent that in addition to being capable of grasping the weavings of Extremes, Records, and Existence, you can now begin to experience their weavings as if you were there.}
A prompt came down in a shocking fashion amidst all of this as Noah's authority was further expanded.
And as if to show him just to what extent, a part of his consciousness began to drift and go towards the weaving of a lost Record eons ago.
As if he would see a difference in what he could grasp back then, and what he could grasp now.
{The eyes of the Weaver of Extremity cross innumerable weavings to land in the lost and eradicated Record of Emperor Delbert.}

Noah's will followed the weavings of what Dikastes of Extremity sought to wipe out entirely as his gaze came to the balcony of a castle made of materials sufficient to make a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.
It shone with a crystalline blue and white glow as it floated above the Supernal Haven of Genesis, high in the skies as if it were overlooking other beings.

On this balcony was the visage of a man who held in his hands...a burning cyan colored flame- this flame moving about erratically as in his immediate surroundings, the authority of Vitalis was actually pushed away.
{What a wonder you are...Relativity...}
His voice was deep and full of power.
Noah seemed to be looking at him from above, but in the next moment...
SAA!
His figure sank down from above and actually flowed into the visage of Emperor Delbert.
An Emperor who unified the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains eons ago before he was eradicated by the Dikastes of Extremity!
Noah sank into his body as shockingly, when he opened his eyes again...
He gazed around not as himself.
Not as his normal self...but as Emperor Delbert.
He was Emperor Delbert. It wasn't a possession or an experience, he truly and succinctly felt that at this moment, he was truly this being!
{The Weaver of Extremity has unearthed and stepped into the past weaving of Existence of Emperor Delbert.}
{The Synchrony percentage is of Middle Tier.}
{The weavings of the life, memories, concepts, and extremes of Emperor Delbert become prevalent to you.}
Everything.
Everything this being had experienced and accomplished was flowing into Noah's will, along with the cyan colored flames he was playing with.
The Extremity of Relativity that under the hands of Emperor Delbert was about to achieve the Existential level!
Noah felt this extreme.
He had it himself and understood it deeply, but at this moment...he felt this Extreme as it was about to achieve the cusp of something great.
As it was about to attain the Existential level!
{The pathway of taking Relativity to the Existential level has been experienced by you before.}

{Weavings of this experience have been saved as at any point in time when the breadth of the existence of the Weaver of Extremity has been expanded to be capable of supporting another Existential Extremity Authority, Relativity can be taken to such a level.}
The differences in what he could do before and what he could do now became clear.
And the results were so utterly terrifying that before Noah could fully go through them...
|Why do you all have such an overabundance of greed? Even with the whole Vitalis Hyperversal Domains under you, you still seek for more and more...|
Noah felt the intent of a Dikastes of Extremity behind him.
The one who would reap the life and records of the past Emperor Delbert.
HUUM!
At this instant, the scene froze.
Only Noah's figure remained movable as while keeping the existence of Emperor Delbert, he turned around to gaze at the entity that had erased everything about him.
A Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity!
The wide spanning wings and the serpentine pupils were as clear as day, with their frozen authority just as menacing as always.
Noah found himself walking towards this terrifying entity in this frozen record as he studied its features closely, and he then came to wonder as he stopped in front of it.
Just like Emperor Delbert, could be...step into the weaving of this entity?
Could he...step into the existence of a Dikastes of Extremity?
They could feel it.
He hadn't just taken the Records of Existence of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains below, he had also taken a bite out of their holy lands.
Out of their Archaeos Vitalis Pylos!
This was why it was so much more unforgivable.
When had a Seed ever dared to do something like this?
When had a Corrupted Seed managed to not just attain corruption and deviate from their norms, but then go forward to eat up the Existential Extremity Authorities of the lands they were in?!
|Unforgivable!|
Cavalier Reylyra bellowed out.
A mere Corrupted Seed dared?
|An insect that boasted so much about Quintessence, only to keep it as a dead path and expand other things...actually dares?!|
Cavalier Reylyra was enraged.
She knew the history of Noah Osmont well and went through all available accounts from the eyes of other Seeds in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Within the Extremity Vein of Dissolution, he had called himself the True Emperor of Quintessence.
Within the Supernal Havens, he was the True Emperor of Quintessence!
And yet such a being couldn't even live up to this name, and he actually grew so bold as to do what he just did?
Not even in terms of being bold, just the capability to do this was an impossible thing!
Yet...
HUUM!
A moment later, the visage of Basileus Anaine and Basileus Urirr appeared above them.
But they weren't alone.
Dozens of other exquisitely adorned and majestic Entities emanating undeniable waves of power appeared beside them.
They came here as it was the center point of the explosion of the foreign Existential Extremity Authorities, and it was from this point that the surrounding records began to be devoured!
They ascertained what had occurred as their eyes quickly shifted from apathy to cold rage.
Only the eyes of Basileus Anaine were calm and calculating as a moment later, beside her, the figure of the enraged Basileus Urirr had his intent weaved out commandingly.
|Convene a meeting with the Blackhats. No more waiting and seeing or leaving it in the hands of you lot...we shall call forward 'that'|
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: Unforgivable! II & III
