One would be called insane if they really stated before that such an entity could even put up a fight against someone at the Eighth Gradation of Extremity.
But the Extremity of Quintessence was different.

He had in his accolades the capability of escaping from Dikastes of Extremity and being the first Honored One to actually expand not just one concept to the Existential level- but from what they could see, it was three!
Naturally, the guidelines regarding him were different.
Even now, potent waves of power at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity could be felt from him!
Seventh!
Even this was astounding enough, but there were dozens of Entities from the past Primogenitors here who were also at this level.
And there were a few terrifying auras like the Primogenitor of Steel who stood at the Eighth Gradation!
Would a unique entity such as the Extremity of Quintessence be able to catch up to the eons of work that these Primogenitors had put in?
The Bard of Vitalis watched on calmly as a guitar appeared in his hands, a low and unbothered melody beginning to play out.
Ishtar and Sargon watched on with sharp eyes as they wondered just how vast the difference would be.
The Cimmerian Architect, The Seer of Sima, Svetlana, The Daughter of Hatred, Ayame, Erikson, and many other prominent figures watched on with high expectations!
Meanwhile, the Extremity of Nepotism smiled.
They sought to measure his father.
They sought to understand him!
They would come to learn.
He could feel the burning within his roiling blood.
He could feel the intensity and Quintessence!
But when Noah actually replied...
[A display is not an issue.
But it would not be fair for me to take you on.]
Oh?
Noah sat on the mountain of Planalith Krystallos as he told the Primogenitor of Steel that it wouldn't be fair.
And before any guesses could be made as to why...
[It wouldn't be fair to let you face me alone, so how about you and all the past Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous come at me?]
BOOOM!
The eyes of the Primogenitors of Steel, Flame, Dust, Sword, Bones, Water, Life, and Death vibrated!
The remaining Primogenitors from Vacuous and Vitalis became stern at such words as there were a few hundred of them here!
Yet for the display of his Existential Extremity Authorities, he said he would face them all here!
He.
Against all the past Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Absent those who didn't call out to be Weaver of Extremity, of course.

But it was still a heavy moment as after acclimating to these words, Steel flashed a smile as his tan figure radiated a terrifying, rusty, silver glow, his white teeth clearly seen as he voiced out close to a bellow.
[Very well!
We face the threat of death and cessation above us...we may as well go wild, even if just a little!]
The Primogenitors gazed at each other.
An agreement was formed in their eyes.
They were all on the same boat currently, yes, but they held their pride.
For eons, they held their positions!
And today, they would defend their positions.
HUUM!
Waves of Existential Extremity Authority descended at this moment as space began to distort once more, the figures of all entities here disappearing an instant later as space was shifted once more.
The scene changed.
From the Alchemy Hall, space distorted across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the Extremity Vein blared with light at this moment.
When the wills of Primogenitors and the many Vassals of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven came to again, they found themselves in a grand domain.
Expanding out to be the size of multiple cosmos, there was a fiery Apollyon Aletheian Haven floating like a massive cosmic island, waterfalls of crimson gold essence falling off of it.
Around it, thrones floating with a tyrannical purple hue as there were tens of thousands in number, this whole area seeming like a grand arena as these thrones circled this floating Aletheian Haven!
On the throne that were for audiences, the figure of Henry, Emperor Penguin, Barbatos, Adelaide, Cimmerian Architect, and many others could be seen.
But they weren't alone.
Hyperion could be seen.
Enders of Extremity could be seen.
Extras also permeated in the surroundings.
The Record of Oppenheimer
The Record of Emperor Feng!
A dazzling array of all the important powerhouses were gathered here today as they all knew they came at a critical point of their existence!
And when all of these beings gazed at the whole landscape around them, they could see a distant Incandescent interior of a dazzling Extremity Vein.
It meant...that they were inside the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Auroras of dazzling authorities and Extremes swirled and flowed all around them as they seemed to be in a glorious ancient land built for battle.

Atop the floating Apollyon Aletheian Haven, Noah appeared above a trembling lava filled mountain as the Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains appeared on other regions of this landmass, their bodies beginning to brim with power.
Noah himself was adorned with a royal purple robe as Existential Extremity Authorities began to swirl around him, his voice succinct as it echoed out.

[If any one of you can manage to land even a tendril of your authority on my body, you can have your pick of hundreds of Middle Grade Planalith Krystallos of any Existential Extremity Authority, or any assortment of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity.]
Hundreds of Middle Grade Planalith Krystallos.
Each one could start an entity on the path of that extreme as the more they devoured, the more refined and powerful this authority became!
The further they could increase the breadth of their Existence, the higher they could climb across the Gradations of Extremity!
His words rang out resonantly as above this region, like glittering stars, thousands of Planalith Krystallos and Armaments of Extremity appeared.
They floated with glory and magnificence as on the seats of the audiences, the eyes of many Vassals burned brightly.
His words reverberated all around.
A sense of awe permeated the surroundings as a moment later, from the audience thrones floating around the Apollyon Aletheian Haven, multiple figures shot out.
Henry, the son of the Extremity of Quintessence, was at the forefront as from another area, the Daughter of Hatred could be seen shooting out towards the Arena.
Emperor Feng shone with a record of profound Destiny as he also shot out!
Hyperion, The Cimmerian Architect, Sargon, Ishtar, Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, and many more also followed!
Because the words of the Extremity of Quintessence were clear.
[If any one of you...]
He didn't specify or limit it to the Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous.
He laid out possibilities for all those here as on this day- the major powerhouses of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...all looked to challenge a single being.
They all looked to challenge the Extremity of Quintessence!

chapters.title: Chapter 2901 Acceleration I
paragraphs: Those who may not be familiar with Noah may make the assumption that maybe, just maybe...landing a mere tendril of authority on him would be achievable.

The Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains currently had a similar mindset where surely, with dozens of Entities at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, a few esteemed Extremities on the Eighth Gradation, and the remaining hundreds in the Sixth Gradation and below...multiple of them should be able to land a Tendril of authority on him!
Likely, he made these conditions to make it easy for them to gain access to the Planalith Krystallos and accelerate their inclusion into his Existential Extremity Authorities.
Likely.
Many of them were also cautious and thinking that for an Honored One like him, there actually might be a challenge here!
Then, there were those who had lived with Noah.
There was a group that didn't even move from their thrones.
Adelaide.
Barbatos, Athena, Katelyn, Eowyn...all the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven didn't even make a move.
Barbatos shook her head while pointing to the rush of entities below as her voice rang out only amongst them.
"Look at them trying to do the impossible..."
The impossible!
Through the Extremity of Harems, they received a portion of Noah's power across their existence.
So they knew a fraction about the strength he held.
And because they knew this, they didn't move a muscle.
"Besides, Little Fish has already secretly given me dozens of Middle Grade Planalith Krystallos... haha! Big Sis Adelaide, you got a similar amount, right?"
She turned her gaze towards Adelaide who towards her question...gave a mysterious smile.
The smile instantly caused the gaze of Barbatos to change as she asked with sharp eyes.
"Sis Adelaide...how many Planalith Krystallos did Little Fish give you?"

The other Queens raised their brows as they were now also interested since they had received Loot from Noah automatically, but they hadn't thought to compare and see just how differently it was compared to others!
Adelaide smiled brightly while replying, her blue hair waving serenely on her throne.
"Just enough, don't worry about these things, Sis Barbatos."
She didn't say the number as her words caused the competitive spirit of all those in the surroundings to rise!
Barbatos harrumphed as she turned to look back toward Noah's glorious visage.
She...was his favorite, right?

Her gaze went from him and into her own blessed chest and figure as she wondered. While the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were on their own field, there were also other entities who knew Noah very closely.
The Emperor Penguin. Kazuhiko. Even his own Son.
They knew his power.
But...they couldn't bring themselves to not even try as his words to include even them were intentional.
He wanted them to see the gap.
He wanted them to see just how far of a distance it was!
So they jumped into the fray as what they held in their hearts...was hope. Then, there were those like the Daughter of Hatred and Ayame. Those like Erikson.
They knew their own power. They knew that they would be nowhere close! But they had to try.
Out of desperation for even higher heights, they had to try!
They weren't alone as even the visage of the Seer of Sima moved, her voice barely discernible.
{Making these old bones put in the work...}
HUUM!
Blaring authorities erupted.
There were too many moving pieces as on the hellish battlefield of the Apollyon Aletheian Haven, some being should shine more than others.
From the Primogenitors, Steel's visage turned robust as all reality surrounding him began to take on a bronze glow.
In the far distance, the visage of Commander Feng- the visage of Emperor Feng could be seen as his body pulsed with tendrils of destiny!
After rushing into the arena of the Apollyon Aletheian Haven, threads of destiny flowed from him and into the minds of multiple Entities.
Hyperion heard his voice.
The Devilish Time Unveiler heard his voice. Sargon, Ishtar, and Elodie heard his voice.
Dozens of Enders of Extremity heard his voice!
{In the weaving of this impossible task, I have a plan.}
Even this astounding Commander knew it was an impossible task as he tried to weave together interminable waves of Destiny!
His intents weaved out and went to multiple beings.

And soon after, they melded into the background of the Arena as they didn't make the first move, allowing the chaos to unfold as the past Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains struck out.
And none were more brilliant than the Primogenitor of Steel at the Eighth Gradation of Extremity.
A rusty glow of silver steel was already spreading all around him as his own visage took a similar hue, and it had enlarged to a ridiculous extent while only growing larger.

Gradually...the rusty silver glow he emanated that altered the surrounding reality truly seemed to be turning the weavings of all nearby records under the banner of Steel, and tendrils of this Authority continued to spread outwards as this Entity uttered out.
{Living Armory.}
HUUM!
His enlarged body shone as dozens of Armaments of Extremity appeared around it.
Most were pristine and glorious looking Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity as the moment they appeared...they turned into streams of light that surged into his body!
As if they were rising with him.
As if they were becoming one.

Multiple Armaments of Extremity fused into his already mighty figure as his body alone had grown to be a hundred times larger than all others here, dazzling tendrils of Extremity Authority that truly represented steel distorting everything as in such a state...this Primogenitor let the intent of his extreme target the Extremity of Quintessence!
He was one of the more flashy and powerful ones.
But along with him, the extremes of all other Primogenitors also flowed to attack Noah.
Life.
Death.
Water.
Sword.
Dust....
Multiple different concepts flowed one after another as their intent and desire sought to make themselves stand out even against this Honored One they were targeting!

chapters.title: Chapter 2902 Acceleration II
paragraphs: An endless sea formed.
Innumerable waves of stellar ash and dust flowed.
And dazzling illusory sword Radiances littered the fiery flows of the Apollyon Aletheian Haven!
And yet the being that these extremes were targeting...gazed at all of this coldly.
For him, there was no future of a struggle or a suspenseful fight.
All he saw was utter and complete domination.
To display his Existential Extremity Authorities, they could only be displayed with complete dominance against all other extremes!
And so, without even moving a muscle, Noah gazed at the hundreds of powerful Entities in the Gradations of Extremity coming towards him as he uttered out coldly.
{Existential Hyperversal Embodiment.}
He cast the skill ushered forth by the Extremity of Skill Trees.
And the target of his Embodiment...caused a glorious colorless brilliance to flash from him.
It was none other than Quintessence.
The moment the three words were uttered, the space above flickered.

Below the Planalith Krystallos and Armaments of Extremity that littered the skies like stars, Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Authority gathered as in the next moment, an illusory pair of eyes manifested!

The eyes followed the curvature of an Infinity symbol as each one held nine rotating pupils, both of them radiating glory as it felt like the eyes of the Extremity of Quintessence had appeared far above the battlefield and were gazing at everything!
And the eyes blinked.
WAP!
A Colorless glow flashed and passed over everything in this Apollyon Aletheian Haven as a moment later....
{All the weavings of authorities that are not Quintessential shall henceforth be stopped.}
The glorious rusty glow of silver disappeared.
The visage of the Primogenitor of Steel began to shrink as his eyes trembled in shock and stupor!
Dazzling sword lights faded as an endlessly rising sea that sought to assert the Extremity of Water...was turned into nothingness!
A basic and simple manifestation of the shocking Extremity of Quintessence was laid out as under it, no authorities that weren't Quintessential could move.
Their very weavings were nullified as not just Steel, but all prominent Primogenitors that were rising against Noah at this moment found themselves unable to utilize any of their Extremes!
And if they couldn't exert their extremes...what could they do in battle?
This was a shocking and unbelievable reality as the gaze of stupor on Steel quickly changed, his visage bellowing out as he sought to express his extreme.
He was of the Eighth Gradation. His target was of the Seventh. Surely, he could at least express his extreme?!
HUUM!
A radiance flickered, and that was it.
A sense of silence and shock spread on the battlefield as a symphony began to play.
{This...is Quintessence.}
The voice of the Extremity of Quintessence thundered out as in the far distance, the Bard of Vitalis was playing a tune with a stern expression while approaching the distant Noah.

Apart from him and the shaken Primogenitors who were still trying to mobilize their authorities, the figures of Henry, Commander Feng, Hyperion, and many others...their bodies still vibrated with power as they held traces of Quintessence.
If not Quintessence, they held traces of Infinity or Tyranny as even within these concepts, Quintessence flowed!
So they could be expressed.

With a single move, Noah expressed shocking dominance against all the past Primogenitors of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains as only his people still held a chance- continuing to charge towards him as uniquely...Commander Feng and Henry were leading the charge as others followed behind them.
And the weaving of extremes around these two beings simmering with destiny was unique as they seemed to be collecting and stacking the extremes of those behind them!
They knew they couldn't beat Noah with their own authorities.
So at this point, they tried to take a different path.
They read the weavings of their extremes.
And with Commander Feng and Henry in the lead, they passed their authorities through them.
They intermixed and layered everything towards a single central point as shockingly, around Commander Feng, an illusory celestial purple mountain formed with him being at the very peak!

Droves of Existential Extremity Authority coursed from the base of the mountain and towards the peak as space split apart, with it seeming like a massive mountain was smashing towards the Extremity of Quintessence!
But this mountain wasn't alone as opposite it, with Henry in the lead, a dazzling celestial cerulean mountain also formed as burning with Infinity...the son of Destiny called out.
{Existential Hyperversal Embodiment}
Commander Feng called out.
{Existential Hyperversal Embodiment}
HUUM!
The single blue mountain spearheaded by Henry pulsed as a moment later, over ten other celestial mountains similar to it manifested.
Strain appeared in the eyes of Henry and those behind him as it was only after 36 dazzling blue mountains covered all regions of this side of the Arena did they stop multiplying!

And the purple mountain with Emperor Feng at the very peak...the amalgamation of a massive illusory purple-robed Emperor appeared behind it seated on a throne, his right hand grasping the base of the mountain as with an overabundance of Tyranny...he prepared to throw it.
At the same time, a dazzling glow of gold began to cover the illusory figure of the massive Emperor as Destiny was doing something behind the scenes!
It was all part of the contrived plan.
In the face of all of this, Noah gazed down coldly as he observed the weavings of unfolding authorities.
Plans.
They were crucial, yes.
But in the face of sheer, unadulterated power...what plans were nothing.
While embodying one Existential Extreme, Noah uttered out silently once more.
{Existential Hyperversal Embodiment}.
WAA!
The target this time...was none other than Infinity.
Noah's visage was already imposing enough.
His figure gave off an immense sense of suffocation.
Many on the lower rungs of Gradations couldn't even gaze into his eyes due to his glory!
And yet at this moment...
In the skies littered with Planalith Krystallos and Armaments of Extremity that hung like stars, a thousand more figures of Noah appeared.
Each one carrying the same momentum and power as the single figure from before!
And this wasn't all as with a gorgeous and unforgettable glow of blue, another thousand figures of Noah appeared.
And this number just continued to balloon upwards as it very soon exceeded 10,000, and it wasn't stopping!
The gaze of Commander Feng flickered.
The eyes of the Son of Destiny flashed!
And everything...came to a standstill!

chapters.title: Chapter 2903 Acceleration III
paragraphs: One after another.
Nonstop.
With auras just as oppressive as the first, more and more figures of Noah appeared!
Vermillion colored flames began to surge around each of them as their number quickly entered the tens of thousands.
And from them...
{This...is a semblance of Infinity.}
His voices rang out in unison.

Across the hellish arena, from tens of thousands of his bodies, his voice thundered out with interminable decibels as it caused the formed dazzling blue mountains and massive purple mountain to tremble!
The Primogenitors looked at this scene with shell shock as even at this moment, they couldn't mobilize any authority.
They couldn't mobilize any of their extremes!

And at this moment, they felt the burning auras of tens of thousands of bodies of the Honored One focus not just on the entities enclosed in mountains surging with Existential Extremity Authorities, but also towards them while were akin to sitting ducks with no extremes to protect them.
And his voice reverberated out again.

{I do it this was not to demoralize you or admonish your years' worth of work. I do this to express undeniably and quickly the grandeur of my Existential Extremity Authorities as with them... there lies a pathway to survival.}
Yes!
Noah chose to utilize Quintessence and disable all other authorities that weren't Quintessential not to make the Primogenitors seem like fools or discredit their terrifying power!
He wanted to make it known clearly and without contest.
He wanted to cement in their minds what his Existential Extremity Authorities truly were.
He wanted to let them know they didn't have the proper tools!
So long as Steel had any of the Existential Extremity Authorities under him, he would have a semblance of Quintessence.
He wouldn't be helpless under Noah's Embodiment as maybe then, he could express his power as an Entity at the Eighth Gradation of Extremity!
So they had to be shown.
Even his people...had to be shown.
From the tens of thousands of bodies stretched across this domain, the endless cerulean brilliance of Infinity flashed.
If it were coming just from his main body alone, its brightness would be astounding.
But it came from tens of thousands of directions as it formed into an inescapable sea of Existential Extremity Authority that cascaded down and crashed into everything!
The dazzling blue and purple illusory mountains.
The Entities that made them.
Henry and Commander Feng shook their heads with wry smiles as the mountains they weaved together the Existential Extremity Authorities of began to be crushed under the weight and slowly disappeared.
They had plans, yes.
But plans meant nothing when they were entirely outmatched!
The pervasive glow of blue remained across this space as the tens of thousands of figures of Noah emanating great Haki at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity all stared at the Entities around him.

{Quintessence, Infinity, or Tyranny are the three pathways for survival. Choose one and proceed on it, and the Planalith Krystallos will further accelerate your advancement. Since we are entering a critical threshold of our existence...Planalith Krystallos will be provided in abundance.}
Noah proclaimed.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven had already forged hundreds of thousands of Planalith Krystallos.
If not have his people utilize them at a time when their future was unknown and also dependent on how powerful his Existential Extremity Authorities became, what use would they have?
So...
The tens of thousands of figures of Noahs began to disappear one after another as golden prompts began to rise in front of all entities here.
{All Loot obtained in the Existential Dungeon Raid Rift will be increased by 10,000% for the foreseeable future.}
{A Middle Grade Existential Loot Cache will be granted to all inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven on the Gradations of Extremity.}

{A Single Middle Grade Existential Loot Cache contains two random pieces of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity, 100 Middle Grade Existential Planalith Krystallos matching one's path, and 1,000 Low Grade Existential Planalith Krystallos.}
The eyes of Noah's closest people opened wide.
Even though nobody came close to even landing a tendril of authority on him, he was actually already planning on being this generous!
And truly, he had to be!

At this moment in time, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was akin to a factory that had produced a large amount of Planalith Krystallos and was still doing so at a rapid pace, and the rate at which his people were able to obtain them from the Dungeon Raid Rift was far too low.
And with the heavy retaliation from Dikastes coming, they truly had to attain as much usage and strengthening of his Existential Extremity Authorities!
So dazzling multicolored treasure caches began to descend around all of those here as their eyes couldn't hide their joy.
Before the perplexed and dumbfounded figures of the Primogenitors, treasure caches also descended as they rationalized and accepted what had just occurred!

The Bard of Vitalis gazed at all of this from a distance as a melodious tune slowly built up around him, looking at the dazzling figure of Noah in the distance that had returned to one as with a thoughtful expression, this being spoke out.
{Quintessence...I shall traverse on the weavings of Quintessence.}
HUUM!
Nearby Primogenitor turned their eyes over.

From the space above the Bard of Vitalis, reality tore as vermillion gold Blood weaved out and came to wrap around his figure, a Colorless glow descending with it as the Treasure Cache in front of him opened its lid to show an array of Colorless Quintessence Planalith Krystallos!
The tune he played began to change ever so gradually as his existence accepted the lineage of the Weaver of Extremity.
As his Lineage accepted Quintessence!
HUUM!
The symphony he played gradually turned bombastic and victorious.
His monkey like visage bopped back and forth as his voice spread out amidst his rising Symphony.
{No longer will I be the Bard of Vitalis.}
Brilliance unfurled.
Heavy boomings echoed out with glory as he didn't even need to finish his words.
His lustrous white fur began to change and gained a vermillion glow, with his eyes simmering with a Colorless light as from his existence, Quintessence began to radiate.
It was the first appearance of the Bard...of Quintessence

chapters.title: Chapter 2904 Acceleration IV
paragraphs: Change.
It was something hard to accept, but the truly powerful entities were those who accepted change without too much rejection or regret.

After seeing the brutal and dominant power expressed by the Extremity of Quintessence where they were forced to observe a reality where they couldn't even express their extremes, the Bard of Quintessence became the first to accept change and pioneered the way forward.
Other Primogenitors watched this scene as the renowned visage of Steel who had forged uncountable legends...sighed before his own existence began to emanate an intent.
It was a silent one, but moments later, vermillion gold blood flowed above him and wrapped around his visage as along with it...a light of Quintessence bloomed.
Quintessence!
Steel simply followed the weaving of his existence and it less him to this as at this moment, he imagined something grand.
He was an architect.
He was someone who built Armaments of Extremity with his own two hands.
At this moment, he imagined for himself what he could do with the Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence.
He imagined what the production of Quintessential Armaments of Extremity would be!
So his pride and reservations were placed aside.

The pride and reservations of all Primogenitors would have to be placed aside if they wanted to move forward at this moment as akin to falling dominoes, one by one...they began to choose their Existential Extremity Authority.
Above this space, Noah floated grandly and looked at this scene as he felt the subtle changes that were coming as a result of all of this.

Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities were constantly being made powerful by these beings before him in the past, and now, he had brought the vast majority of them into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the refinement and strengthening of his own Existential Extremity Authorities...was about to reach another level.
He would now wait to see just what critical level they had to reach before the distant and unachievable dream of Fruits of Existence would actually come to fruition.
And the knowledge of exactly what wonders this fruit entailed to the point that it was made the central motivation of the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius who were overseeing these lands!
For this, the progression of power and refinement of Existential Extremity Authorities had to occur even faster.
And with the unfolding reality at this very moment...this pace would only accelerate!

At this moment of brilliance and wonder as many more entrants were truly branded inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, a prompt rose only to Noah's eyes that caused his eyes to shine with glory.
{A critical threshold has been reached after the assimilation of the obtained domains of Vitalis and Vacuous along with the inclusion of more Existences into the folds of Quintessence.}
{The possibility of forging High Grade Planalith Krystallos and High Grade Armaments of Extremity had opened.}
High Grade.
This level was opening up before Noah minutes after his entrance into the Gradations of Extremity.
Krystallos and Armaments that matched the latter Gradations of Extremity!
His Infinite Hyperversal Haven pioneered the way forward ceaselessly every construct connected to Noah worked speedily to ensure their survival.
None of them truly knew what was coming, but they could all feel a sense of urgency as they moved faster and faster!
Basileus Anaine stood atop paradisiacal clouds of white, rivers of Vitalis swirling around her as they seemed to be extremely active and agitated.
She twirled these tendrils of Existential Extremity Authority in her hands as her pupils contained uncountable thoughts!
The purity of this authority around her was unmatched across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and today, it held a sense of wildness as if it were affected by something.
Something...that was about to be put in motion at this very moment.
|Mmm...| Her gaze was a pondering one as she thought about everything.
There were a variety of ways to go about resetting Existential Domains.
One could spend a somewhat significant amount of Fruits of Existence to activate a Legion of Dikastes of Extremity, an even more costly option was the descent of Basileus themselves.
Both of these were good, but they held a hint of unpredictability as there have been instances where the weavings of the reason a reset was required in the first place remained.
So if one truly wanted to have a complete reset and uproot any so called corruption within the Existential Domains, a more costly but definitive option was carried out through the Codex of Extremity.
The governing construct of any Existential Domains!
Everything that occured within it was recorded within the Codex as the methodology of Mors Apokalypsis was utilized to definitively wipe out and reset everything within a domain.
Nothing would be left behind as that which was in Existence, that which was in Non-existence, and everything in between would be erased.
Nothing escaped the game of the Codex of Extremity.

'So, if your Existential Extremity Authorities somehow overcome this...if you are able to survive a cleansing at such a fundamental level...then we shall see of the opportunities opened up with this, Noah Osmont.'
The thoughts of Basileus Anaine were her own as at this moment...
HOONG!
A blaring sound reverberated from the center of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos as all streams of Vitalis Existential Extremity Authorities changed directions and converged towards a single point.
All massive cylindrical pillars of glorious white light released tendrils and changed directions.
At the very center of Archaeos Vitalis Pylos, a brief but oppressive illusory image of an ancient book flashed for an instant.

Basileus Anaine became stern at such a moment as she couldn't imagine what Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was facing as he initiated such a process, the resources he had taken from Archon Basileus Ignatius and his own being the key to starting all of this!
RUUUMBLE!
Archaeos Vitalis Pylos began to tremble and pulse all around.
The Dikastes of Extremity that weren't hibernating rose and gazed at the changes as they knew.
Basileus Anaine knew.
All of them knew that a significant change had been initiated that would forever alter the history of the Existential Domains they oversaw.
They all knew...that Mors Apokalypsis had began at this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 2905 Mors Apokalypsis! I
paragraphs: Mors Apokalypsis!
A process with a heavy cost, and it was done through something that very few even understood.
Under the authority of the Codex of Extremity, it was ushered forth as the moment this occurred, the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos and Archaeos Vacuous Pylos trembled.
The grandeur of the Codex of Extremity flashed over them briefly as the Basileus of Al-Abalem and Ignatius felt its undeniable glow.
The Dikastes of Extremity kneeled down respectfully under its light as what powered them- the Fruits of Existence...their authority was what powered up the very Codex of Extremity!
Thereafter...
SNAP!
The connection the Dikastes of Extremity felt to the weavings of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains was cut off.
Basileus Anaine raised her head in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos as her silver white hair glimmered with brilliance, confirming how she could no longer sense the weavings of anything below.
No surface of the Existential Domains below could be felt as if they didn't even exist.
They would only feel the lands below them again when 9 days were up- when everything was erased and started once more!
|Mmm...| Basileus Anaine closed her eyes while letting out a light sigh, thinking of what result would come out nine days from now as...
'Let me get a move on as well...'
She also began to move earnestly.
In the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos.

Roiling clouds of darkness filled the earth as obsidian flames of Vacuous Existential Authority painted the sky, serene paradisiacal lands stretching out into the distance with grasp rectangular structures seen rising gloriously.
In the vastness of this Archaeos Vacuous Pylos, Legions of Dikastes of Extremity were left hibernating as the Basileus of Ignatius reigned supreme!
At this moment of great change when the Mors Apokalypsis was initiated.
Within the roiling black clouds churning with nothingness, something unique could be seen at this moment.
Unseen and undiscovered by others, tendrils of blue light flashed as it seemed like mere lightning that crossed the surface of the roiling black clouds.
The last time these blue tendrils of light were seen was after the cleansing of all those with records connected to the most recent Honored One, and they weren't devoid of a will!
Whatever will was contained in these blue tendrils of light noticed the occurring change as...
{Things seem more obscured...can I move with a little bit more freedom now?}
A devilish will could be felt in these words as the moment they passed, the tendrils of light seemingly fused into the roiling black clouds and disappeared even deeper into Archaeos Vacuous Pylos.
At this same moment in time.
Within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
The Annals kept records of all things, but they could be manipulated, and records could be masked.
The weavings of Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity could be erased or altered.
Then, there was the Codex of Extremity.
Something not understood.
Something not truly known.
Within it, nothing within existence or non-existence could be manipulated or altered.
So when the Mors Apokalypsis was initiated with the Codex of Extremity...just how would this great reset be carried out?!
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Within the throngs of the Planar Palisades of Extremity where scattered Planes of Existence could be found outside the scope of the Seven Havens of Extremity.

The Desolate Mausoleum where Noah stemmed from was once anchored in such a vast emptiness before his entrance into the Seven Havens as far from where it stood in the past, in the depths of the Planar Palisades, there was a small Plane.
Within this Plane of Existence, clusters of Cosmos and universes serenely followed their own rotation. In a small world within one of the many universes in this Plane.
A family garbed in animal skin could be seen sitting around the campfire, the father holding a club in his hands as he told a story to three children and his partner.
A cave stood behind them where tools could be seen scattered, and a forest extended around them as sounds of animals could occasionally be heard.
It was a scene of serenity and happiness as everything seemed how it should be.
And yet in the next moment, a blinding white light shone above.
It was so out of place that the father raised his head to see something never observed before!
In the skies, a tear could be seen in space as from it, a low guttural snarl was heard first.

And then, as if Records were spilling into existence, a four legged shining with utmost brilliance stepped out of this tear in space, its body emanating intense waves of the purest Vitalis Existential Authority!

Beastial in nature, this creature on four limbs had a predatory visage as its head seemed reptilian in nature, two white eyes radiating coldness and apathy shining down as on its back, radiant white wings were outstretched.
Three sharp tails that seemed like malleable spears twisted behind it as the moment it appeared in this space, its gaze turned down and gazed at the family below.
The father grasped his club tightly to protect what he had to protect, seeing the apathetic glare of this beast as even though it seemed otherworldly, he held no fear.
And he spoke towards his children and partner behind him.
In shock, his partner grabbed their children and ran towards the forest as the father...
"OOOUUU!"
He bellowed out valiantly, smacking his club down before roaring towards the beast in the skies.
The beast gazed at this with cold apathy before it warped and appeared right in front of this man, the tails behind it dancing as one struck out sharply.
SAA!
Uniquely, the tail striking out came at a speed the man could actually follow, even though barely any traces of Mana were within his body, much less any weavings of Extremes.
And yet an attack by a beast bathed in Existential Extremity Authority...could actually be followed by him.
Why was this?
Why could an entity not even fully cognizant of utilizing Mana be capable of following the attack of a beast bathed in Existential Extremity Authority?!

A devilish will could be felt in these words as the moment they passed, the tendrils of light seemingly fused into the roiling black clouds and disappeared even deeper into Archaeos Vacuous Pylos.
At this same moment in time.
Within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
The Annals kept records of all things, but they could be manipulated, and records could be masked.
The weavings of Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity could be erased or altered.
Then, there was the Codex of Extremity.
Something not understood.
Something not truly known.
Within it, nothing within existence or non-existence could be manipulated or altered.
So when the Mors Apokalypsis was initiated with the Codex of Extremity...just how would this great reset be carried out?!
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Within the throngs of the Planar Palisades of Extremity where scattered Planes of Existence could be found outside the scope of the Seven Havens of Extremity.

The Desolate Mausoleum where Noah stemmed from was once anchored in such a vast emptiness before his entrance into the Seven Havens as far from where it stood in the past, in the depths of the Planar Palisades, there was a small Plane.
Within this Plane of Existence, clusters of Cosmos and universes serenely followed their own rotation.
In a small world within one of the many universes in this Plane.
A family garbed in animal skin could be seen sitting around the campfire, the father holding a club in his hands as he told a story to three children and his partner.
A cave stood behind them where tools could be seen scattered, and a forest extended around them as sounds of animals could occasionally be heard.
It was a scene of serenity and happiness as everything seemed how it should be.
And yet in the next moment, a blinding white light shone above.
It was so out of place that the father raised his head to see something never observed before!
In the skies, a tear could be seen in space as from it, a low guttural snarl was heard first.

And then, as if Records were spilling into existence, a four legged shining with utmost brilliance stepped out of this tear in space, its body emanating intense waves of the purest Vitalis Existential Authority!

Beastial in nature, this creature on four limbs had a predatory visage as its head seemed reptilian in nature, two white eyes radiating coldness and apathy shining down as on its back, radiant white wings were outstretched.
Three sharp tails that seemed like malleable spears twisted behind it as the moment it appeared in this space, its gaze turned down and gazed at the family below.
The father grasped his club tightly to protect what he had to protect, seeing the apathetic glare of this beast as even though it seemed otherworldly, he held no fear.
And he spoke towards his children and partner behind him.
In shock, his partner grabbed their children and ran towards the forest as the father...
"OOOUUU!"
He bellowed out valiantly, smacking his club down before roaring towards the beast in the skies.
The beast gazed at this with cold apathy before it warped and appeared right in front of this man, the tails behind it dancing as one struck out sharply.
SAA!
Uniquely, the tail striking out came at a speed the man could actually follow, even though barely any traces of Mana were within his body, much less any weavings of Extremes.
And yet an attack by a beast bathed in Existential Extremity Authority...could actually be followed by him.
Why was this?
Why could an entity not even fully cognizant of utilizing Mana be capable of following the attack of a beast bathed in Existential Extremity Authority?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2906 Mors Apokalypsis! II
paragraphs: Like a valiant warrior, the man veered his head to the side just in time to escape being skewered by the tail he could see the speed of, his club smashing towards the head of the beast in retaliation as...
SQUELCH!
His body came to a halt.
His club was pierced through by the other two sharp tails, his own vision being obscured in his attack as his head and chest were pierced through a moment after.
The light within his eyes dimmed.
Then, his body became engulfed in white flames as he gradually turned to dust, and even this dust was swallowed up by a raging wind!
Behind him in the cave, the beast spat out white flames as the tools and carvings here all began to burn and disappear.
Very soon, there was no sign of the man.
Not any sign of where he lived.
An empty cave.
The fire he and his family were sitting around was gone, and the lands looked untouched and unvisited by any living thing.
It was the start of the first day of Mors Apokalypsis.And on the first day, all Entities in the First Gradation of Extremity or below...will be wiped out from existence!
Their records. Their very being. Every. Single. Thing!
This was a glimpse within the Planar Palisades of Extremity.
Far from here, between the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.

A raging war was still unfolding as Emperor Shao watched out with a tired gaze, chaos currently unraveling as the more powerful Primogenitors in the Supernal Havens of Extremity were stating that something unfathomable had occurred moments ago.
And yet even before all of this could be verified and understood...
HOONG!

Their surroundings vibrated and trembled as both Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions raised their heads in shock to see tears in space, and from these tears...beast shining with heavy Existential Extremity Authorities of Vitalis and Vacuous stepped out.
Not one. Not one thousand.
Millions.

Bathed in Existential Extremity Authorities, millions of winged beasts shining white or black with three tails behind their backs appeared, their white eyes gazing coldly as they shot out faster than the speed of light towards any entities at the First Gradation of Extremity or Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
All those above the First Gradation of Extremity were ignored as a shocking new reality unfolded, nobody truly understanding what was going on!

The beast bathed in Vacuous Existential Authority surged like an apocalyptic tide towards the Vacuous Entities at the First Gradation and below, while those bathed in Vitalis Existential Authority surged towards Vitalis Entities.

Emperor Shao watched this scene with a stupor as near him, a Tier 1 Extremity quickly came under the attack of one of these beasts as this existence parried its blows, but the beast was obviously and very quickly gaining the upper hand as death seemed imminent.

What was unique was that even with the blinding Existential Extremity Authorities around this beast, the Tier 1 Extremity who didn't grasp any Existential Extremity Authority managed to follow and initially trade blows with it!

'A beast at the First Gradation?' The gaze of Emperor Shao was sharp at the deteriorating situation in the surroundings, his sword ringing and shooting out as he appeared above this beast and swung down.
SAA...BZZT!
The three tails of the beast shot out at speeds far faster than those at the First Gradation of Extremity should be capable of.
And...Emperor Shao's pupils changed as he found his sword was actually blocked.
Blocked by the beast who was having a fight against a Tier 1 Entity as this beast itself seemed to be at this level a moment ago!
Yet the moment that Emperor Shao moved against it...
BOOM!
Its aura erupted upwards.
Billowing Existential Extremity Authority raged around it as they formed into dazzling sword light that struck out against Emperor Shao like a storm!
BOOM!

The impact was heavy as Emperor Shao was smacked back, his figure only stabilizing a distance away as he turned to find the visage of the beast had 'calmed' after he was rebuffed, but its three tails had now pierced into the body of the shocked Tier 1 Entity as his body burst into white flames and began to disappear from existence.

Thereafter, the beast didn't even spare a glance towards Emperor Shao as it surged towards a group of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, its aura once more dwindling as at this moment, it seemed to match those at this level as it struck out and battled against them!

After the initial trading of one or two blows, it was very apparent that it had the upper hand as its three tails shot out, piercing the bodies of three Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as they began to burn into white flames.
It was an astounding scene.
And such a hellish scene was occurring all around as even at this moment, nobody knew what was truly going on!
Within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
In the gaps between existence and non-existence, a construct of interminable proportions was in a constant paradoxical flux.
A paradoxical flux of existence and non-existence!
But still...it existed within the confines of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. It even further existed under the undeniable authority of the Codex of Extremity!
At this moment.
Inside the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Noah's visage was gazing at the eruption of Existential Extremity Authorities all around him as the Primogenitors took in his lineage and concepts, his existence feeling the strengthening of his concepts in real time!
But at such a moment...
RUMBLE!
The surroundings trembled.
No, it wasn't the surroundings, but the very Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself!
Noah's gaze rapidly changed as the Will of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven communicated with him.
{Millions of foreign Lifeforms have surrounded the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!}
What was this?
His gaze was stern as his existence pulsed!
They couldn't have been located. It was an impossibility.
So what exactly had happened?!
BOOM!
Without notice to others, Noah's body exploded into a cluster of vermillion flames as the Weaver of Extremity moved in earnest.
His will covered the vast Infinite Hyperversal Haven through their connection.
His vision saw what lay outside of its barriers and boundaries.
He saw four legged beasts with wide spanning wings and three tails, their bodies burning with either Vacuous or Vitalis Existential Extremity Authorities!
Existential Extremity Authorities that were so pure- even purer than the Dikastes of Extremity!
And at this moment, their auras were mighty as they were drilling across the barriers of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Noah's existence blared.
{The Weaver of Extremity gazes upon the unidentifiable Lifeforms before it.}
{The Weaver of Extremity gazes upon the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts!}

chapters.title: Chapter 2907 Mors Apokalypsis! III
paragraphs: Existential Apokalypsis Beasts!
Their appearance was a heavy and tremendously dangerous thing as Noah's home should not be one that could be found.
Living in a paradoxical state of existence and nonexistence, it should not be capable of locating it!
The first thought one would have at a scene like this was that this was just the prelude, and droves of Dikastes of Extremity would follow.
Basileus of Al-Abalem and Ignatius would follow.
And then everything...would be gone.
This would be the first thought.
But Noah didn't let his thoughts run rampant as he focused.
This initial sense of doom passed as the Weaver of Extremity truly gazed at the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts that were drilling into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven at this moment!
{The Weaver of Extremity peels across layers of history as records.}
He became bathed in vermillion colored flames as his eyes closed, and everything before him...disappeared.
He saw whiteness.
He saw himself amidst this whiteness.
And then...he saw reality beginning to fill into this whiteness along with different versions of himself.
Different possibilities into Unrecorded versions of himself stepping into the future!
And he saw...an astonishing scene.
Of the possibilities of the weavings of Records and History in the near future...he saw no Dikastes of Extremity.
No Basileus of Al-Abalem or Ignatius!
Noah's will surged as he continued to read the Weavings of Existence all around him.
Of the unfolding Records echoing out here and of the extremes stretching out into the future.
And he was shocked to grasp a truth with his weaving that the gazes of Dikastes of Extremity and Basileus...were not present!
They would not be present for the foreseeable future!
But in their place...were these Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.
SHAA!
His eyes opened.
He gazed at the beasts with a profound light as after ascertaining the current state of affairs, he truly looked at them as their weavings were made clear before him!

{Existential Apokalypsis Beast}:: Of profound origins tracing back to the formation of the Existential Domains of Vitalis, the weavings of this existence are ushered forth by the Codex of Extremity. All of its weavings have a singular purpose- the completion of the Mors Apokalypsis that has been initiated through the Codex of Extremity. This Existential Apokalypsis beast is currently within the First Gradation of Extremity as its purpose is to completely erase any existences within the Existential Domains of Vitalis. After its purpose is achieved in the next day, it will be recalled as the Mors Apokalypsis continues to be carried out...
Droves of information came.
Each sentence from it was more important than the last as from the weavings he had unveiled, Noah learned many things!
Mors Apokalypsis.
The Codex of Extremity.
The purpose of these shocking beasts!
And it's current stage of power.
It stated 'currently' at the First Gradation of Extremity.
Why currently? And could it change later?

As he peeled the layers of secrecy, Noah's figure disappeared and actually moved outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, coming to the barrier and boundaries that these beasts were drilling through as he...
Came within meters of these terrible Existential Apokalypsis Beasts. And...they didn't react to him.
As if he didn't even exist, they continued their relentless advancement into the barriers of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as there were a few incongruencies with this.
First- no entity at the First Gradation of Extremity would be able to force their way into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
And yet these beasts were drilling across and almost halfway through, even though their power should be at the First Gradation!
At this very moment, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was pulsing as droves of Existential Extremity Authorities were being used to resist and stop the advancement of these beasts into it.
But it didn't seem possible.
Their entry seemed inevitable as they would get to complete their purpose!
{The Weaver of Extremity peels away falsehood and gazes at the truth of the current reality.}
Noah's existence flashed at such a moment as he came to appear in front of one of these millions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts, his hand swinging down.
BZZT!
And the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts in front of him reacted to his existence as the pure Existential Extremity Authority of Vitalis around it blared.
The aura it gave off instantly blared and emanated tremendous waves of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity as it exploded with tendrils of Vitalis towards Noah!
BOOM!

They were genuinely of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, and truly powerful ones at that as they were filled with Existential Extremity Authority, but against Noah...they weren't enough to even send him back an inch as his body dispersed the exploding authority, his eyes becoming stern.
He wasn't against his people or Primogenitors at this moment.
And against enemies, Noah was...brutal.
HOONG!
Tyranny blared forth within him and crashed towards this single Existential Apokalypsis Beasts in all directions.
Vermillion flames of Haki joined in as for the beast, it was as if all surrounding reality was compressing in all directions!
And once more, a terrifying aura at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity blared from it!
But against the power of none other than Noah who held four Existential Extremity Authorities...power of this level was nowhere near enough.
CRUNCH!

Within an instant, the glorious white scaled body of the four legged Existential Apokalypsis Beasts was crushed into a gory scene of white blood and bones, its majestic wings and tails nowhere to be seen as...
{The Extremity of Loot gazes at the new target.}
A blinding golden light washed over the remnants of the Beast.
Remains that held within them pulsing translucent tendrils of authority- especially within the organs of this beast!
And its records were rapidly eaten up.
Its weavings became even clearer to Noah.
His nine pupils dilated as prompts cascaded before him.
{The Extremity of Loot dances with profound joy at the highest quality of Records that have appeared before it.}
{The Extremes of Greed and Devouring surge and sink their jaws into the fray!}
{The Weavings of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts have fully unveiled themselves before you.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2908 Mors Apokalypsis! IV
paragraphs: Yes.
After destroying one, Noah was able to fully and without a doubt understand these creatures before him!
And what shocking process did they signify.
What shocking reality they were bringing forth!
All of it...was related to Mors Apokalypsis!
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 36 Fragments of the Endocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 41 Fragments of the Mesocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 51 Fragments of the Exocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 21 Fragments of the Seed of a Fruit of Existence!}
It's blood and bones.
It's very being.
Everything about it...was powered by nothing else than the Fruit of Existence.
In front of Noah, dazzling Loot showed itself as fragments of many pieces came together, their intent serene as when all required pieces were there....they would be capable of forming a single Fruit.

Their colors were currently dazzling with a golden translucent hue- especially the fragments of the seed as when the Seed, Endocarp, Mesocarp, and Exocarp came together...it seemed as if a cosmos was coming to fruition!

The number of fragments Noah had attained were extremely high as it was due to nothing else but his Extremity of Loot, where if other beings managed to kill off these beasts...they may only be capable of pulling your a few fragments of the Endocarp or Mesocarp of the Fruit of Existence from these Beasts.
As for the true quantity needed before a Fruit of Existence could be formed?
This information could now be seen from the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.

{Existential Apokalypsis Beasts}::...with its Weavings being powered by traces of the Fruits of Existence, the power and capabilities expressed by this creature can vary to a wide degree. Its purpose on the First Day of Mors Apokalypsis is to erase any entities at the First Gradation and below. As with any absolute goal, restrictions come into place as to erase any Existence, it has to match its current stage of Life Form. If it is attacked by a force exceeding its current Gradation, its existence will utilize more authority from the residues of the Fruit of Existence powering it up to match the stage of the equivalent opposing force, taking it out as an obstacle before proceeding back to its true purpose. The Extremity of Loot has managed to destroy one Apokalypsis Beast and heavily magnify the Records from it, obtaining exceedingly impossible numbers and qualities of products as from it, the fragment of the Seed, Endocarp, Mesocarp, and Exocarp that make up a Fruit of Existence have been obtained. Collecting 100,000 Fragments is enough to allow for the formation of a single Fruit of Existence. The defeat of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts by any others who don't have the Extreme of Loot being utilized at a fundamental level will result in extremely poor procurement of the number of Loot in comparison to the Extremity of Loot...

But more than this was the information Noah had unearthed again.
The First Day of the Mors Apokalypsis.
It was meant to erase all entities at the First Gradation of Extremity and below- and it would match their stage of power as they would only be killed when they weren't up to par!

Which Apex Aeonic Lifeforms would be up to par?

Which entity that was merely a normal human being that an Existential Apokalypsis Beast matched the specs of...be up to par when its whole body was still bathed in and utilizing Existential Extremity Authority?
So undoubtedly, all life would truly perish!
Since even if something more powerful intervened, it would be pushed away as an Apokalypsis Beast would erupt to match that stage of power!
And such a ridiculous reality...was made possible by the Fruit of Existence.
It allowed the beast it powered up to be capable of being in the First Gradation of Extremity, and yet it could raise its power to the Seventh Gradation of Noah's just because Noah attacked it.
What other terrifying things was the Fruit of Existence capable of granting?
And even more than this was the truth that Noah had unveiled in this matter.
The retaliation of the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius for what he had done.

Apocalypse.
A complete wipe out of everything.
Today...the next 24 hours...was the wipeout of all those in the First Gradation and below.
The next day would likely be the extinction of all those in the Second Gradation of Extremity.
And this would continue in the days to come until all life within the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains was wiped out.
Everything in existence and non-existence.
This...was the response of the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius.
This...was the consequence of Noah's actions by not bending the knee.
By not conceding and falling in line like eons of others behind him.
His gaze was heavy.
His figure burned with vermillion flames of brilliance as at this moment, surrounded by Existential Apokalypsis Beasts all around, he seemed so...alone.
Had he not expanded Quintessence and Infinity to the Existential level, none of this would have occurred.

Had he not rebelled against the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius overseeing the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, they would not have initiated Mors Apokalypsis that would cause the genocide of countless quintillions!
All life.
All traces of weavings of any of their records and existence.
All of these thoughts and weavings settled in Noah as his figure...seemed so extremely desolate.
A heavy and inescapable weight settled on him as for any others, it would have instantly crushed them.
But he stood alone as in the next moment, he disappeared.
He fluttered across existence and non-existence as he traversed the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
He stepped into Vitalis as in the next instant, his main body appeared within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
He saw a floating Archipelago, grand in stature.
Under his gaze, time seemed to be frozen as he saw tens of thousands of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts rushing down.
Smilodons and Dragonflies roared out defiantly as there were many that had already burst into white flames, their existence being erased at this very moment.
No doubt, scenes like this were occurring across existence.
Across Vitalis and Vacuous, countless entities were undergoing an apocalyptic genocide as all of this fell under his shoulders!
Other people initiated this Mors Apokalypsis, yes.
They decided to wipe out all things, yes.
His decision was also at the crux of it. His decision led everything here.
And as he bore the weight of his actions, utmost desolation surrounded him as...
RUUUMBLE!
A pressure unlike anything he had ever released before began to rise with him.
Purple, radiant waves of Tyranny unfurled.
He would bear the weight of his actions.
Yes, his actions brought things here, but the alternative was to continue eons of oppression and silent, but small scale genocides.
Genocides of powerful existences seeking a way past Vitalis and Vacuous.

The Alternative was to continue living in lands where the Legacies overseeing them considered them as insects- as Seeds to continue powering up their Existential Extremity Authorities as they collected Fruits of Existence!
{The Extremity of Tyranny stands firmly in defiance.}
{The Extremity of Quintessence states that it is time to run wild.}
The pressure and might he emanated became so utterly obscene as he uttered out.
"Existential Hyperversal Embodiment."
It was silent.
But it was like a thundering call across all of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
Freely and with wanton abandon, the Existential Extremity Authority of Tyranny began to spread wildly, its goal being to cover all of this Haven.
He would bear the weight of his actions.
And he would ensure that those who had initiated it...would face something far worse than Apocalypse!
BOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2909 Mors Apokalypsis! V
paragraphs: Selfish.
This was something Noah understood about himself long ago.
To succeed in life, one had to be selfish of their own interests, of their family, and of what they wished to accomplish!
But in existence, nobody was alone.

One being's goals and selfishness could always impact others, and as the Weaver of Extremity, Noah was now particularly in tune with the Weavings of Extremes, Existence, and Records of all those connected by him.
All those impacted by him.
And at this moment, he felt it all.
He felt weavings of the immeasurable pain and death spreading out across existence as he was, in part, responsible!
And due to this...
BOOOM!
He let loose.
Tyranny ran wild as the first time Noah cast the embodiment of tyranny, it didn't expand to target or enclose a small domain.
Waves and tendrils of the Existential Extremity Authority of Tyranny began spreading out to cover all of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!
Below Noah, a massive purple throne materialized as he sat on it grandly, the throne creaking from the weight he bore.
Of the tendrils of Tyranny spreading out, illusory manifestations of Vassals bowing towards his direction appeared en masse.
At such a time, two intents boomed from Noah.
One was filled with a burst of vermillion Haki and reverberated across the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
The other was contained in the wildly spreading waves of Tyranny as it was targeted towards the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts!
{Come!} {Kneel!}
Simultaneously.
Booming out at the same time.
The {Come} was directed towards all Entities within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution as Noah didn't even ask them to call out to him.
He didn't even ask for them to call out to the Weaver of Extremity as he could feel their desperation and shock at the blooming apocalypse.
And his power...was enough that he could easily and forcefully teleport any Entity below the Seventh Gradation of Extremity!
There was no time for them to call out to him.

So he simply called them as with him at the very center, vermillion colored flames wrapped around every entity in the surroundings- these flames jumping madly to stretch out towards all of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!
And at the same time, he told others to kneel.
He told the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts to kneel like the countless Illusory figures kneeling towards him in the skies of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.

The beasts simmering in white Existential Extremity Authority of Vitalis of course did not follow such a command, their three tails buzzing along with their Aurora of wings as they erupted with authority at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity!
But this...was the Seventh Gradation of Extremity.
What was it to Noah?
Milliseconds after he achieved Extremity, he was already contending with those in the Fifth Gradation.
And now?
{KNEEL!}

The moment that the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts resisted his command, the illusory figures of Vassals kneeling across the Supernal Haven of Dissolution gazed down with fury as waves of Tyranny formed above...and began surging down like an endless purple sea.
The skies trembled.
The floating Archipelagos shook.
Seething waves of Dissolution froze and tumbled as an undeniable pressure descended on the tens of thousands of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts in front of the Archipelago before him.
And the hundreds of thousands of other Existential Apokalypsis Beasts in other Archipelagos stretching out towards the horizons of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!
Their numbers...exceeded a few million.
And the pressure of tyranny.
The pressure to kneel.
The forge of oppression emanating from Noah...he had it going down this entire Haven.
He had it pressing down on all of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts as in sequence.
One by one.
Their four limbs began to buckle from the wild pressure of tyranny.
Their heads began to bow while their tails turned down!
Their ferocious glimmers shine with defiance, but the power pressing down on them was too mighty as their heads bowed one by one!
And the moment they did so...
CRACK!
Their bodies began to crack and be ground down as if a singularity had formed at the core of their existence.
And in the span of a millisecond...
CRUNCH!
A heavy sound reverberated across the Supernal Haven of Dissolution as every single Existential Apokalypsis Beasts was pressed down and faced with a bellow of Extinction!
They came to reign down apocalypse, and yet they faced their own moments later!
{The Extremity of Apocalypse dances to a somber tune of glory.}
{The Extremity of Loot surges over a whole Haven!}
Atop every dying Existential Apokalypsis Beast.
The golden light of Loot flashed.
The maddening light of Apocalypse observed.
And Quintessence began to run wild as...
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 44,637,880 Fragments of the Endocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 41,185,350 Fragments of the Mesocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 40,284,335 Fragments of the Exocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 28,759,775 Fragments of the Seed of a Fruit of Existence!}
Millions of blinding particles of radiance unfurled.
A single Existential Apokalypsis Beasts had given him 20 or 30 fragments when he first killed.
Now, he killed approximately 3 million as the Loot ridiculously jumped to fragments of millions of Endocarps, Mesocarps, Exocarps, and Seeds of the Fruit of Existence!
And all he needed...were 100,000 Fragments of each to form a Fruit of Existence.
It was a tremendous achievement.
But even as it occurred, Noah was nowhere close to done as from his main body, a glimmer of Infinity shone.
And thousands of clones unfurled from his single figure in an instant.
And each of these clones...became bathed with a vermillion light as they disappeared into the folds of space and records.
Their destinations were the remaining Supernal Havens.
Their destinations were the Nether Havens of Genesis, Penumbra, Oceanus, Elera, Andromeda, Dissolution, and Helios!
Their destinations were the Planar Palisades.
Their destinations were infoldings of Records within Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity where any Existences were hidden in!
