chapters.title: Chapter 2910 Mors Apokalypsis! VI
paragraphs: It was the Weaver of Extremity spreading himself out across Existence and Non-existence.
It would no doubt be something utterly fantastical as the cost for Noah to do all of this...was obscenely immense.
And so his main body grasped his chest.
And he felt the beat of his Heart.
THUMP!
Like an ancient drum that was truly only waking up now {O Mana...}
Noah called out as his main body began to be covered by an astounding blue and vermillion radiance on top of the royal purple light.
His endless swathes of Mana danced madly and churned.
It seemed like an endless cerulean sea was rising within him and just now beginning to spread out.
{O Mana...}
Noah called out again as in addition to all of this, an Aurum glow came and surged all around.
The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist shone with radiance as the actions being carried out now and what Noah was about to continue doing...
Who else other than the Main Character could do this? Who else other than the Protagonist?
{O Mana...O Infinity...}
HUUM!
{Run wild and free.}
The weavings of his extremes shuddered.
Their desires rose.
And they saw they were given free rein without any limitations.
And so...
BOOOM!
Utterly unfathomable brilliance unfolded!
From the skies of Dissolution, tears in space occurred as two illusory Dungeon Monoliths descended in different corners of this Supernal Haven.
It was just the beginning of Noah letting loose.
It was just the first day of the Mors Apokalypsis, and yet the changes that would occur on this single day would be utterly consequential and irreversible ones!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
HOOONG!
A blaring sound boomed out that alerted all those within it, prompts beginning to rise before them.
{The Ones Above Extremity have chosen the path of Extinction of all beings.}
Such an astonishing prompt arose as the Son of Destiny gazed upwards with a somber expression.
The Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were stern as they also gazed up!
The Primogenitor of Steel opened his eyes as a Colorless light flashed through them, Quintessence buzzing around his existence as he glared upwards.
The Bard of Quintessence has bright eyes as a grand symphony had begun to play from his weaving, his whole existence lost in it.

The Cimmerian Architect felt the subtle changes along all others as the prompts continued to descend before them while the faraway vision of the boundary of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven being penetrated became clear to all!
{The gazes of the Dikastes of Extremity and the Ones Above Extremity are obscured as they cannot move.}
{In exchange, a process to erase all existences was initiated- with the tools of this process known as Mors Apokalypsis being these Existential Apokalypsis Beasts!}

{Today marks the First Day of Mors Apokalypsis, with the target of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts being all those in the First Gradation of Extremity and below. Attacking any Apokalypsis Beasts will cause their existence to erupt with power equivalent to your Realm, with victory or defeat dependent on the breadth of your Extremes and existence.}
The weavings of secrets that would have taken countless lives to be lost before they were learned...were made clear to them by the Weaver of Extremity.
He had seen through the secrets of exactly what was occurring as he guided those below him, his words reverberating across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
{The Extremity of Quintessence issues an Existential Quest of Survival for all those deemed capable of standing against the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.}

{Defend your home. Defend those at the First Gradation and below. Immeasurable rewards, glory, and loot await on the other side depending on how many Existential Apokalypsis Beasts you manage to kill.}
The Extremity of Loot imposed itself on the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven while Noah issued such daring prompts.
The very extreme of Loot flowed within Noah's Lineage as it was budding like a silent flower within the bodies of all of his chosen Vassals.
So long as they managed to kill an Existential Apokalypsis Beast, Noah's light of Loot would shine as the maximum possible Loot would be attained.

And at this moment, a great deal of Noah's people were chosen as ones capable of standing against the Apokalypsis Beasts once they attacked them, their bodies became burdened with a great purpose as space twisted around them before they were sent towards different areas of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
The buzzing Infinite Hyperversal Haven was spending a great deal of authority to continue keeping the drilling Apokalypsis Beasts at bay as at this moment...
{Let them through.}
The words of the Weaver of Extremity echoed out.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven began to stabilize.
And across its barriers and boundaries, a few massive cylindrical pathways formed as they opened up the defenses widely.

The Apokalypsis Beasts only had a single purpose as those nearby these formed Passages surged across them speedily, while those in the distance...changed their route to also come through the wide open defenses.
The path of least resistance was followed by these killing machines as they surged in seeking to accomplish their purpose!
So across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, it seemed like abyssal pathways from above had opened as from them, tens of thousands of Apokalypsis Beasts began to descend with shocking glory and power.
The Record of Oppenheimer stared at the legions of enemies with a blinding light of Destiny.
Beside him, Commander Feng shone even brighter as these two past enemies stood side by side.
Around them, Primogenitors and some of Noah's closest Vassals could be found, with even the figures of the Daughter of Hatred and Ayame present!
Their whole existence was filled with purpose as they were warped here to defend those weaker than them.
To defend the inhabitants of the new domain they called their home.
{Today, the Ones Above Extremity made a choice of genocide and apocalypse for all those in the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.}
{Against such a choice, we forge our own path. We weave...our own story.}
The voice of the Extremity of Quintessence reverberated all around as it held a fantastical sense of magnetism!
{Weave...your own story!}

sentences.text: It was the Weaver of Extremity spreading himself out across Existence and Non-existence.
It would no doubt be something utterly fantastical as the cost for Noah to do all of this...was obscenely immense.
And so his main body grasped his chest.
And he felt the beat of his Heart.
THUMP!
Like an ancient drum that was truly only waking up now {O Mana...}
Noah called out as his main body began to be covered by an astounding blue and vermillion radiance on top of the royal purple light.
His endless swathes of Mana danced madly and churned.
It seemed like an endless cerulean sea was rising within him and just now beginning to spread out.
{O Mana...}
Noah called out again as in addition to all of this, an Aurum glow came and surged all around.
The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist shone with radiance as the actions being carried out now and what Noah was about to continue doing...
Who else other than the Main Character could do this?
Who else other than the Protagonist?
{O Mana...O Infinity...}
HUUM!
{Run wild and free.}
The weavings of his extremes shuddered.
Their desires rose.
And they saw they were given free rein without any limitations.
And so...
BOOOM!
Utterly unfathomable brilliance unfolded!
From the skies of Dissolution, tears in space occurred as two illusory Dungeon Monoliths descended in different corners of this Supernal Haven.
It was just the beginning of Noah letting loose.
It was just the first day of the Mors Apokalypsis, and yet the changes that would occur on this single day would be utterly consequential and irreversible ones!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
HOOONG!
A blaring sound boomed out that alerted all those within it, prompts beginning to rise before them.
{The Ones Above Extremity have chosen the path of Extinction of all beings.}
Such an astonishing prompt arose as the Son of Destiny gazed upwards with a somber expression.
The Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were stern as they also gazed up!
The Primogenitor of Steel opened his eyes as a Colorless light flashed through them, Quintessence buzzing around his existence as he glared upwards.
The Bard of Quintessence has bright eyes as a grand symphony had begun to play from his weaving, his whole existence lost in it.

The Cimmerian Architect felt the subtle changes along all others as the prompts continued to descend before them while the faraway vision of the boundary of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven being penetrated became clear to all!
{The gazes of the Dikastes of Extremity and the Ones Above Extremity are obscured as they cannot move.}
{In exchange, a process to erase all existences was initiated- with the tools of this process known as Mors Apokalypsis being these Existential Apokalypsis Beasts!}
{Today marks the First Day of Mors Apokalypsis, with the target of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts being all those in the First Gradation of Extremity and below.
Attacking any Apokalypsis Beasts will cause their existence to erupt with power equivalent to your Realm, with victory or defeat dependent on the breadth of your Extremes and existence.}
The weavings of secrets that would have taken countless lives to be lost before they were learned...were made clear to them by the Weaver of Extremity.
He had seen through the secrets of exactly what was occurring as he guided those below him, his words reverberating across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
{The Extremity of Quintessence issues an Existential Quest of Survival for all those deemed capable of standing against the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.}
{Defend your home.
Defend those at the First Gradation and below.
Immeasurable rewards, glory, and loot await on the other side depending on how many Existential Apokalypsis Beasts you manage to kill.}
The Extremity of Loot imposed itself on the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven while Noah issued such daring prompts.
The very extreme of Loot flowed within Noah's Lineage as it was budding like a silent flower within the bodies of all of his chosen Vassals.
So long as they managed to kill an Existential Apokalypsis Beast, Noah's light of Loot would shine as the maximum possible Loot would be attained.

And at this moment, a great deal of Noah's people were chosen as ones capable of standing against the Apokalypsis Beasts once they attacked them, their bodies became burdened with a great purpose as space twisted around them before they were sent towards different areas of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
The buzzing Infinite Hyperversal Haven was spending a great deal of authority to continue keeping the drilling Apokalypsis Beasts at bay as at this moment...
{Let them through.}
The words of the Weaver of Extremity echoed out.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven began to stabilize.
And across its barriers and boundaries, a few massive cylindrical pathways formed as they opened up the defenses widely.

The Apokalypsis Beasts only had a single purpose as those nearby these formed Passages surged across them speedily, while those in the distance...changed their route to also come through the wide open defenses.
The path of least resistance was followed by these killing machines as they surged in seeking to accomplish their purpose!
So across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, it seemed like abyssal pathways from above had opened as from them, tens of thousands of Apokalypsis Beasts began to descend with shocking glory and power.
The Record of Oppenheimer stared at the legions of enemies with a blinding light of Destiny.
Beside him, Commander Feng shone even brighter as these two past enemies stood side by side.
Around them, Primogenitors and some of Noah's closest Vassals could be found, with even the figures of the Daughter of Hatred and Ayame present!
Their whole existence was filled with purpose as they were warped here to defend those weaker than them.
To defend the inhabitants of the new domain they called their home.

{Against such a choice, we forge our own path.
We weave...our own story.}

{Weave...your own story!}

chapters.title: Chapter 2911 End Times! I
paragraphs: A time of death.
A time of unfathomable brilliance!
Listening to the words and prompts rising before them, all the chosen inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven picked up the truly important things from them.
That today was the First Day of Mors Apokalypsis.
That those in the First Gradation of Extremity were now targeted.
Following this logic, it meant many more days of Mors Apokalypsis would follow as after the extinction of all those in the First Gradation...those above them would follow!
So they had to make their stand.
And seeing the Legions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts descending, they moved to weave their own records.
They moved to weave their own stories!
Stories.
Legends.

At this moment, a clone of Noah's was floating valiantly at the very peak of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as near him, a cylindrical pathway that allowed Legions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts to pass down stood.
The beasts rushed down with interminable purpose as Noah watched them pass by, gazing at his own people as he told them to weave their own stories.
Their own legends.
What was the life of a being other than a story?
A collection of records of how they lived their lives?
HUUM!
Around Noah's already blazing figure that was radiating throngs of vermillion flames, the weaving of a grand extreme began to stir.
Noah uttered out with sharp eyes as he looked at the throngs of his people flying upwards to face Legions bringing down an apocalypse.
Their records and existence would shine brilliantly as they forged their own stories.
And stories...held power.
The legend of the records of one's existence...held power!
HUUM!
{The Extremity of Fables is coming to fruition!}
A new extreme emerged.
Its desire was boundlessly wide as it sought to encompass all of one's existence and records...into their own power.
One's story...could also be an extension of their power.
The grander their story was.
The more quintessential their fable was...
The more power they would have!
And whose story was more grand.
Whose story and achievements were more fantastical?!
{The Extremity of Fables vibrates with determination!}
A shocking brilliance erupted with Noah at the very center as a verdant light bloomed.
A light of life and brilliance.
A light that came with the thundering voice of the Extremity of Fables as he made a new extreme available to all his people through his lineage.
{Forge your own stories. Forge your own Fables...the stronger your legend is, the stronger you shall become.}
The lands shook with trepidation as all Entities in Noah's lineage felt their Existence burning with a profound intensity!
They felt the Culmination of their achievements come together and grant them strength as out of all of them...
A single entity's fable was supreme.
{Your Fable is an unfathomable one.}
{Your Fable is a Quintessential one.}
A Colorless light seemed into a budding verdant light.
Noah's existence became suffused with this brilliance as even the Vermillion colored light became painted with it!
{Your Fable is your staunchest supporter.}
{Your Fable is a Quintessential pillar of strength that holds up an unpredictable future.}
{Your Fable empowers the capabilities of the Weaver of Extremity.}
{Your Fable empowers the weavings of all of your Extremes!}
A verdant light akin to a nuclear bomb exploded.
And Noah's extremes seethed as he felt Infinity flare with brilliance, another ten thousand clones instantly being created.

A few hundred of his clones appeared in the Nether Haven of Genesis as he observed throngs of Apokalypsis Beasts all around it, but the moment he was even about to will the weaving of an Existential Hyperversal Embodiment, a royal purple light already flashed and crashed down oppressively on all Apokalypsis Beasts as...
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 51,284,665 Fragments of the Endocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 47,776,650 Fragments of the Mesocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 42,635,999 Fragments of the Exocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 34,625,887 Fragments of the Seed of a Fruit of Existence!}
All of the Apokalypsis Beasts that were roaming the Nether Haven of Genesis instantly perished.
All of Noah's extremes were supported by his grand legend- even his Existential Extremity Authorities as everything about his capabilities exploded upwards!
Outside of the Seven Havens.
Outside the scope of the endless Vacuous stretches of nothingness.
In the endless swathes of the Planar Palisades of Extremity where random Planes of Existence moved.
His will and clones stretched out infinitely as at this moment, Noah truly felt like he could cover this vast distance.
And so, he set out to do just that.
He set out to enact and progress his grand Fable that as of this day, it was only just beginning!
In a nondescript Minor Plane of Existence.
Across its cosmos and universes, within a small but developed world.
A metropolis could be seen with grand structures, some floating in the skies as flying cars and gravitating vessels could be seen with abundance.

In such a metropolis, millions moved and lives busily as among the throngs of people moving about in the neon streets, there was one man with a scraggly beard who was holding up a circular device that released a hologram above him, this hologram reading...
{The end times are here. Repent! Repent! Repent!}
The hologram pulsed with bright lights as all others passing him on the neon streets scowled and shook their heads at this man's waste of time!
Yet this being continued unfettered, a stern expression on his face as occasionally, he would even bellow out.
"The End Times are here! It's the End Times! Repent, and save your worthless souls!"
His voice was deep as it rang out across the neon streets, and just as he was about to increase his pitch while yelling at the skies...
He was dumbfounded to see the skies torn open as tens of apocalyptic beasts descended!

chapters.title: Chapter 2912 End Times! II
paragraphs: BOOM! BOOM!

The defenses of the metropolis instantly activated as lasers and railguns boomed out, a thin barrier rising as under the descent of the white apocalyptic Beasts, raging white flames thundered down and destroyed everything!
Shock and horror quickly spread as...
'It...it was actually happening?'

The doomsayer himself was shocked while the sign above him continued to blare with the words of end times, his expression rapidly changing to joy as he spread his arms out while bellowing with a trace of madness!
"Haha, I was right! I was finally right! You fools!"
He spread his arms out wide to welcome death.
While others were scrambling chaotically around him, he was laughing freely as white flames burned the skies themselves thundered down!
And...
A Colorless light flashed.
And the raging white flames disappeared.
The doomsayer blinked as he gazed at the skies again.
And there, he saw a flash of purple light as a moment later, the heads of the ferocious apocalyptic beasts bent down and their bodies then turned to dust!
Those scrambling gazed up in shock.
The doomsayer was incredulous as while gazing up, he barely saw the outline of what seemed to be a man appearing far above them.

His eyes stung as if he were looking at a burning sun, and a moment later, he felt a vermillion light cover everything around him, the neon city lights fading from his view as when he next opened his eyes....
He was looking at an endlessly blue sky.
In the skies, serene floating landmass could be seen as blue waves of light trickled down from them gorgeously as if they were waterfalls.

And he himself...was on a similar floating island along with hundreds of thousands of others as the futuristic lands they knew were gone, verdant grasslands at their feet and overflowing blue rivers in the distance as around them...a heavy and potent atmosphere of energy was present!

To the extent that the doomsayer and hundreds of thousands of others in this landmass alone felt as if their bodies were drinking something akin to a tonic- as if their very selves were being enriched as...
BOOM!
Explosive lights bloomed from each of them as they felt...a source of energy flowing through them.
As they felt...Mana.
And in front of their eyes, blue prompts began to rise for the first time in their lives.
{You have awakened!}

In shock and incredulity, they felt their bodies continue to drink up the heavy concentrations of energy in the surrounding atmosphere as the reserves of Mana in their bodies only became more potent, nexus points of origins beginning to form at the core of their being as they began to change into entirely different Lifeforms!
This...was an example of a few hundred thousand existences from a Metropolis of a small world among many worlds in the Cosmos of a Minor Plane of Existence in the Planar Palisades of Extremity.
The influence of the Extremity of Fables was spreading across many worlds such as this. Many cosmos such as this.
Many Planes such as this.
The number of entities saved from the burning white flames of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts was rising by millions of quintillions at every moment!
And he was just getting started.
The Planar Palisades of Extremity were vast.
The Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains were even vaster.
On this day, the myriad of Existences across these domains would all become intricately connected to the Weaver of Extremity, only a distinct few losing such a favor due to their own actions.
Within Dissolution.

The figures of Extremity Blue, Seer Amestris, and the Avernus Extremity Overlord gazed around with blank expressions as those they considered the Ones Above Extremity...had abandoned them and were nowhere to be seen.
Their existence felt hollow and drained as if they would never be able to easily cross the Gradations of Extremity again, their fate tumultuous as likely...a very obscene end was coming.
Far from here, in the region outside of Vitalis and Vacuous where Legions from both sides clashed.

The visage of the Prime Devourer could be seen amidst the core of the Legions of Vacuous Hyperversal Domains as he stared with a dull look towards the legions of descending Existential Apokalypsis Beasts whose terrifying reign was put to a pause as a single being appeared.
The figure of a single entity made his entrance as many had seen him before on this same battlefield!
But his appearance now was undeniable.
His gaze masked interminable weavings as many could instinctively feel like his appearance here...was to put an end to this war.
With a flare of brilliant Vermillion flames and a glint of purple light, the words of this being were heard throughout.
{Kneel.}
HUUM!
Emperor Shao and others of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains watched with expanding pupils.
The pressure of these words descended on the Apokalypsis Beasts as they began to tremble and shatter.
The pressure of these words also pressed on the visage of the Prime Devourer as he felt it.
Heavier than anything he had felt before.

And he felt it wrap around his body here, and his body that had lost the guidance of the Celebrious Ones in Anarchos. He felt the weight of this single word wrap around the weavings of his very records and existence as it began...to grind everything to dust!
With a dazed expression, the eyes of the Prime Devourer dimmed as his head bowed, and he didn't even bend halfway before his body shattered into ash and dust.
It was the first few seconds of Mors Apokalypsis.
And already, many grand changes were occurring.

The grandest change of all...was something that the Weaver of Extremity who moved across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity at this moment had far, far from his grasp just moments ago presenting itself to him.
It was the construct and concept of the Fruit of Existence he had only learned of from the weavings of Records and Existence.
He had attained all the pieces required to make not just one...but many, many of these critical constructs!

chapters.title: Chapter 2913 The Fruit of Existence I
paragraphs: 2913 The Fruit of Existence I
Fruit of Existence.
What was it?
Why was it of such profound relevance that the very backing and authority of what was known as the Codex of Extremity...
was powered by the Fruits of Existence to initiate Mors Apokalypsis?
Why was this fruit cultivated over eons from the Existential Extremity Authorities of Vitalis and Vacuous?
These were once questions with no foreseeable answers.
They were.
But no longer.
Within the weaving of a Record being etched concurrently into existence.

It was not within the Vitalis Annals of Extremity nor the Vacuous Annals of Extremity- frankly, it wasn't even in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that encompassed the Existential Domains and even the Archaeos Vitalis and Vacuous Pylos!
It was within the Weaving of a Record outside of all of this.
In this Record, a serene white sea could be seen stretching out for light years.
At the center of this white sea, a circular table and two white thrones facing each other could be seen as on one of these thrones, there sat a woman adorned in a white dress pulsing with authority.
Her silver white hair radiated purity as her white pupils changed colors every now and then, her beauty utterly ecstatic!
The table before her held a plate full of translucent fruits, a teapot, and cups- one of which she was raising and sipping herself as she waited for someone.
She was none other than Basileus Anaine, and the one she was waiting for...
"The Great Anaine hasn't been waiting for too long, right?"
A feminine voice came out right behind her as if it was always there.

And yet Basileus Anaine was unfettered as she didn't react one bit, continuing to sip her tea calmly as the presence behind her instantly warped to appear on the opposing throne, tanned radiant caramel hands coming down to grab a translucent fruit as an utterly astonishing visage of a woman bit down on it while reveling in its taste.
Her hair was dark as her face was pristine, with her figure being adorned by a fiery red gold dress as her whole visage burned with a unique Existential Extremity Authority.
Basileus Anaine would recognize this authority many weavings away.
The Existential Extremity Authority of Ignis!
From the Legacy of Lethith overseeing the Existential Domains of Ignis, she was...
"Basileus Sarynn. You came exactly when you were supposed to."
"I did, didn't I? Never did I think I would see you again so soon. Have things already been set in motion? For me to receive that signal, it must mean..."

Even though she just sat, Basileus Sarynn of the Legacy of Lethith seductively bit onto the Fruit of Existence while leaning forward, her devilishly gorgeous visage coming close to Basileus Anaine until she was inches away!
To the extent that she could clearly see the outline of the lips and the hot circulation of authority on the surface of the skin.
To that point, Basileus Anaine frowned and spoke succinctly.
"You continue to ignore boundaries. How about we focus on business?"
Business.
What business could the daughter of the Archon Basileus Al-
Abalem have with an entity of a different Legacy?
An entity overseeing an entirely different Existential Domain?
A pouting expression appeared on Basileus Sarynn as she leaned all the way back into her throne while licking her lips of the juices of the Fruit of Existence.

"Mmm, business. The business of treachery, my dear Anaine. But have you collected enough of the Panaceas of Existence? These gorgeous elixirs of life that keep everything moving? Without enough of these, mobilizing a sufficient force will be hard."
She smiled as she twirled the Fruit of Existence in her hands with fondness.
As if even the one she was eating was something so utterly prized!
At her question, Basileus Anaine let out a smile as she thought about a few things.
"Since we last talked, a few things have changed. Naturally, so do our plans. And the Fruits of Existence...there won't be a requirement as high as before."
Changes had occurred.

Changes that caused the brows of Basileus Sarynn to rise as she sat seriously on her throne, a heavy and veiled discussion blooming at this moment as it showed the intricacies of Legacies...were anything but simple.
But most of all...everything seemed to be rotating around a single object.
A single construct.
Something that shone with a translucent light as it was none other than the Fruit of Existence!
Basileus Sarynn looked at her while a thoughtful look developed on her face, a sense of seriousness coming in as she spoke slowly.

"Taking down an Archon Basileus is almost an impossibility. Are you sure about this move, Anaine? Profits aside. Glory aside. The difficulty and aftermath alone will be tremendous as inheriting the title of Archon thereafter...must you go so far?"
The words were heavy.
When Basileus Anaine listened to all of them, her gaze didn't change once as her eyes remained unphased.
She stared out into the white sea around her as her eyes turned sharp, staring out into this concurrently unfolding Record as she replied.

"There are many Legacies out there, and there are abundant Existential Domains. Over the eons, Legacies have been replaced. Wars have erupted. Those who have a say in the rise and fall...are those who control the Fruit."
WAA!
She turned back to gaze at Basileus Sarynn calmly.

"And without becoming an Archon Basileus, I cannot control anything. I cannot dream of overseeing multiple Existential Domains under me. I cannot dream of surviving long enough to be free. And without the dreams of our existence...what are we but mere shells?"
Immense silence descended as the two women looked at each other.
Basileus Sarynn once more turned down to lock her gaze onto the Fruits of Existence before her as she sighed.
"Such a small thing, and yet its sway and pull over the dreams of all others is just astonishing, isn't it."
Her existence throbbed at it.
Her records danced just by being near it.
And because of this fruit...a daughter would betray a father.
A ruling would change one legacy would shine ever brighter while another...
"Very well."
Basileus Sarynn came to a decision!

chapters.title: Chapter 2914 The Fruit of Existence II
paragraphs: 2914 The Fruit of Existence II
"The pieces on my side will be ready soon. I'll cement the discussions with Archon Basileus Lethith and thereafter, we can move at any time. What timeline do you foresee?"
A timeline.
A timeline for deception and treachery!
At this, Basileus Anaine smiled as she thought about something.
"Nine days."
Nine days!
This was how long Basileus Anaine expected as when Basileus Sarynn saw this smile, her eyes turned sharp and cautious as she asked.
"You have a look of interest in your eyes...what did you latch into? Who did you latch onto?"
The question was sharp as Basileus Sarynn could sense something from the weavings of her expressions.
But the moment she tried to peer a bit deeper into these weavings...she came upon a blank wall as she could only ask!
The smile from Basileus Anaine slowly faded into calmness as she replied lightly.
"Something special. It may turn out into a factor, it may not. I'm still waiting and seeing."
The words further caused the cautious light in the eyes of Basileus Sarynn to burn as the temperature in this whole Record began to rise.
"It's not a man, is it? The moment that I hear a man has laid his hands on you..."
An utterly domineering and possessive light shone from her eyes as Basileus Sarynn leaned forward again, her eyes openly locking onto the astonishing visage of Basileus Anaine as once more...
"Boundaries, Basileus Sarynn. You continue to violate them." Basileus Anaine reminded.
"Hmph." Basileus Sarynn harrumphed as she came out of her unique state of mind at these words, her figure rising as the hot air around her only became more intense.
She looked up to calm herself as she spoke.
"All right. Nine days. Nine days before you enact your dream of holding onto a Codex of Extremity...I sure hope you've prepared enough Fruits of Existence to utilize it."
The Codex of Extremity!
One of the deciding factors in all the weavings of this deception.

Only Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had access to it as with the Codex of Extremity, one could do many things. And it was because Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had already done many things that Basileus Anaine did not for a second believe she could do this all alone.
Not against someone who had been utilizing the Codex of Extremity for so long- not against someone with the wealth that Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had accumulated.
Not against someone who had assimilated so many Fruits of Existence and continued to consume them unceasingly!
The difficulty was high.
But it was things with the highest Difficulty that were always the most rewarding!
"Mmm, I'll keep in touch. Let me know when all the pieces can move."
WAP!
With a flicker of crimson gold radiance, Basileus Sarynn entirely faded as if she were never there.
Basileus Anaine looked at this scene calmly as she pondered.
Around her, the white sea began to recede rapidly as it seemed to be disappearing.
The skies, the space...everything about this record seemed to be receding and disappearing as within moments, even the throne opposite her disappeared.
She waved her hands as the Fruits of Existence in front of her also faded away as an instant later, she was standing in a black record.
She was alone.
The concurrently unfolding Record had all but faded as if it never occurred.
As if this meeting never occurred.
It wasn't etched down or recorded anywhere as this meeting...never occurred!
In the bounds of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Moving between Existence and Non-existence, the expanding and ever strengthening construct that was the Infinite Hyperversal Haven stood staunchly.
Within it, at depths other beings could not even enter...the figures of the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and Ruination could be seen.
In front of them, the Dowager of Quintessence could be seen along with the figure of none other than her Son, the Extremity of Quintessence!
"When you mentioned a fruit, I had to see for myself."
She oversaw the cultivation of many of the herbs and spiritual fruits within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as she even dabbled within the Alchemy Hall!
At the mention of something that exceeded anything cultivated in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, she came to observe!
"Mmm..." Noah nodded towards his mother with a smile as he waved his hands.

Above them, tens of thousands of fragments of what would make up a single Fruit of Existence gathered, 100,000 Fragments of Endocarps, Mesocarps, Exocarps, and the fragment of the seed of the Fruit of Existence itself!
They shone with a golden translucent light as they began to rotate as if they were stellar bodies at this moment.

The fragments of the Seed were at the very center as they swirled and came ever closer, with pieces of the Endocarp following up as pieces of the Mesocarp and Exocarp followed thereafter- as if they were making the composition of a genuine fruit!
[Converge.]
HUUM!
Noah spoke out with authority as the Extremity of Loot exploded with a golden light, all the swirling pieces of the Fruit of Existence being brought together as a blinding light shone!
In the midst of this process, the Dowager of Quintessence turned her head sideways and asked lightly.
"You cannot multiply the composition of this Fruit yet?"

Her words were directed towards none other than Ruination as akin to a filial daughter, the figure of Ruination replied in a soft voice of respect that didn't at all match the terrifying Armament that she was.

"Not yet, Mother. After I consume a Fruit of Existence, what it grants me will theoretically make it possible for me to begin multiplying the pieces that make it. We just don't understand much about it yet."
The Dowager nodded at this as in the next moment, a blinding light of existence shone.
An existential light, and yet it didn't belong to any specific Existential Extremity Authority!
As it was coming to fruition...
[The Weaver of Extremity observes the formation of a Quintessential construct.]
[The Quintessential Annals of Extremity record an unimaginable achievement!]
Something far outside of his grasp at this moment.
And yet...here it was.
[A Fruit of Existence...is blooming before your very eyes.]
HUUM!
With waves of brilliance that caused his Existential Extremity Authorities to shudder in excitement, a clear, translucent fruit bloomed before Noah.
Its advent...was the first sign that his enemies were about to be in a world of Quintessential pain!

chapters.title: Chapter 2915 The Fruit of Existence III
paragraphs: 2915 The Fruit of Existence III
Translucent.
Radiant.
The glow was initially blinding and covering everything, only to slowly start dying down to reveal the source that had begun to cause the surrounding weaving to pulse with a sense of excitement.
The Dowager of Quintessence gazed at it with surprise as Noah, Ruination, and the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had sharp eyes!
The Fruit held an ever-present glow as its texture was closely resembling that of an apple.
It let out a translucent glow, with light passing through it, and yet at the same time...one felt like they could see their reflection in this fruit as well!
Its appearance was unique as the moment it came to, it radiated a pull that all four entities here felt.
It pulled on Noah's and his mother's soul.
It pulled on Ruination...and it even radiated an undeniable pull towards the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
HUUM!
Waves of glory seethed around Noah as his will went on to wrap around this dazzling fruit.
He had to know.
He had to grasp exactly why this object before him was at the center of why the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius were present in the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!
Like a hungry tide, his soul cascaded down on the translucent wonder.
[The object before you is something far and above your current grasp, and yet you have attained it.]
[To understand it truly, one needs to have scaled the nine Gradations of Extremity and achieved a special weaving of their authority!]
Yes.
It was something far out of his grasp. But since it was before him...
HUUM!
Vermillion flames burned as he reached out.
Like a tyranny moving to hold something pristine only for himself, he reached out and came to hold this glorious translucent fruit in his hands.
[The Weaver of Extremity stares at the Fruit of Existence.]
[The Weavings of the Fruit of Existence begin to speak to you!]
Brilliance unfolded as Noah used a large amount of his Will and Existential Extremity Authorities to understand what he held in his hands.
And...
[A Boon of the Fruit of Existence is gradually becoming clear to you.]
Information began to flow.
Weavings began to flow as Noah uncovered a single usage of the Fruit of Existence so far!
[Once devoured, the authority within the Fruit of Existence will reduce and reverse the deterioration of one's existence, going even further to expand the breadth of one's existence over time.]
Noah's eyes opened wide.

The latter part of the prompt that spoke of the expansion of the breadth of existence was definitely terrifying enough, but Noah's pulsing will couldn't help but be shaken by the first part of the prompt.
As one lived, one aged. All things fell to states of more and more disorder.
The Fruit of Existence...reversed disorder.
The deterioration of one's existence was reversed as Noah could feel that these words alone were not this simple!
The effect of such words...should be something utterly maddening as they would affect everything about the one who devoured this fruit!
But before he could even focus on this...
[Another Boon of the Fruit of Existence is gradually becoming clear to you.]

[Once devoured, the authority within the Fruit of Existence can be directed towards a chosen concept within one's existence. The light of the Fruit of Existence can bathe this concept to cultivate it towards the Existential level, and go further to increase the authority of an Existential Authority.]
[Another Boon of the Fruit of Existence is gradually becoming clear to you.]

[Those with means and capabilities of advanced utilization can take the authority of the Fruit of Existence and allow it to nurture selected Records or Domains. This Existential Nurturing can allow a selected Existential Extreme to be bound to a Record or Domain, with further elevations allowing the chosen domain and extreme to grow into a construct of Infinite possibilities. When the purity and refinement of an extreme bound to a record or domain reaches a critical level, it may even be capable of generating wisps of the authority of the Fruit of Existence that once empowered it.]
The weavings around Noah came to a halt.
Vermillion flames burned brightly around him as he stared with burning eyes towards the Fruit of Existence in his hands!
He had only barely managed to unearth three uses, and each one was more maddening than the last as this most recent prompt...it held too many implications.
The Fruit of Existence could be used to nurture domains themselves.
It could be utilized to nurture the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
It could be utilized to nurture Noah himself.
And it could be utilized to nurture concepts!

But the most astounding thing was the nourishment of a domain and binding of an extreme to it as it meant the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius strengthened Vacuous and Vitalis- bringing them to such a shocking extent as along with the Seeds refining these very same authorities within...they were able to extract Fruits of Existence.
It didn't seem like there was a limit.
There weren't too many details Noah had uncovered as there still seemed to be many mysteries!
And even after unveiling three uses, Noah knew that he was only scratching the surface as under his gaze, he couldn't see everything right now.
To the extent that maybe, the best way to uncover any more weavings...was to devour this Fruit of Existence before him and observe the changes within his existence!
His very existence was crying out for it as his Extremes had already expressed their intent.
Every single part of him wanted this unimaginable treasure as after arriving at such a juncture, Noah breathed out and controlled himself.
The first entity within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to get to enjoy the unfathomable wonders of the Fruit of Existence had to be a special one.
So Noah held the fruit within his hand and turned to gaze towards an entity ahead of him who was looking at everything with curiosity.
"Mother..."
He called out to the one who went through tremendous adversity for him in his early days.
He offered the honor of the first Fruit of Existence converged from the Loot of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts...to a single person whom he could never repay!

[Once devoured, the authority within the Fruit of Existence will reduce and reverse the deterioration of one's existence, going even further to expand the breadth of one's existence over time.]
Noah's eyes opened wide.

The latter part of the prompt that spoke of the expansion of the breadth of existence was definitely terrifying enough, but Noah's pulsing will couldn't help but be shaken by the first part of the prompt.
As one lived, one aged.
All things fell to states of more and more disorder.
The Fruit of Existence...reversed disorder.
The deterioration of one's existence was reversed as Noah could feel that these words alone were not this simple!
The effect of such words...should be something utterly maddening as they would affect everything about the one who devoured this fruit!
But before he could even focus on this...
[Another Boon of the Fruit of Existence is gradually becoming clear to you.]
[Once devoured, the authority within the Fruit of Existence can be directed towards a chosen concept within one's existence.
The light of the Fruit of Existence can bathe this concept to cultivate it towards the Existential level, and go further to increase the authority of an Existential Authority.]
[Another Boon of the Fruit of Existence is gradually becoming clear to you.]
[Those with means and capabilities of advanced utilization can take the authority of the Fruit of Existence and allow it to nurture selected Records or Domains.

This Existential Nurturing can allow a selected Existential Extreme to be bound to a Record or Domain, with further elevations allowing the chosen domain and extreme to grow into a construct of Infinite possibilities.

When the purity and refinement of an extreme bound to a record or domain reaches a critical level, it may even be capable of generating wisps of the authority of the Fruit of Existence that once empowered it.]
The weavings around Noah came to a halt.
Vermillion flames burned brightly around him as he stared with burning eyes towards the Fruit of Existence in his hands!
He had only barely managed to unearth three uses, and each one was more maddening than the last as this most recent prompt...it held too many implications.
The Fruit of Existence could be used to nurture domains themselves.
It could be utilized to nurture the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
It could be utilized to nurture Noah himself.
And it could be utilized to nurture concepts!

But the most astounding thing was the nourishment of a domain and binding of an extreme to it as it meant the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius strengthened Vacuous and Vitalis- bringing them to such a shocking extent as along with the Seeds refining these very same authorities within...they were able to extract Fruits of Existence.
It didn't seem like there was a limit.
There weren't too many details Noah had uncovered as there still seemed to be many mysteries!
And even after unveiling three uses, Noah knew that he was only scratching the surface as under his gaze, he couldn't see everything right now.
To the extent that maybe, the best way to uncover any more weavings...was to devour this Fruit of Existence before him and observe the changes within his existence!
His very existence was crying out for it as his Extremes had already expressed their intent.
Every single part of him wanted this unimaginable treasure as after arriving at such a juncture, Noah breathed out and controlled himself.
The first entity within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to get to enjoy the unfathomable wonders of the Fruit of Existence had to be a special one.
So Noah held the fruit within his hand and turned to gaze towards an entity ahead of him who was looking at everything with curiosity.
"Mother..."
He called out to the one who went through tremendous adversity for him in his early days.
He offered the honor of the first Fruit of Existence converged from the Loot of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts...to a single person whom he could never repay!

chapters.title: Chapter 2916 The Fruit of Existence IV
paragraphs: 2916 The Fruit of Existence IV
The Extremity of Quintessence offered the honor of the first Fruit of Existence to the Dowager of Quintessence!
To the Quintessential Dowager!
Ruination and the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven smiled as Amelia Osmont came out of her stupor and waved her hands dismissively.
"Oh stop it, I don't need something like that. You have a war to win right? Just take them all as you need..."
Even at this point in time, she wanted the best for her son.

Just like Noah, Ruination, and the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- her very existence was crying out for this Fruit before her, but her role as a Mother was so profound that among all of them, she didn't show an ounce of this intent!
Noah smiled at his mother as he appeared before her, taking her hands and placing the Fruit of Existence on her palms.

"Take it as a gift for all the sleepless nights you had in the past. All the diapers you changed. All your worries and stress whenever I got sick. All your tears I could do nothing about for years..."
The Weaver of Extremity understood his Records very well.
He could go back to the moment his records first began and remember everything.
The heartbreak and toil his mother had to go through! The long nights where he incessantly cried as an infant. The even longer days when his father was home.
He could never in his life repay this woman before him, but he hoped to at least make her happy and free of worries now as he beckoned towards the Fruit of Existence in her palm!
"Please."

The Dowager of Quintessence gazed at her son with eyes of an overabundance of love that only a single being could portray, making sure not to cry at this moment as she let out a breath and gazed at the dazzling fruit in her hands.
She then took it to her mouth...and took a bite.
Her whole existence exploded with an unfathomable light.
Her mouth seemed to move by itself thereafter as in a few bites, the whole translucent Fruit was gone!
HUUM!
Brilliance unfolded on her whole visage as no doubt, grand changes were happening within her. But outwardly...Noah's eyes squinted as he saw her skin become more radiant. As she seemed younger.
No, not younger- more so in her prime! As if after eating and beginning to assimilate this Fruit of Existence, she was becoming her most perfect self!
[My goodness...] She spoke in a mesmerized tone as her very words brimmed with Existential Authority, her whole existence beginning to buzz as it scaled upwards in power.
[You have to try this...] The Quintessential Dowager thus spoke as she became the first in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to devour a Fruit of Existence.
Noah gazed at such a scene with a profound gaze as he waved his hands, tens of thousands of Fragments that made this unique Fruit appearing up until the count reached 300,000 for all four components!
And then, akin to the swirling stellar bodies of galaxies, all of these pieces moved and converged together as within the span of a millisecond, three dazzling Fruits of Existence came to fruition.
One floated towards Ruination.
One floated towards the manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
And the other came into Noah's hands as with a tyrannical light, the whole translucent fruit was thrown to his mouth as he tasted this wonder for the first time!
A foreign and yet natural authority bloomed within his body a moment later as every part of Noah's existence was seemingly fighting for it.

At this moment in time, Noah had made his will extremely analytical to explore and understand this Authority closely, but even he nearly lost himself as he found the Fruit of Existence...made one experience a profound sense of euphoria!
So much so that it could even affect their mental state as everything within their existence sought to drink up this authority.
By the time Noah had chewed the Fruit of Existence, he felt as if an immense sea of authority exploded within him as initially, it was waiting for direction.
For a mere instant...it waited for a direction as it spread across all of Noah's existence, but after this instant passed, this authority moved by itself.

It sank into Noah's Soul as a refulgence of brilliance erupted- as if it didn't even require Noah to choose! As if it had seen what he needed the most and instantly determined that it was Noah's Soul.

Noah analyzed this scene carefully and understood that naturally, the Fruit of Existence went to fill the deficiencies of an Existence first before anything else. Another point was that to control this shocking authority within a Fruit of Existence...
one had to have sufficient power to do so!
Because when Noah tried to pause or direct the flow of the blooming sea of authority within his existence, he found that he wasn't even able to do so.
So...he let it run free.
HUUM!
Into his soul, all of the authority of the swallowed Fruit of Existence flowed.

Tendrils of vermillion flames weaved across Noah's existence as he studied what this authority was doing, with his soul emenating an intent of profound euphoria as he felt his breadth...begin to expand.
His soul was akin to a container that held everything.

His Existential Extremity Authorities were so extremely heavy in this container! They covered all parts of him as Noah could see a reasoning for Entities to only ever expand and take one or two concepts at the Existential level.
But he was greedy.

And his greed for more and more Existential concepts would have to be paid as at this moment, his soul received a baptism. The container that was his soul was being expanded in what it could hold as with the expansion of the breadth of his soul, his current Existential Extremity Authorities could rise ever higher, and he would gradually have enough space to add another existential Extremity Authority if he wished!

chapters.title: Chapter 2917 Heavy! I
paragraphs: The Fruits of Existence were things that those Above Extremity had access to.
They utilized them for their own unique purposes as what would happen when an Entity still within the Gradations of Extremity devoured a Fruit of Existence?
If they weren't constructs like the Dikastes of Extremity who were powered by the Fruits of Existence themselves, how would their existence react?!

Noah was experiencing this answer in real time as the boundless waves of the authority of the Fruit of Existence felt like they were stimulating, refining, compressing, and purifying his soul all at once!

In the viewpoint of the endless waters of the Gradations of Extremity, a fantastical scene bloomed in the slow waters of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity where Noah was proceeding along at a slow but constant pace.
As if his figure gained wings.
Even without his Existential Extremity Authorities rose to a higher level.
Just his soul alone...
BOOM!
Propelled him upwards once more at a shocking speed.
{The Weaver of Extremity is experiencing a profound elevation.}
{The Extremity of Fables is adding on to an already profound legend.}
{The Extremity of Ascendancy illuminates with glory as it states every single devoured Fruit of Existence is akin to fundamental transformation.}
{The effects of the Fruit of Existence are further enhanced.}
Utterly brilliant golden light bloomed along with the translucent majesty, followed by tendrils of blue, purple, Aurum, and colorless lights as all of Noah's extremes cheered!
{The effects of the Fruit of Existence are hard to quantify.}

{The boons of expanding your breadth of existence are felt and understood, but even more fundamental changes are occurring to your soul due to the energy of the Fruit of Existence that is not yet capable of being quantified.}
WAA!
Something was occurring that even he couldn't understand.
At least, not yet.
But one thing was clear.
His rise across the Gradations was about to take a tremendous leap as a great deal of progress was about to be made.
And he wasn't alone.
Amidst his brilliance, he turned to see Ruination and the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Their gazes were stern as brilliance was reflected on them as well, and the land around them...the vast stretches of Aletheian Havens and the pulsing Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself began to pulse and shake!

The Warriors of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven who had risen to battle the Legions of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts...felt this change very closely as they instinctively knew something was coming.
None more so than a few special beings.
One being, in particular, was affected as a byproduct of something Noah had done not too long ago.

Standing in the midst of Entities blazing with power at the Fourth and Fifth Gradation of Extremity, there was a lone visage of Lilith whose body...was currently radiating a power that she should not be capable of emanating.
It was too bright.
Her hatred...its extreme was almost solidifying molten red in her surroundings as the cause was none other than...Fables.
The Extremity of Quintessence had spurred this extreme unto all of them from their Bloodline as he told them to forge their own stories!
Now, for the vast majority of entities in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven who were brought up by Noah, they barely had any stories.
They barely formed any legends.
{Your Fable is a long one.}
{Your Fable is a grand one.}
{Your Fable cannot be left alone to rot in oblivion as at this moment, the weaving of Fables supports you with immensity.}
Her devilish horns became ever brighter.

She clashed with a robust Apokalypsis Beast whose aura rose maddeningly to match hers and even exceed it, and yet while its Existential Extremity Authority began to burn...the Hatred around Lilith mixed with the Quintessence overflowing in her Blood, and a glimmer of Fables empowered this all that much more!
And in the next moment, her Hatred congealed into demonic spikes from all four directions around the Apokalypsis Beasts in front of her.
Like Ayame, Erikson, and others in her surroundings, she should be struggling in front of this beast.
And yet...
SQUELCH!
The demonic horns formed with Hatred thundered down and skewered the Apokalypsis Beasts before her as white gold blood spurt out onto her face.
It was a scene even she couldn't believe.
She...was the Daughter of Hatred.
The Dimensional Deceiver.
Unlike many others...she already had an existing Legend.
She already had a grand Fable that she was only adding to!
Thus, her augmentation of power through the Extremity of Fables...was truly extreme!
And she wasn't the only one.
There were others.
Commander Feng.
Hyperion.
Oppenheimer.
The Cimmerian Architect.
Ishtar, Sargon, Svetlana, the Primogenitor of Steel...and many other entities who already had long stretching legends!
Their augmentations...were utterly obscene as at this moment, they were running utterly wild on the battlefield.
Their scenes fluttered across the eyes of Lilith.
They were adding to their own legends.
But she wouldn't focus on them.
She would focus on enriching her own fable as after taking down a single Apokalypsis Beasts...she saw the prompts of Fragments of none other than the Fruit of Existence granted as Loot.
And towards this, her very soul shuddered.

It shuddered as with a demonic glint, she looked far above where the legions of Apokalypsis Beasts were charging as her figure warped to appear within their throngs, her whole visage beginning to move with a sense of seduction and danger as she uttered out coldly!
{Quintessential Dance of the Deceiver.}
Her own creation.
Her own weavings.
Hatred moved as now, supported by the Fable behind Lilith, it was bound to allow her to make something of herself even with the large scheme of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
She moved as like many others who didn't struggle too much against their first Apokalypsis Beast and actually managed to take it down, they saw the Loot fragments that exploded out.
They saw the glimmer of the Fruit of Existence as their souls could not take their eyes off of it.
They didn't know that the Extremity of Quintessence above them was already testing the effects of one soon enough, he would be taking on hundreds!

chapters.title: Chapter 2918 Heavy! II
paragraphs: In the isolated domain in the depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
While feeling the constantly expanding breadth of his soul, Noah's will turned towards Ruination.
As if she could feel his piercing gaze, she spoke.

{It is too intricate as you can see for yourself, Master. But the changes it is causing within me are quintessential as after assimilation an unknown number of them, I should be able to multiply them thereafter.}
Yes.
It was still something too high.
Noah nodded at her words as he waved his hands again.
This time, hundreds of thousands of Fragments of Endocarp, Mesocarp, Exocarp, and Seeds of Fruits of Existences bloomed above them.
They began to swirl and converge the moment they appeared as from where they disappeared, new fragments took their place.
And at the center point of convergence...one Fruit of Existence after another appeared as after Noah analyzed, he knew that the most critical thing was to understand these wonders fully first.
And the best way to do this was for none other than the Weaver of Extremity to devour and assimilate them!
One fruit after another descended with a translucent light from above as this time, Noah's mouth remained open as he took them in one by one.
He didn't worry about an overflow of this terrifying wonder.
He was akin to a hungry sponge.
His existence was already stretched thin with all the concepts he held!
The blooming translucent seas of existential authority...were akin to a saving grace for him as he wanted to take it all in with tyranny!
After all, it had been a decent number of minutes now since he first stepped into the Gradations of Extremity.
Minutes.
To him, this was long enough.
While on the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, Noah swallowed ten Fruits of Existence at once as after their blossoming waves of authority bloomed within his existence and surged into his soul...
His figure in the waters of the Gradations of Extremity underwent a change.
It instantly disappeared with a flicker of light as if it no longer existed, and when Noah opened his eyes again...
{Huh?}
The water around him was different.
It was too clear.
It was beginning to thin out.
It looked too pure to the extent that one would think..they were approaching the upper surface of these deep waters.

And the moment Noah arrived here, the waters turned chaotic as a heavy and undeniable pressure fell from all around, and yet his existence remained staunchly strong as a burning transient light covered it and continued a ridiculous process!

A process that after affirming everything around him...Noah confirmed that the instant consumption of 10 Fruits of Existence instantly took him way past the demarcation between the Seventh and the Eighth Gradation of Extremity as of this moment, he was genuinely roaming within the Eighth Gradation of Extremity.
A distance away from the 9th Gradation.
A distance away from whatever lay beyond Extremity!
HUUM!
And even at this moment, his existence burned with interminable determination as he continued his ascent!
The state of his existence was currently unique as after every Fruit of Existence released its endless seas of authority into him, it all surged towards his soul.
But after he had more than ten in a short period of time, the target of some of these vast seas changed.
They came to a halt as if they were making a choice once more.
At such a scene, Noah once more focused with extreme precision.
Would his body and origin follow?
His Origin held unique Aletheian Havens and its own Extremity Vein, even being capable of producing Loot on its own as he even had a wondrous Forge!
Would be...be capable of producing his own Fruits of Existence?
His body held an unsurpassable physiology after building up a foundation others could only dream of!
Would-
BOOM!
His thoughts came to a stop as his Existence released a pulse of light.
After the elevation of his soul continued, the raging authority directed itself towards another part of his existence.
{Your Origin burns with Quintessential ambition.}
{Your Origin is being exposed to an authority that is making it more sublime!}
The authority of Existence itself covered his Aletheian Havens.
His radiant Extremity Vein.
And...
{Havens within Havens, layers within layers.}
{The First Aletheian Haven has begun to form within your Extremity Vein!}

The direction of the authority of the Fruits of Existence divided. It now flowed into his Soul and Origin with purpose as seeing the quantifiable changes and unquantifiable ones, Noah's strong will sought a conclusion.
{The Weaver of Extremity holds Existential Extremity Authorities within him as he ponders a question.}
He held Quintessence, Infinity, Tyranny, and the Protagonist.
These concepts were Existential.
But as he saw the overflowing threads of the authority of the Fruit of Existence, Noah came to wonder.
{If the weavings of one's Extremes are Existential, what about there own Existence?}
He was seeking the path forward!
One's concepts could become Existential, yes. But what about their own Aspects of Existence?

What about one's Soul, Origin, and Body? And what if it was a case like Noah who also expanded the concepts of the Soul, Origin, and Body towards Extremity- what if such concepts became Existential along with his Aspects of Existence?
Noah's will shone brightly as he looked at the depths of his Origin and Soul, observing the rampaging waves of translucent authority as he wondered.
'Can you help me achieve this?'
No answer came from the wondrous authority of the Fruit of Existence.
It was not cognizant.
It only moved based on weavings Noah himself didn't quite grasp.
It wrapped around his Extremity Vein as it pulsed, existence being inverted as within it, an Aletheian Haven began to bloom.
The blooming Haven...was a mixture of the weavings of Noah's Extremes.
Four in particular.
Quintessence. Infinity.
Tyranny.
Protagonist.
The weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities bloomed with the first Haven to bloom inside the Extremity Veil stabilizing his Origin.
The First Aletheian Haven...had weavings of Existential!

sentences.text: In the isolated domain in the depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
While feeling the constantly expanding breadth of his soul, Noah's will turned towards Ruination.
As if she could feel his piercing gaze, she spoke.
{It is too intricate as you can see for yourself, Master.
But the changes it is causing within me are quintessential as after assimilation an unknown number of them, I should be able to multiply them thereafter.}
Yes.
It was still something too high.
Noah nodded at her words as he waved his hands again.
This time, hundreds of thousands of Fragments of Endocarp, Mesocarp, Exocarp, and Seeds of Fruits of Existences bloomed above them.
They began to swirl and converge the moment they appeared as from where they disappeared, new fragments took their place.
And at the center point of convergence...one Fruit of Existence after another appeared as after Noah analyzed, he knew that the most critical thing was to understand these wonders fully first.
And the best way to do this was for none other than the Weaver of Extremity to devour and assimilate them!
One fruit after another descended with a translucent light from above as this time, Noah's mouth remained open as he took them in one by one.
He didn't worry about an overflow of this terrifying wonder.
He was akin to a hungry sponge.
His existence was already stretched thin with all the concepts he held!
The blooming translucent seas of existential authority...were akin to a saving grace for him as he wanted to take it all in with tyranny!
After all, it had been a decent number of minutes now since he first stepped into the Gradations of Extremity.
Minutes.
To him, this was long enough.
While on the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, Noah swallowed ten Fruits of Existence at once as after their blossoming waves of authority bloomed within his existence and surged into his soul...
His figure in the waters of the Gradations of Extremity underwent a change.
It instantly disappeared with a flicker of light as if it no longer existed, and when Noah opened his eyes again...
{Huh?}
The water around him was different.
It was too clear.
It was beginning to thin out.
It looked too pure to the extent that one would think..they were approaching the upper surface of these deep waters.

And the moment Noah arrived here, the waters turned chaotic as a heavy and undeniable pressure fell from all around, and yet his existence remained staunchly strong as a burning transient light covered it and continued a ridiculous process!

A process that after affirming everything around him...Noah confirmed that the instant consumption of 10 Fruits of Existence instantly took him way past the demarcation between the Seventh and the Eighth Gradation of Extremity as of this moment, he was genuinely roaming within the Eighth Gradation of Extremity.
A distance away from the 9th Gradation.
A distance away from whatever lay beyond Extremity!
HUUM!
And even at this moment, his existence burned with interminable determination as he continued his ascent!
The state of his existence was currently unique as after every Fruit of Existence released its endless seas of authority into him, it all surged towards his soul.
But after he had more than ten in a short period of time, the target of some of these vast seas changed.
They came to a halt as if they were making a choice once more.
At such a scene, Noah once more focused with extreme precision.
Would his body and origin follow?
His Origin held unique Aletheian Havens and its own Extremity Vein, even being capable of producing Loot on its own as he even had a wondrous Forge!
Would be...be capable of producing his own Fruits of Existence?
His body held an unsurpassable physiology after building up a foundation others could only dream of!
Would-
BOOM!
His thoughts came to a stop as his Existence released a pulse of light.
After the elevation of his soul continued, the raging authority directed itself towards another part of his existence.
{Your Origin burns with Quintessential ambition.}
{Your Origin is being exposed to an authority that is making it more sublime!}
The authority of Existence itself covered his Aletheian Havens.
His radiant Extremity Vein.
And...
{Havens within Havens, layers within layers.}
{The First Aletheian Haven has begun to form within your Extremity Vein!}
The direction of the authority of the Fruits of Existence divided.
It now flowed into his Soul and Origin with purpose as seeing the quantifiable changes and unquantifiable ones, Noah's strong will sought a conclusion.
{The Weaver of Extremity holds Existential Extremity Authorities within him as he ponders a question.}
He held Quintessence, Infinity, Tyranny, and the Protagonist.
These concepts were Existential.
But as he saw the overflowing threads of the authority of the Fruit of Existence, Noah came to wonder.
{If the weavings of one's Extremes are Existential, what about there own Existence?}
He was seeking the path forward!
One's concepts could become Existential, yes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2919 Heavy! III
paragraphs: Within his Extremity Vein in the depths of his Origin, an Aletheian Haven bloomed as since it was born of Quintessence, Infinity, Tyranny, and Protagonist...could it be anything other than Existential?

Noah may not fully know the intricacies of the elevation of existence to come, but he could definitively say that a Haven that was being constructed by Existential Extremity Authorities would at the very least be something Existential that he could use as a base to catapult himself on to the next stage!
{The Weaver of Extremity ponders on the core of his being.}
He, as the Weaver, pondered about his distinction.
About his being.

He gazed at the Concepts that made him, at the extremes he supported and sought to elevate the weavings of. As he looked at it now, Extremity itself seemed to be an indispensable tool- a weapon one needed to step on the path and traverse if they wanted to grasp anything Existential.
One began by playing around with the understanding of natural laws.
The rulings that made the structure of the reality around them.
Water, fire, earth, air, time, hatred, destruction, life, death.
They touched on such constructs as with Mana, they could even manipulate them to a certain extent as they progressed through different stages of their Lifeform.
From an unranked existence to a Higher Existence, to an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
And then from the cusp of an Aeonic Lifeform, the constructs one only played with...could be expanded towards Extremes!

Noah was playing with Quintessence as only when he expanded it towards Extremity was he truly grasping it. And now, he had already done what others couldn't do in billions of years at the same time he took this concept to Extremity- he made it existential!
The next step was that for those capable, they had to utilize the weavings of their Concepts of Extremity to spurr the weavings of something Existential.
For the Seeds living in the Existential Domains of Legacies, this was an impossibility.
And yet, Noah had made it possible as he was now pioneering the way forward- and all of it was due to nothing else but his Extremes!
Quintessence, Infinity, Tyranny, and the Protagonist to allow for his power to be at such a maddening level.
All of his other Extremes that contributed to him not being found by the Basileus of Al-Abalem and Ignatius.
And the Extremity of Loot...for being capable of extracting the essence of the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.
His extremes were at the core of his achievements.
That's why...he really wanted the translucent light of the Fruit of Existence to bathe his Concepts of Extremity!
{Come!}
HUUM!
He bellowed out.

He spoke commandingly towards none other than the Fragments of the Fruit of Existence as now, millions of fragments gathered above his figure and the figures of the Quintessential Dowager, Ruination, and the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The scene was a stupendous one as they all converged like stellar galaxies, one translucent Singularity after another forming as dozens of Fruits of Existence came to be!
And they all made their descent in the wide open jaws of the Extremity of Quintessence.

He devoured an even larger volume of these terrifying fruits that may have shattered lesser beings with their potent waves of authority, and he did this because so far, the authority of the Fruits of Existence had gone towards expanding the breadth of his soul as thereafter...it went towards his Origin!
The authority held a mind of its own as it seemed to tell Noah that his concepts were so far advanced while his own existence had not caught up.
So he daringly devoured more.
And his existence...
RUUUMBLE!
Radiated a profound vibration.
An interminable desolation!
The seas of translucent energy exploded within him by the dozens as they took but an instant to sense his existence.
They saw his Soul and Origin were already in the process of being bathed by them as even more strands went towards their direction.
But not all.
With their volume being so endlessly vast, at this moment...they surged towards another Aspect of his Existence.
{Your body trembles at the pristine seas of Authority surging into it.}
{Your Physiology rises with endless determination.}
{Your Bloodline feels eons of changes beginning to occur in the span of seconds.}
His Lineage which had just gained a profound elevation with the advent of the Weaver of Extremity seemed like it was about to undergo something even more ridiculous.
Seas of uncontrollable energies radiated towards all of Noah's Aspects of Existence as at this time, he devoured his one-hundredth Fruit of Existence.
None of it was directed towards his Extremes.
And yet his whole existence burned with the majesty and valor and this authority.
All Aspects of his Existence were covered with the light of the Fruit of Existence!
Now, there were many things that Noah still did not fully understand with the Fruit of Existence. He knew there were unquantifiable boons that he had yet to analyze and understand.
And something unquantifiable reared its head at this very moment.
{The Quintessential Annals of Extremity are having a hard time grasping your existence.}
Not from his own body, nor from his weavings.
But it was an alert and prompt from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!
The Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that was tasting and analyzing its own Fruit of Existence had a stern gaze at this moment as she looked at Noah.
As if she could see him right there, but the profound connection they always shared felt just a little fainter at this moment!

It was a terrifying development as in the midst of his Aspects of Existence being enveloped by the authority of the Fruits of Existence, something was occurring outside of Noah's knowledge and control as it made his existence harder to discern from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity themselves!
The construct that held him at the very core.
The construct that was kicked off with a moment of Infinity!
What was happening?
Why did such a development unfold from the devouring of the Fruits of Existence?!
