chapters.title: Chapter 2920 Heavy! IV
paragraphs: His existence was becoming faint to his own Quintessential Annals of Extremity!
Facing such a shocking development, Noah looked deep within himself as his will bathed other his Aspects of Existence.

The major change that had occurred was on the one-hundredth Fruit of Existence being devoured, and that all of his Aspects of Existence were now being bathed by the fantastical light of these fruits Around Noah, vermillion flames raged as he sought to understand why, but truly...he didn't need to.
Because as time passed, it was made clear.

At this moment, the body of his clone was floating serenely in the stellar domain at the depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, his mother, Ruination, and the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven being in front of him as around them, rivers of liquified extremes flowed with multicolored light.
Yet at this moment...
BZZT!
Noah's body sank.
He gazed below to see the space around him become deformed, reality becoming twisted as it was breaking down.
As if...the weight he imposed on it was becoming too much.
At the same time, he finally felt a change within his Existence.
He felt something that was always his, but at this time, it seemed to truly be so.
'This is...records?' His will buzzed as he recognized his records.
His authority as the Weaver of Extremity moved as finally, some sense of what was happening could be made out.
{An unquantifiable boon of the Fruit of Existence is manifesting itself.}
{Your Records are your own.}
{Your weavings are your own.}
{As you approach a new stage of your life, the weavings of your records are being branded onto your Existence.}
What an existence did was always recorded down.

Noah's records were vast and filled with connections to others as they were initially encompassed in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and later transferred to the Quintessential Annals of Extremity once he forged this construct!
It was a type of proof of one's existence.

A type of certificate to say that this being or that being was actually there. And now, a shocking phenomenon was occurring where Noah's Records were being taken from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and into himself!
How massive and intricate were his Records? Their weavings with trillions of others? How could such a thing be supported in any way by him?
He gazed within himself.
He gazed at his Body, Origin, and Soul that were being bathed by the light of the Fruits of Existence.
They...were being elevated and prepared by the Fruits of Existence for something just like this.
{Your Records meld into crevices of your Body, Origin, and Soul.}
In his Quintessential Soul that supported his extremes.
In his blooming Aletheian Haven at the depths of his Extremity Vein.
In his Meridians coursing through his body.
His own existence was slowly coming to contain his own weavings of all his Records.
As this happened, his existence felt...heavy.
Immensely and unfathomably heavy!
Supremely filled with an unfathomable weight!
So much so that he felt his existence- his weavings, his records, his Concepts, his very being...they could affect his surrounding reality.
As if he was an immediate heavy object that was affecting the very spacetime continuum itself, the surrounding space trembled at his mere being!
There was Existence that was the person themselves.
There were Extremes that they expanded that supported them.
Then, there were their Records that foretold everything about them.
All three of these things could be destroyed to end an Entity as only their weavings would remain as traces in the rivers of history.
At this moment, within his Existence that contained his Extremes...Noah was also taking in his Records as everything about him was being wiped from even the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!

This progression caused by the Fruits of Existence caused Noah's mind to think of many things- the incident with Basileus Anaine and the entity who stood above the Legacy of Al-Abalem replaying in his mind.
The moment he had gazed at the weavings of Basileus Anaine, she had known. The moment he even thought of gazing at the weavings of the one above her, he had felt unprecedented danger!
Was this because their weavings were their own? That everything relating to them- their records were fully contained within their Existence?
So when Noah tried to even gaze at their weavings, it was akin to trying to gaze at their very existence with his own two eyes.
Even before he could truly gaze at them, these beings found out!
Noah's mind buzzed at this possibility as he thought about something even larger in the grand scheme of things.
Seeds.
Their records were always contained within the Annals of Extremity.
They were used as a source to elevate and make the Existential Extremity Authorities of their respective domain stronger, with their lives even making the extraction of Fruits of Existence possible!

But...were Seeds actually so prized because of the fact that their Records could be etched and utilized? That when they refined Existential Extremity Authorities, these benefits could be recorded in the Annals of the Existential Domains they were in and utilized for the formation of Fruits of Existence?
Stumbling on this thought, Noah's mind buzzed as he felt the heaviness of his existence increase even more.

Why did the Basileus need Seeds? Why did Legacies oversee Existential Domains when they themselves should have the most proficiency and purity of their respective Extremity Authorities? This seemed to be a plausible answer!
As Noah stumbled on this, the figure of the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven spoke up at this moment as her eyes were actually filled with a sense of worry.
{I feel less and less of you with every passing second.}
More and more of his Records were being taken from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and layered onto himself as there were a great deal of things to figure out.
Of immediate consequence was that at this moment, his body was radiating a heavy new pressure.
A pressure that caused his surrounding reality to shudder as just by existing in it, it seemed to be distorting and breaking around him!
He had to control it.
He had to control the weight of his existence as at this moment, it was infinitely heavy!

chapters.title: Chapter 2921 Heavy! V
paragraphs: Immeasurably heavy.

This was how Noah felt as the authority of 100 Fruits of Existence raged within his existence, taking his records from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and layering them unto himself ever so slowly!
His mind worked fast.
The distinction of the Weaver of Extremity was not for show.
And this was expressed by none other than his Main Body that had appeared within the Supernal Haven of Oceanus.
A gorgeous blue sea lay all around him.
Quintillions upon quintillions of Lifeforms were stretched within Oceanus, this and the Nether Haven of Oceanus counterparts actually being the ones with the most Lifeforms.
The seas across these Havens were nigh endless.
Thus, the number of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts appearing here was the most abundant compared to any other Haven!

Initially, Noah's will was spreading out to cover this vast Haven before he imposed one of his Existential Extremity Authorities onto the Apokalypsis Beasts to eradicate them, but as he felt his main body cause the waters in his surroundings to churn at his mere presence while his surrounding reality began to distort and flicker...
He closed his eyes.

The Weaver of Extremity closed his eyes and felt his Existence that was spreading out and exerting its effects all around him- purely because it was ballooning and expanding, becoming even mightier due to his own records!
Since it was being like this, he simply simplified it as if he had attained a new power that was spreading out in all directions.
For now, he only had to reign it in as if he focused it onto a central point within his body...
HUUM!
The sheer pressure Noah emitted all around disappeared as he pulled this pressure into himself.
He came to centralize it at the center of his Existence as after that, he tried to freely move it across his body.

This heaviness contained everything about him. His Existence. His Extremes. A small portion of his Records. He understood that now as at this moment, instead of continuing to stretch his will out across Oceanus and impose one of his Existential Extremity Authorities, he commanded the heaviness that represented his existence.
He allowed it to weave across his body and become centered on his right foot- having raised it before he brought it down with force!
As if he was stomping something with his very existence.
And the selected target was none other than all Existential Apokalypsis Beasts in the surrounding domain as Noah simply thought of their weavings!
RUUUMBLE!
The reality within Oceanus where he had stomped his foot churned.
And then across Oceanus, wherever an Apokalypsis Beasts stood...an unfathomable weight seemed to press down on them as they didn't even have the time to adjust their bodies to a higher Gradation.

As if their robust bodies covered by potent Existential Extremity Authority were mere eggs or crumpled paper, they became flattened by an irresistible force- becoming compressed to the size of a grain of sand in an instant!
Across Oceanus!
But it didn't stop there.

Noah had imposed his increasingly heavy existence on the surrounding domain. So shockingly, his existence which had disgustingly grown to a shocking stage at this moment...leaked into half of the Supernal Haven of Elera and a quarter of the Supernal Haven of Penumbra nearby as the Apokalypsis Beasts in these areas also faced a similar fate!
They became flattened and destroyed to the size of grains of sand instantly.
This was Noah's power.
This was his existence!
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 123,984,665 Fragments of the Endocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 109,884,550 Fragments of the Mesocarp of a Fruit of Existence!}
{The Extremity of Loot has extracted from the target 111,813,228...}
Prompts of Loot overflowed.

And Noah understood his power just a bit more as the clean up around the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, as well as the Planar Palisades of Extremity...were about to unfold at an even faster rate.
He just affirmed that when it came to lesser beings, he could entirely erase their existence by superimposing the weight of his existence.
It meant that the Basileus of Al-Abalem and Ignatius who enjoyed who knew how many Fruits of Existence could also do the same to him!

He had to understand the Boons of these Fruits more. He had to resolve today's unfolding Apokalypsis and then dedicate his time to truly study how his existence was being changed, and he could then prepare for the days of Apokalypsis that would follow.
But there were also other intricacies to keep in mind.
One particular intricacy was Noah's actions after he destroyed the Existential Apokalypsis Beasts within an entire Haven.
Within Oceanus and the affected domains of Elera and Penumbra, after he entirely erased the presence of the Apokalypsis Beasts within them...
A second passed before more began to appear as space tore to reveal a deluge of records.
But there were significantly fewer.
Less than a fourth of the original amount of Apokalypsis Beasts that were present before!

Noah had confirmed this since the first Haven where he erased all of them and then the subsequent ones that came after- where after three rounds of decimating newly risen Apokalypsis Beasts, no more descended within that Haven!
As if for designated domains, there were only a specific number of Apokalypsis Beasts that could be released.
And this led Noah to make another assumption that there would likely be a limit to the number of Apokalypsis Beasts for the First Day!
As he kept clearing them, no more would come.
Not until the day was over, and a new one began.

It meant the number of Fruits of Existence that he could obtain were not endless, and he had to ensure that at the end of these 9 days, he wouldn't just survive...but be ready to face the Legions of Dikastes of Extremity and the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius above them.
After all, the prophecy stated so.
A prophecy he made...but it stated so!

chapters.title: Chapter 2922 Development! I
paragraphs: The number of Fruits of Existence was limited- so Noah had to make sure he had another source when Mors Apokalypsis was over.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven was the Prime candidate to produce the Fruits of Existence, but it wasn't the only one.
There was also Noah.
He held his Soul, and he held his Infinite Forge within it.
At this moment as his Aspects of Existence experienced the baptism and his heaviness just increased more and more, threads of their authority flowed into the Infinite Forge.
Over the next hours and days, would Noah be able to see the elevation of the Infinite Forge to a level where it may produce fragments of the Fruits of Existence?
On a longer time scale after he bathed in an uncountable number of Fruits of Existence, would he not be capable of producing them himself?!
His eyes burned with ambition as he allowed the authorities of the 100 Fruits of Existence to rage across his existence.
He monitored his thinning connection to the Quintessential Annals of Extremity as more and more of his records were pulled.
He focused on his connection with the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and what consequences there could be from all this.

Threads of his weaving spread all around as he didn't consume any more Fruits of Existence for now, only collecting their fragments and converging them to become whole as a steady stream of a few fruits flowed to Ruination- Noah gauging just how many it would take before this construct gained the capability to multiply them herself.
As all of these pieces came together, time began to pass.

In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, cylindrical pathways showed Legions of Apokalypsis Beasts coming through as the Defenders of these Lands fought to protect it, some beings shining much more than others.
Then, there were the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains where Noah was rapidly spreading into.
In the Haven of Perdition within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.

The Extremity Lineage of the Kukul Butterfly pulsed with beauty and horror as they sought to defend those at the First Gradation and below, but their Primogenitors quickly became pushed back by the beasts that matched their power- heavy losses beginning to accumulate!
But just before this could continue...
SHAA!
The folds of non-reality tore as a being stepped out.
Devilishly handsome in nature and majestic in stature, he pressed his foot down as if he was putting pressure on the whole Haven.
And his existence pressed down as all attacking Apokalypsis Beasts were flattened.
It was a scene that the Kukul Butterflies would never forget in their lives as moments later, a vermillion light covered them as they were forcefully taken away!
Away from all this.
In the Nether Haven of Genesis surrounded by gorgeous white rivers.
The visage of Noah appeared here as his actions were carried out.

In the vast stretches of the Planar Palisades of Extremity, his clones stretched out endlessly as undiscovered Planes of Existence became discovered, and throngs of Apokalypsis Beasts became annihilated!
The momentum of the Extremity of Quintessence did not decrease one bit as it only increased, and a reality that could have never been thought about just hours ago was gradually becoming a reality.
The assimilation of quintillions upon quintillions of Entities from the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains and into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The Seeds that were being utilized to farm Fruits of Existence in this domain were all being taken into his home as did this not mean he would gain this capability himself?

And even more, the Existential Dungeon System was being utilized in abundance, with two Dungeon Monoliths laid out in each Haven between Vacuous and Vitalis as on this day, multiple Dungeon Breaks would occur.
This was the current capability of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

But with them, a percentage of these Existential Domains would begin to be devoured on this day as when the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius return to observe the results of their Mors Apokalypsis after 9 days...would anything remain?
The future was a tumultuous one.
But the first day of Mors Apokalypsis...was not a suspenseful one!
The river of time flowed.
An hour passed.
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the atmosphere of all surroundings trembled with ever-increasing waves of authority.
Near the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, atop the Aletheian Haven of Avalon.
Emperor Shao gazed around him with a stern expression like many others as scenes of what had just occurred not too long ago flashed across his eyes.
After terrifying white beasts descended, he came.
And with a flicker of existential brilliance, he ended the apocalyptic beasts.
With a flicker of Vermillion light, all of them also disappeared. He ended the war that simply.
That easily.
Now, Emperor Shao appeared here amidst many others as uniquely, he was rather remarkable in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains until just moments ago.
Now, he was just one among many who were gazing up at Legions of powerful defenders that were wiping out the last remnants of Apokalypsis Beasts flowing across Cylindrical pathways!
Among them, shockingly, Primogenitors and Legends they had only heard of from tales could actually be seen.
It was a surreal reality.
But it was one that showed the result of the first day of Mors Apokalypsis.
Approximately an hour after it started, the presence of Apokalypsis Beasts was entirely thin as very little kept on appearing.
The legions of defenders were breathing heavily as for them, it felt like every part of their existence was put to the test!
But of some of them, gazes of victory and glory shone.
The majestic visage of the Primogenitor of Steel seemed larger than most others as at this moment, he waved his hands to gaze at tens of thousands of Fragments of the Fruits of Existence.
A demoness was laughing valiantly amidst her exhaustion as her head turned towards the far distance.
She was gazing at...the Banner of Quintessence as she wanted to see.
She wanted to know just how far she had risen after all this!
But a moment later...
Her eyes trembled.
This was because the name that was always there on the Banner of Quintessence, the grand distinction of the Extremity of Quintessence...it was no longer there.
The ranking of the Extremity of Quintessence was gone!

chapters.title: Chapter 2923 Development! II
paragraphs: It was a shocking scene!
Somehow, the Extremity of Quintessence who always took first place was no longer there, and in his place, after overtaking all others...
Was none other than the Extremity of Nepotism.
Henry Osmont!
He leaned into his identity as after accepting who he was, as the being closest in purity to the Weaver of Extremity...others were left behind.
He took the number one spot as at this moment, he could be seen surrounded by a prideful Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, Hyperion, and a few other distinguished beings.
Strands of Vermillion flames covered his body as he seemed to be brimming with purpose- not seeming the least bit exhausted as the others around him were!
And following him on the Banner of Quintessence were names others could not deny.
This was due to their power simply being too obscene as it was connected to the Extremity of Quintessence, the second on the Banner of Quintessence being Barbatos!
Below her, a few of the other Queens followed as the only dazzling new name that drew eyes was one of the most powerful past Primogenitors of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
The Primogenitor of Steel came 9th on the Banner of Quintessence!

His figure was near other Primogenitors who were looking up at him, his body covered by a brilliant bronze silver hue as he seemed like a majestic statue that was thinking innumerable thoughts right now.
And then, yet another name made itself distinguished in a shocking turn of events, maintaining its high in the ranking while being in the midst of utter monsters!
It was none other than Lilith, the Daughter of Hatred, actually clinching the 10th spot after competing with such terrifying entities.
Top 10.
She actually stayed within such ranks as following her, the names of Hyperion, Commander Feng, Ishtar, Sargon, and the Cimmerian Architect followed.
These were the entities who had distinguished themselves.
And their rewards were mighty as apart from everything else, they had attained something that they couldn't wait to utilize.
Lilith shook her head from the disappearance of the name of the Extremity of Quintessence from the Banner of Quintessence as she came to focus on the critical reward to come out of all of this.
Something none of them would have been able to obtain if it weren't for the weavings of the Extremity of Loot.
Lilith was among the first to wave her hands and reveal...dazzling fragments of Seeds of the Fruit of Existence.
Followed by Endocarps. Mesocarps. Exocarps.
Tens of thousands of such pieces swirled above her with a glimmer as her soul felt a strong pull!

She wasn't the only one as the visage of Henry also waved his hands to cause a stellar swirling of Fragments of the Fruit of Existence above him, clenching his fist a moment later as they began to converge them into a lustrous translucent light.
So did such a convergence occur in front of the Primogenitor of Steel.
In front of Barbatos and the other Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In front of Lilith.
A dazzling translucent fruit formed.
Something utterly impossible for beings like them!
But the Extremity of Loot made this impossibility a reality.
With trembling hands, Lilith's hand rose as she grasped the translucent fruit in front of her...and instantly took a bite!
Around the same time that the Defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven took bites of Fruits of Existences.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven was undergoing even grander changes as over the past hour, multiple successive Dungeon Breaks had occurred!
This meant that more and more of the Existential Domains of Vacuous and Vitalis were devoured and assimilated by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, with a single unique thing occurring from before.
That was the fact that none of the pristine lands where the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius resided were able to be stolen like the first time!
As if Mors Apokalypsis had truly isolated these two lands.
It meant that in the coming days, even if Noah managed to devour more and more of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, he would still not be able to do so 100%.

The lands where the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius resided would be the last lands he didn't get a hold of, and if he wished to swallow all of Vitalis and Vacuous- these lands would have to follow!

That was a dream for the future. For now, there was the fact that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was experiencing the most fundamental changes as the past Natural Laws and Decreta that made it, the authorities of Havens that made it...they were shining with interminable splendor as their extremes eerily seemed to be going towards Existential.
They were becoming more and more robust as they devoured something that even at this moment was not fully understood!
At the same time, there was Noah himself.
He had absorbed the full raging authorities of 100 Fruits of Existence as truly, his aspects of existence were being reformed to a stage even he didn't fully grasp yet.

At the same time, over half of his Records were imposed on himself and taken away from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, his ranking in the Banner of Quintessence ultimately fading away as for him...this ranking was not a distinction he needed.
Who else in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven stood above him? Who else was more Quintessential?
So this was not at all an issue as the main ordeal to grasp the results of...was the fact that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could feel less and less of him as time went by.
And yet even though the sensation felt thinner, after a certain point in time while Noah's existence was being elevated, a dazzling new prompt arose.
{Your weavings of Records, Extremes, and any complex bindings are becoming truly yours- not etched down in any outside Records.}

{The bindings between you and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven exist and do not exist at the same time, making it impossible for any entities to locate the Infinite Hyperversal Haven through you or your people, and vice versa.}

This meant that more and more of the Existential Domains of Vacuous and Vitalis were devoured and assimilated by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, with a single unique thing occurring from before.
That was the fact that none of the pristine lands where the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius resided were able to be stolen like the first time!
As if Mors Apokalypsis had truly isolated these two lands.
It meant that in the coming days, even if Noah managed to devour more and more of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, he would still not be able to do so 100%.

The lands where the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius resided would be the last lands he didn't get a hold of, and if he wished to swallow all of Vitalis and Vacuous- these lands would have to follow!
That was a dream for the future.

For now, there was the fact that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was experiencing the most fundamental changes as the past Natural Laws and Decreta that made it, the authorities of Havens that made it...they were shining with interminable splendor as their extremes eerily seemed to be going towards Existential.
They were becoming more and more robust as they devoured something that even at this moment was not fully understood!
At the same time, there was Noah himself.
He had absorbed the full raging authorities of 100 Fruits of Existence as truly, his aspects of existence were being reformed to a stage even he didn't fully grasp yet.

At the same time, over half of his Records were imposed on himself and taken away from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, his ranking in the Banner of Quintessence ultimately fading away as for him...this ranking was not a distinction he needed.
Who else in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven stood above him?
Who else was more Quintessential?
So this was not at all an issue as the main ordeal to grasp the results of...was the fact that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could feel less and less of him as time went by.
And yet even though the sensation felt thinner, after a certain point in time while Noah's existence was being elevated, a dazzling new prompt arose.
{Your weavings of Records, Extremes, and any complex bindings are becoming truly yours- not etched down in any outside Records.}

{The bindings between you and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven exist and do not exist at the same time, making it impossible for any entities to locate the Infinite Hyperversal Haven through you or your people, and vice versa.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2924 Development! III
paragraphs: Yes. An additional protective layer was what Noah attained through his Records being branded to himself as it was really preparing him for when he faced existences who had overcome the bounds of Extremity and held means others could not even fathom.
This...was the boon between him and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that came to be.
Then, there was Ruination.
As the last threads of the translucent waves of authority merged into him, so did the threads of 50 Fruits of Existence fully assimilate into Ruination!
Her figure opened its eyes to gaze at Noah at this moment.
Her whole demeanor and visage seemed ethereal and otherworldly as she most definitely could not even be considered within the bounds of High Grade Armaments.
She wanted to express her intent as without even moving her lips...
|Master.|
Her intent weaved out and expressed her words for her.
Noah looked at her closely and nodded in recognition as she continued, knowing exactly what he wanted to hear!
|50 was enough to gain a sense of resonance and understanding with them. As it stands now, I can multiply the fragments of the Fruits of Existence by a factor of 1.5. No more, no less.|
Her intent was filled with utmost confidence.
Her words were those of pride and power for having been allowed to come this far by the being in front of her!
Noah smiled as without any words, he waved his hands.
And stellar waves of light passed across the weavings of Records as the boons of millions upon millions of Fragments Noah had collected in the last hour from Apokalypsis Beasts changed hands.
The result of his actions in moving across Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!
How many Entities had he saved? How many beasts had he killed? The number was too high to count as the effects were glorious to quantify.
The effects of the quintillions of entities he had saved would show over time as his Existential Extremity Authorities would only continue to be refined and purified.
Over time.
But...did Noah really need that much time?
Because after the breadth of his existence was elevated like this, and the effects of the Fruits of Existence about to be devoured by him...Noah knew he was about to cut off a lot of time!
HUUM!
Ruination floated staunchly.
She accepted what Noah threw at her across their connection as she shone with a blinding translucent light!
Her existence trembled.
What she was doing was something so far above what she should be capable of, yet her nature allowed for a semblance of replication of the Fragments of the Fruit of Existence.
This mere semblance allowed for the multiplicative factor of 1.5!
A million Fragments of the Fruit of Existence would go in, and 1.5 million would be spat out.
And this..was exactly what she began to do at this moment as within a mere ten seconds, the first set of fragments multiplied my Ruination flowed back to Noah.
And before they were even all the way there...
HUUM!
Noah's authority already had them dancing on his palm as they began converging, and by the time they reached him...
They were already dazzling translucent fruits.
Ones that he opened his jaws wide and began to devour!
He let loose as he had no worries about his existence becoming shattered from the sheer raging waves of authority.
After all, it had just been strengthened to withstand all of this!
Around Noah, gorgeous lights of majesty radiated outwards.
And his smile only became deeper.
This was because as seas of translucent energies exploded within his existence, he finally felt tendrils of these authorities go towards...Quintessence.
Towards Infinity, Tyranny, and the Protagonist.
The light of the Fruits of Existence finally began to cover his concepts at this moment!
And such a thing was akin to lighting up sparks in a flammable sea as Noah felt a booming explosion within his existence.
He felt his extremes cheer with desire as his Manifestation in the Waters of the Gradations of Extremity disappeared once more.
Millions upon millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures surrounded him.
Flames of the Weaver of Extremity surrounded him.
And then...he felt like he came across a thin film of light that only took an instant for him to burst through, and thereafter, everything changed.
His vision opened to a brand new location.
Serene waves of extremely clear waters could be seen all around.
But this wasn't all.
The waters were not empty.
In these calm and serene waters, Noah saw extremely pure streams of Vitalis and Vacuous converging.
Well, it actually wasn't too accurate to call these pure streams of energy Vitalis and Vacuous because they felt closer to being a pure authority of existence itself!
Of the records of existence and achievements of countless entities across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!
Here, Noah saw translucent branches holding half formed and fully formed Fruits of Existence.
Here, Noah saw obsidian and white chains connected to the heads of terrifying Dikastes of Extremity whose Serpentine eyes and wings...were extremely closed and folded in.
As if they were hibernating.
As if they were forced to be in this state by an action taken not too long ago!
And what action could it be other than Mors Apokalypsis?!
Noah's will spread out as he observed hundreds of Dikastes of Extremity stretched out all around these waters that were none other than the waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity!
The Ninth Gradation that no seeds were allowed to step into across Vitalis and Vacuous.
Streams of pure Existential Extremity Authority gathered here as it seemed endless, and there was an overabundance of half formed and some fully formed Fruits of Existence!
It was a domain that seemed immeasurably far to cross as when Noah gazed higher and higher, he couldn't see the ends of these waters.
But they became thinner and thinner. Clearer and clearer.
As if crossing this endless distance...may just allow one to break free of these waters.
To reach an endless sky that only pristine entities grasped!

chapters.title: Chapter 2925 Development! IV
paragraphs: It was a scene that was ingrained in Noah's mind.
The single extending chains atop the Dikastes of Extremity he had seen before- each of them still extending upwards towards whoever bound and chained these Dikastes of Extremity.
The dazzling Fruits of Existence he had began to accumulate across a myriad of branches, their numbers extending outwards!
They could all be found within the waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
Waters that no Seeds were allowed to reach over the eons as this was where they began harvesting the Fruits of Existence!
But how were the waters signifying the Gradations of Extremity connected to the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains, and the Aeonic Annals of Extremity?

Noah could affirm with certainty their connection as within these waters, he came across many beings who were chained and rising through them slowly...but they were all from the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
As if these waters of the Gradations of Extremity only represented the beings of these two domains.
They were not in any way connected to other Existential Domains under the watch of other Legacies.

Many thoughts passed over Noah's mind at this as a few pathways were shown, but as his existence continued to receive a heavy baptism, he took a moment to actualize the achievement that he had truly just arrived here.
The Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
So easily.
So simply!
And now...
HUUM!
He moved towards the translucent branches showing a Fruit of Existence that had fully formed, appearing before it to pluck it out as...
POP!
With a glimmer of authority, the Fruit came into his hands.
He smiled brilliantly at this as thereafter, his body floated in front of the massive but immovable Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity.
The crystalline white skin seemed tougher than High Grade Armaments of Extremity as even while in a state of Hibernation, they gave off an oppressive air.
He never got the chance to go against these beings as he was too weak against them just hours ago, and now he should have arrived on the same stage as them!
But they were unique constructs that weren't any common Lifeforms, and even though Noah did not get a chance to fight them now in his elevated state...
{The Extremity of Loot pulses with desire.}
{The Extremity of Greed and the Extremity of Devouring say that a meal is presenting itself right before you!}
A devilish glint shone in Noah's eyes as akin to a predator enamored by their prey, authority boomed from him and came to envelop the Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity before his eyes.
As he sought to devour it!
As he sought to break it down and understand it!
Even though it didn't have the Fruit of Existence to power it up, what challenge could it pose?
BZZT!
{You are beginning to break down and devour a construct born of immeasurably advanced constituents.}
{Proceed with caution, as there are existential markings and brandings on this construct not belonging to any of the Legacies you have come across.}
Existential makings and brandings.

Noah's extremes cautioned him as he felt them all flow across his existence, with his soul expressing Oraculum, Indefatigable, Vitalistic...all of his previous Dynamis of Extremity could all be felt at once.

They warned him to be careful as Noah now knew how even peering at the weavings of others could alert them, and it seemed these Dikastes of Extremity were not local to the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius.
They were constructs forged elsewhere and seemingly traded amongst Legacies- bought and sold in states of Hibernation for them to be utilized in their Existential Domains.
It meant that they didn't begin as Vitalis or Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity, but were changed into this after they arrived in these domains!
Noah felt the influx of this information come in as he proceeded slowly, his authority of a predator covering the massive Dikastes before him as he reveled in what boons may come from it!
As the Extremity of Quintessence stepped on the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were making their own gains.

After devouring a Fruit of Existence, those who were in the lower rungs of the Gradations of Extremity found themselves rapidly shooting up to achieve high Gradations that were mere dreams not too long ago!
Henry opened his eyes with a flash of brilliance as he emanated powerful waves of power at the peak of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, the Eighth Gradation only a sliver away.
The vast majority of others jumped across the Gradations as being like Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, the Seer of Sima, or Svetlana had all stepped into the Sixth Gradation of Extremity!
Even the visage of the demoness, Lilith, stood at this stage as she came truly far.

At this time, the vibrant eyes of the Primogenitor of Steel also opened as he felt his existence, his body shining with interminable waves at the peak of the Eighth Gradation of Extremity as he knew...the Ninth would not be too far away.
He smiled as he looked around him.
At the deluge of beings who had arrived at new stages of power, this whole scene being unlike anything that could play out in the past Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
It was a scene of serenity and peace as if they weren't in a process of Apocalypse- a scene one couldn't truly come across just days ago.
He gazed at all of them as in his deep voice, he spoke.
{Shall we get to know each other's fables? Stories of who we were and who we aspire to be in the future?}
At this momentary period of peace, the Primogenitor of Steel was the first to move as he sought to form connections and understanding with the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Henry and the others gazed up to meet his gaze as soon after, numerous intents unfolded as Entities coming from different eons and times for a chance to mingle amongst each other!

chapters.title: Chapter 2926 Development! V
paragraphs: Weavings were formed between the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

At the same time, the Entity to bring all of this together was enjoying the baptism of a few hundred Fruits of Existence that after being focused on his Aspects of Existence- the Authority of these fruits now also flowed to his Extremes!
And this...brought about its own changes as it acted like a trigger point for Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities that were already rising up in a robust fashion on their own.
Quintessence, Infinity, Tyranny, and the Protagonist exploded with millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures, and their Weavings became all that much more complex!
He had yet to urge any other ones to jump towards the Existential level, seeking to stabilize things as they were even though the breadth of his soul continued to be expanded.
But as his Existential Extremity Authorities increased in their weavings, so did the expanded breadth of his soul gradually become filled.
He continued to monitor and analyze all of these changes as an hour into the devouring of the hibernating Dikastes of Extremity in the waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity...
HUUM!
His existence buzzed.
An extreme within him stirred.
{The Extremity of the Protagonist blazes with brilliance and states that it has attained enough distinction to continue cementing what it stands for.}
An Aurum brilliance overflowed as the Protagonist flared its fangs once more!
The Protagonist had made way for Noah's distinction of the Weaver of Extremity and Prophecies, and it now rose once more as what did it wish to do?!
{The Weavings of the Protagonist, Quintessence, Infinity, Plot, and Fables are resonating amidst the elevation to bring about a critical feature for the Protagonist.}
The Protagonist recruited the dazzling influence of Infinity, Quintessence, Plot, and Fables!
Within Noah, millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures pulsed as...
{Under the guidance of multiple extremes led by the Protagonist, the feature of Existential Proofreader is being born.}
WAA!
Noah's pupils dilated.
Existential Proofreader.
Such a daring set of words came together as what exactly did it wish to accomplish?
The Aurum glow of the Protagonist bloomed within him as information flowed freely.

{You can read wisps of the unfolding of your most probable Unrecorded Fable for the next 24 hours. With enough exertion of your authority, the unfolding of these fables can fall under your control. In addition to reading about your Unrecorded Fable, you can choose to distort the weavings of Records, Extremes, and Existence to jump forward from your currently unfolding Fable and into your future Fable, skipping over points and receiving memories of how events unfolded until you reached the point you jumped into.}
{As the Protagonist, you can dictate the flow of your own story. As one who holds his records within himself, many more possibilities open up before you.}
A dazzling feature unfolded amidst this brilliance.
And it seemed like one of the reasons it was able to come out successfully was because of Noah's Records slowly becoming layered onto himself and not any Annals of Extremity!
Noah's will didn't delay as he tried this new feature right away.
{Existential Proofreader}.
Millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures cycled and burned.
And before Noah's eyes...
{Your Fable, not yet recorded in your Existence, continues.}
In his shining eyes, illusory scenes began to play out one after another like a high definition film.
{Under your guidance and extremes, with the aid of Fruits of Existence, more and more Entities at the Eighth Gradation of Extremity appear within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}

{The refinement and purification of your Existential Extremity Authorities because of this increases at a Quintessential pace as you feel like the extraction of pure Existential Authority to form Fruits of Existence may soon be possible.}

{As your Aspects of Existence continue their baptism with the translucent light of the Fruits of Existence, your Lineage finally reaches a critical point and begins its long transformation into an Existential Lineage.}

{After hours of careful and steady devouring and breakdown of the Hibernating body of the Dikastes of Extremity, you finally make an advancement. The authority of your weavings reaches the core of the Dikastes of Extremity as there, an insignia shining with a brilliant existential light stops your advancement.}
{Oh?}
The scenes flitting across his eyes came to a stop as he focused on this point of his Unrecorded Fable.
Hours from now.
Noah wanted to test out how he as the Protagonist could control his own fable, seeking to jump across the weavings of space and time to appear hours from this point!
HUUM!

And an Aurum colored glow wrapped around his existence as an instant later, he felt like his consciousness delved into a blinding endless golden sea, everything fading away before him as when he opened his eyes again...
The weavings of reality felt different.

A sense of distortion settled as Noah felt like his existence had jumped from one point of time towards another, but unlike any other times before when he gazed at his records or went back in time...he jumped forward!
He left behind the weavings of Records, Extremes, and Existence itself to come towards his set future Fable!
And he looked ahead of him as his eyes brightened up.
He saw the Hibernating Body of the Dikastes of Extremity splayed open, its wings torn and eaten away while its chest was fractured with a significant amount of its structure missing.
And towards the depths of this chest cavity, there lay a silently spinning circular crystalline structure that held a single insignia.
An insignia representing a single word that Noah made it out to be...
Archimedes!
Noah stared at this insignia with scrutiny and care as from it, he felt immense danger.

Just like when he thought of the weavings of Basileus Anaine and the one above her and they noticed, he felt like if he touched this circular core with this Insignia, he would be poking a hornet's nest he could not yet handle.
No.

He had to first make sure all of his Records were sublimated to himself and away from any Annals, and even likely exceed the bounds of the Gradations of Extremity before he could be confident in viewing the weavings of Entities within the ranks of Legacies, and those behind the Dikastes of Extremity!

Because at this moment, Noah could foresee that the insignia etched on the core of the Dikastes of Extremity...was likely the group or Entity manufacturing these terrifying Entities that managed and oversaw Existential Domains.
Archimedes!

sentences.text: Weavings were formed between the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

At the same time, the Entity to bring all of this together was enjoying the baptism of a few hundred Fruits of Existence that after being focused on his Aspects of Existence- the Authority of these fruits now also flowed to his Extremes!
And this...brought about its own changes as it acted like a trigger point for Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities that were already rising up in a robust fashion on their own.
Quintessence, Infinity, Tyranny, and the Protagonist exploded with millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures, and their Weavings became all that much more complex!
He had yet to urge any other ones to jump towards the Existential level, seeking to stabilize things as they were even though the breadth of his soul continued to be expanded.
But as his Existential Extremity Authorities increased in their weavings, so did the expanded breadth of his soul gradually become filled.
He continued to monitor and analyze all of these changes as an hour into the devouring of the hibernating Dikastes of Extremity in the waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity...
HUUM!
His existence buzzed.
An extreme within him stirred.
{The Extremity of the Protagonist blazes with brilliance and states that it has attained enough distinction to continue cementing what it stands for.}
An Aurum brilliance overflowed as the Protagonist flared its fangs once more!
The Protagonist had made way for Noah's distinction of the Weaver of Extremity and Prophecies, and it now rose once more as what did it wish to do?!
{The Weavings of the Protagonist, Quintessence, Infinity, Plot, and Fables are resonating amidst the elevation to bring about a critical feature for the Protagonist.}
The Protagonist recruited the dazzling influence of Infinity, Quintessence, Plot, and Fables!
Within Noah, millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures pulsed as...
{Under the guidance of multiple extremes led by the Protagonist, the feature of Existential Proofreader is being born.}
WAA!
Noah's pupils dilated.
Existential Proofreader.
Such a daring set of words came together as what exactly did it wish to accomplish?
The Aurum glow of the Protagonist bloomed within him as information flowed freely.
{You can read wisps of the unfolding of your most probable Unrecorded Fable for the next 24 hours.
With enough exertion of your authority, the unfolding of these fables can fall under your control.

In addition to reading about your Unrecorded Fable, you can choose to distort the weavings of Records, Extremes, and Existence to jump forward from your currently unfolding Fable and into your future Fable, skipping over points and receiving memories of how events unfolded until you reached the point you jumped into.}
{As the Protagonist, you can dictate the flow of your own story.
As one who holds his records within himself, many more possibilities open up before you.}
A dazzling feature unfolded amidst this brilliance.
And it seemed like one of the reasons it was able to come out successfully was because of Noah's Records slowly becoming layered onto himself and not any Annals of Extremity!
Noah's will didn't delay as he tried this new feature right away.
{Existential Proofreader}.
Millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures cycled and burned.
And before Noah's eyes...
{Your Fable, not yet recorded in your Existence, continues.}
In his shining eyes, illusory scenes began to play out one after another like a high definition film.
{Under your guidance and extremes, with the aid of Fruits of Existence, more and more Entities at the Eighth Gradation of Extremity appear within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}

{The refinement and purification of your Existential Extremity Authorities because of this increases at a Quintessential pace as you feel like the extraction of pure Existential Authority to form Fruits of Existence may soon be possible.}

{As your Aspects of Existence continue their baptism with the translucent light of the Fruits of Existence, your Lineage finally reaches a critical point and begins its long transformation into an Existential Lineage.}
{After hours of careful and steady devouring and breakdown of the Hibernating body of the Dikastes of Extremity, you finally make an advancement.
The authority of your weavings reaches the core of the Dikastes of Extremity as there, an insignia shining with a brilliant existential light stops your advancement.}
{Oh?}
The scenes flitting across his eyes came to a stop as he focused on this point of his Unrecorded Fable.
Hours from now.
Noah wanted to test out how he as the Protagonist could control his own fable, seeking to jump across the weavings of space and time to appear hours from this point!
HUUM!

And an Aurum colored glow wrapped around his existence as an instant later, he felt like his consciousness delved into a blinding endless golden sea, everything fading away before him as when he opened his eyes again...
The weavings of reality felt different.

A sense of distortion settled as Noah felt like his existence had jumped from one point of time towards another, but unlike any other times before when he gazed at his records or went back in time...he jumped forward!
He left behind the weavings of Records, Extremes, and Existence itself to come towards his set future Fable!
And he looked ahead of him as his eyes brightened up.
He saw the Hibernating Body of the Dikastes of Extremity splayed open, its wings torn and eaten away while its chest was fractured with a significant amount of its structure missing.
And towards the depths of this chest cavity, there lay a silently spinning circular crystalline structure that held a single insignia.
An insignia representing a single word that Noah made it out to be...
Archimedes!
Noah stared at this insignia with scrutiny and care as from it, he felt immense danger.

Just like when he thought of the weavings of Basileus Anaine and the one above her and they noticed, he felt like if he touched this circular core with this Insignia, he would be poking a hornet's nest he could not yet handle.
No.

He had to first make sure all of his Records were sublimated to himself and away from any Annals, and even likely exceed the bounds of the Gradations of Extremity before he could be confident in viewing the weavings of Entities within the ranks of Legacies, and those behind the Dikastes of Extremity!

Because at this moment, Noah could foresee that the insignia etched on the core of the Dikastes of Extremity...was likely the group or Entity manufacturing these terrifying Entities that managed and oversaw Existential Domains.
Archimedes!

chapters.title: Chapter 2927 Jumper! I
paragraphs: Before the distinction of those behind the Dikastes of Extremity, Noah only gazed coldly as he calculated many things!
Outside of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, there were likely grand and intricate domains that the Legacies ruled over.

Noah felt like he was just stepping on the cusp of these organizational forces at this moment, and he had to proceed carefully to make sure that he didn't alert any Entities that he could not handle yet.
But he also had to be ready.
And understanding what lay in front of him, as well as being capable of fully countering it...would be ideal.
So he gazed at the half devoured Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity as his eyes flared with brilliance!
And his extremes answered.
{Quintessence states that nothing can fall outside the scope of its understanding.}
{The Extremities of Loot, Devouring, and Greed state that they have made sufficient gains from breaking down the body of the current Dikastes of Extremity!}
{The Extremities of Systems, Forging, and Smithing state their desire to design a new construct.}
{The Extremity of Cheats rouses with interest and offers its help!}
One after another, Noah's extremes flowed out with their own desires as their goal was a singular one.
The replication of the Dikastes of Extremity they were seeing before them- the reconstruction of something that was likely a product traded between Legacies to take care of Existential Domains!
{Cheats smiles with mischief and initiates the start of Project Existential Automaton.}
WAA!
Project Existential Automaton!
It was a grand undertaking as before Noah's eyes, a cerulean blueprint of the massive visage of a Dikastes of Extremity formed- this being all the parts that were just devoured and broken down.

As the rest of this body was devoured, this blueprint would be even more complete as thereafter, the results of this recently enacted project would be something that others would be dumbfounded to even look at.

His extremes moved with their own weavings as they decided on the materials, the core, and the very weaving of something new- Project Existential Automaton kicking off hours after Noah's entry into the Gradations of Extremity.
At the core of such an Automaton...
His extremes buzzed as a moment later, a Colorless light bathed the blueprint.
Quintessence.
From what Noah could tell, the constructs of the Dikastes of Extremity began in a neutral state before they were influenced to match the Existential Domains they would be residing in.
The most appropriate core material for such a construct for him...would no doubt have to be Quintessence.
Other ingredients and materials would soon follow as Project Existential Automaton kicked off with a flurry of Existential Extremity Authorities!
After affirming this, Noah's eyes blazed with brilliance once more as he called out.
{Existential Proofreader.}
HUUM!
His surrounding reality buzzed once more as a golden sea bloomed before prompts and illusory scenes began to fill his eyes.
{Your grand Fable continues to unfold with glory.}

{Elevated by the increased percentage of Existential Domains assimilated into it, as well as the Sources of many new Existences, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven begins to manufacture High Grade Planalith Krystallos and High Grade Armaments of Extremity that can be utilized by those in the latter Gradations of Extremity.}

{It is a precarious time of the start of Mors Apokalypsis, with the Inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven knowing that the coming day would send down more Legions of Apokalypsis Beasts, but their mood and wills remain unfettered.}

{Amidst the mingling of the natives of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and the new Inhabitants who recently arrived, the visage of the Emperor Penguin rises up and calls for a feast amidst this precarious time. It calls to celebrate the arrival of more comrades and that in the style of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, they would not be bothered by any apocalypses as they had gone through multiple before!}

{The first Feast of Quintessence erupts within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as Entities from eons ago and entities just recently born gain a chance to know and understand the weavings of each other.}
These illusory scenes all bloomed in Noah's mind as he smiled.

In these scenes, he could see the Bard of Quintessence sitting above a small floating landmass of sandy dream light, a symphony of celebration playing from him as around him, chalices filled to the brim with golden liquid and an assortment of Spiritual Herbs and grilled meats vibrating with Extremity Authority were being consumed by those participating in the Feast of Quintessence.
One of Noah's clones was also present in such a Feast as his prior role as a Chef unfolded, the Extremity of Gastronomy unfolding as everything prepared by him contained a shred of Extremity!
And the scenes flashing across his mind continued.

{In such a celebratory time, your Main Body did not sit idle as you convened the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to analyze the progression and utility of Dual Cultivation at this stage. Due to your robust vitality and elevating Bloodline that was becoming Existential, you find the effect of elevating one's existence during Dual Cultivation is not minimal.}
An interesting reality unfolded as before more scenes could cross his mind, Noah's mind buzzed with an Aurum colored glow as the capabilities of Existential Proofreader came to a halt.

He reversed it back as for the purposes of research, he didn't want to jump across the weavings of reality and Existence after he had ascertained the results of Dual Cultivation, only to attain memories of it. He wanted to fully experience these effects himself!
HUUM!
Once more, his body jumped forward across the weavings of Records.
And when his vision came to again, he could see the fiery visage of Barbatos- her eyes filled with determination as if she was about to have a great battle.
{Little Fish, I won't lose today!}

Her words were filled with conviction, but it was unknown whether they would hold any truth to them. In other Domains, Noah's vision also saw the mesmerizing figures of other Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as he jumped to the point in time right before he analyzed the utility of Dual Cultivation.
Of course, it was all for the sake of research and understanding!

chapters.title: Chapter 2928 Jumper! II
paragraphs: After critical research was carried out, Noah's existence continued to burn with the Aurum colored glow of the Protagonist as he resumed jumping through records and existence.
Existential Proofreader was activated once more as the Weaver of Extremity continued to flitter across time!
{The Hours of the first day of Mors Apokalypsis passed by as the existence of the Weaver of Extremity continued to be altered by the Fruits of Existence.}

{The breadth of your soul was growing along with the current Existential Extremity Authorities you held, but a sufficient enough space was expanded in your existence to retain an additional Existential Extremity Authority.}
{Multiple extremes express their intention and right, with Apocalypse, Relativity, Plot, and many others joining the fray.}
A moment came in the near future when Noah could expand yet another Existential Extremity Authority!

{As you pondered on the risks and benefits of expanding another authority or continuing to take the ones you currently hold to an even grander level, the weavings of your Existence had inadvertently caused changes to the flow of Mors Apokalypsis.}
Something new popped up.
Noah's mind focused sharply as the golden prompts rising seemed to be ever brighter.

{You stretch out your Existence to the utmost to understand how your weavings have impacted the unfolding Records around you, the level of your Existence and extremes allowing you to gain more threads of knowledge.}
{Threads of knowledge about the Codex of Extremity begin coming to you through the weavings your actions have caused.}
{For the success of any task and especially the task of Mors Apokalypsis, the Codex of Extremity has never failed.}

{Utilizing any means possible for whatever variables arise, the Codex of Extremity works to achieve its initiated purpose. Yet on the first day of Mors Apokalypsis, a catastrophic failure occurred where not even one percent of the parameters of success were achieved.}

{The weavings of the one responsible for this failure were analyzed as the Codex of Extremity has designed the Mors Apokalypsis of the Second Day to counter the one responsible for the previous failure, all while abiding by the absolute restrictions placed upon it.}
Noah's eyes radiated a lustrous light as waves of tyranny began to buzz within them.
The Codex of Extremity was something unique.
It seemed to be moving with an autonomous will to simply carry out a process that it was tasked with achieving, and it actually deviated from its normal workings in the case variables arose!
Noah...was a stupendous variable that the Codex of Extremity was now accounting for.
What exactly would change due to this?
Blazing with existential might, Noah gazed at a myriad of illusory scenes as he prepared to make another jump!
In the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
The Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had a contemplative as he floated in a unique domain.
A sea of white lay before his feet as all around him, intricate translucent streams flowed in a unique manner as his eyes were reading something from the weavings of these streams!

Nobody within the Gradations of Extremity could ever guess nor understand what he was currently looking at, with layers upon layers of the weavings of Records, Existence, and Extremes simultaneously moving around in these seemingly simple streams of white.
"Even though it has just begun, the noses of these barbarians are already sniffing something? Which Legacy covets what is mine?"
His eyes were sharp as he read and organized countless flows and weavings of information.
He knew there was a snake circling outside, plotting and planning.
But he didn't know the identity of this snake, nor did he know just how big it was.
As he was about to continue grasping the weavings around him, his face hardened in the next moment as he placed his right hand on his chest.
There, deep within, there lay his heart where he locked in everything that was his.

Yet at this moment, he felt a stream of translucent Fruits of Existence flowing out without his permission- and they followed a link he was bound to towards a distant location outside of the domain he was currently in!
He turned his head towards a certain direction where only a single thing could be- the one thing that could pull from his cache of treasures without his permission.
"The Codex of Extremity..."
His eyes became utterly sharp as he shockingly affirmed that even more of his reserves of the Fruits of Existence were being depleted!

The reasons for this were few, but it could only be explained that as Mors Apokalypsis progressed, the Codex of Extremity deemed it necessary to utilize more Fruits of Existence than those originally planned in order to achieve its purpose.
It rarely occurred.

Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had rarely heard of such a thing occurring, with the closest instances to memory being eons ago when Legacies were not utilizing Dikastes of Extremity and had more intricate relationships with the Seeds within the Existential Domain.

Then, the Legacy of Archimedes rose to prominence and proceeded to become one of the most powerful Legacies over the eons after they designed one of the more perfect methods to manage Existential Domains!

Archon Basileus Al-Abalem used such a method, but even now...he was watching the results of its failure as even after he was forced to utilize the Codex of Extremity, the problem remained so prominent that it was deemed necessary to utilize more Fruits of Existence!
His gaze was chilly as he felt the steady stream of his reserves continue to be taken away.
He didn't blame the Codex of Extremity.
It was only doing what it felt- no, what it knew to be necessary.
He thought of the identity of the insect that was at the root of all of this.
"Noah Osmont..." Archon Basileus Al-Abalem uttered out this name with an incredible amount of apathy and revulsion.
The Fruits of Existence being taken from him currently were manageable. They would go on to complete the task of the Codex of Extremity.

He...just wished that he could have this Osmont who was causing him all of these losses stand before him so that he could twist his existence in a million different ways- to express to him the ire that Seeds like him do have a significant part to play in the unfolding eons!

chapters.title: Chapter 2929 Alteration! I
paragraphs: The Eons of history were endlessly vast and filled with many names that rose and fell.
Very few ever managed to etch their names in eons of History- to be remembered and even remain moving to this day.
The Legacy of Archimedes was one such name that would forever be etched over the eons.
His Legacy...
Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had sharp eyes as he thought about his Legacy that was neither strong nor weak.

He wasn't in charge of some small and weak Existential Domain. He had climbed up the ranks until he was appointed to these Existential Domains of beginnings and endings as his collection of Fruits of Existence was immense!
But unlike some Legacies he looked at from afar, he didn't oversee multiple Existential Domains.
He wasn't even close to the center of power of this endless Existential Omniverse as he was just standing at the rungs of it!
Like all Legacies, he wished to climb up.
He wished for greater glory and honor- to make his existence even more distinguished.
So he bid his time and amassed droves of Fruits of Existence. He carefully chose his targets and was not yet ready to act!
But this Corrupted Seed...this Osmont...
The gaze of Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was filled with a chilling light as he observed the flow of Fruits of Existence, his voice coming out on magnetizing droves.
"What is a Seed to an Overseer? What is an animal to its owner?"
Utmost revulsion radiated from him.
Oh, how he wished he had the chance to crumple this Seed in his own hands!
As he expressed his intent, within these very same Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
The figure of another Entity raised her head while looking at the center of these intricate lands bathed in a paradisiacal white light.
There, Basileus Anaine saw the dazzling glimmer of a white book- the brilliance of the Codex of Extremity as it seemed to be exerting even greater authority!
Basileus Anaine's eyes were sharp as she looked at this phenomenon thoughtfully.
She knew it wouldn't happen without reason as for it to occur...
She gazed down at the white clouds below her.
As if she could pierce into the weavings of the lands beneath it- into the domains where Mors Apokalypsis was taking place.
'Is it you? My expectations only continue to rise...'
She didn't even vocalize her words as she only let them remain as passing thoughts, thinking of the figure of the man she saw within the weavings of a Record.
She was thinking of Noah Osmont!
As those in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos experienced this phenomenon, they weren't the only ones.
Far from here, in the secluded Archaeos Vacuous Pylos, a dark shrouded visage of the Archon Basileus Ignatius looked up coldly.

He paid a significantly less cost for the activation of Mors Apokalypsis, but he was paying it nonetheless. He was also connected to this process as he was an Archon Basileus of these Existential Domains too!
He felt the outflow of his own reserves of Fruits of Existence as he knew variables arose, but for now, be kept quiet.
He waited to see how the next few days of Mors Apokalypsis would unfold.
{The last hour of the First Day of Mors Apokalypsis dawned.}

{The Weaver of Extremity was an entirely different entity compared to the start of this day, with his Records nearly being assimilated fully into his existence as the breadth of his very being was rapidly expanded.}

{He was confident within himself, but so was the Codex of Extremity. Modifications had been made. Alterations were carried out to ensure within reasonable limits that the task of the Codex of Extremity could be carried out.}

{Knowing what was coming, you tried to foresee multiple possible paths your Fable could take. But the weaving of Existence, Records, and Extremes occurring next were too intricate and complex for your current self to bypass, and thus, the direction of your Unrecorded Fable could no longer be discerned.}
{Minutes before the start of the Second Day of Mors Apokalypsis, you could not foresee the surprises prepared by the Codex of Extremity.}
These prompts flowed smoothly into Noah's mind as his eyes shone with a devilish light!
What he could do was already ridiculous enough, but it was still within the bounds and power of his existence.

If he could see ahead, then it simply meant he had to get stronger to the extent that even the weavings of heavily intricate and complex matters like the unfolding of the Second Day of Mors Apokalypsis would be possible!
But he wasn't there yet.
And that was okay.
The time would come.
HUUM!
Covered by an Aurum colored glow, Noah's visage jumped across the weavings of Records once more.
His consciousness woke up to find his main body floating valiantly, adorned with a purple Emperor's Robe as no Armament was on him.
And what need did he have for an Armament when his Aspects of Existence had been getting baptized with the authority of the Fruits of Existence?
When his very skin held the hardness and majesty of a High Grade Armament of Extremity?

He contained his existence within himself as he stood ahead of others, with his Son, past Primogenitors of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, and more Defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven floating behind him with serious expressions!
They held a feast hours ago and celebrated their success, but they didn't let this cloud their judgments as they knew the next day would be just as crucial.
They just didn't know...to what extent.

Further ahead past Henry and others but behind Noah, the figures of Xiaomi, Athena, Barbatos, Katelyn, and other Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could be seen expressing glorious power at the Eighth Gradation of Extremity.

Their whole bodies brimmed with shocking life force and vitality as the elevated Existence of Noah was truly that unfathomable, the gains they made during their Dual Cultivation session not too long ago making them some of the most powerful combatants within these Lands as they relied on the Extremity of Harems.
They were ready to experience and utilize this power fully as they all stared towards the vibrant barrier of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven in the distance!

The Legacy of Archimedes was one such name that would forever be etched over the eons.
His Legacy...

He wasn't in charge of some small and weak Existential Domain.

He wished for greater glory and honor- to make his existence even more distinguished.
